verses.original: ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਏਕੁ ਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chamatakaar pragaas dheh dhis ek teh dhirasaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak pia(n)pai charan ja(n)pai bhagat vachhal har biradh aap banaiaa ||4||3||6||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaave ||
verses.translation: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai gireh har naahu su sadh hee raave ||
verses.translation: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: avinaasee avigat so prabh sadhaa navatan niramalaa ||
verses.translation: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: neh dhoor sadhaa hadhoor Thaakur dheh dhis pooran sadh sadhaa ||
verses.translation: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: praanapat gat mat jaa te pria preet preetam bhaave ||
verses.translation: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my Dear Beloved is pleasing to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai thir sa(n)tan sohaag marai na jaave ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau raam bhataar taa kai anadh ghanaa ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukhava(n)tee saa naar sobhaa poor banaa ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ॥
verses.translit: maan mahat kaliaan har jas sa(n)g surajan so prabhoo ||
verses.translation: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੂ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sidh nav nidh tit gireh nahee uoonaa sabh kachhoo ||
verses.translation: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. - everything is there.

verses.original: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: madhur baanee pireh maanee thir sohaag taa kaa banaa ||
verses.translation: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent and everlasting.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa ko raam bhataar taa kai anadh ghanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeaai ||
verses.translation: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.

verses.original: ਪੀਸਉ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: peesau charan pakhaar aap tiaageeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: taj aap miTai sa(n)taap aap neh jaanaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saran gaheejai maan leejai kare so sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਾਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhaas dhaasee taj udhaasee kar joR dhin rain jaageeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palms pressed together, remain wakeful day and night.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai aau sakhee sa(n)t paas sevaa laageeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee pooran aas jin(h) saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har kai ra(n)g gobi(n)dh simaran laagiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord of the Universe in meditation.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bharam moh vikaar dhoojaa sagal tineh tiaagiaa ||
verses.translation: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man saa(n)t sahaj subhaau vooThaa anadh ma(n)gal gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises with joy and delight.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa kai masatak bhaag s sevaa laiaa ||4||4||7||
verses.translation: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla,

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japa(n)tiaa kachh na kahai jamakaal ||
verses.translation: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death will have nothing to say to you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak man tan sukhee hoi a(n)te milai gopaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge with the Lord of the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: milau sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g moh udhaar leh ||
verses.translation: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: binau karau kar joR har har naam dheh ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam maagau charan laagau maan tiaagau tum(h) dhiaa ||
verses.translation: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Your kindness.

verses.original: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: katahoo(n) na dhaavau saran paavau karunaa mai prabh kar miaa ||
verses.translation: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment of mercy, have mercy on me.

verses.original: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਏਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: samarath agath apaar niramal sunahu suaamee binau eh ||
verses.translation: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak dhaan maagai janam maran nivaar leh ||1||
verses.translation: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, let my cycle of birth and death come to an end. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਨੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: aparaadhee matiheen niragun anaath neech ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom, worthless, destitute and vile.

verses.original: ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਕੁਲਹੀਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੋਹ ਕੀਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: saTh kaThor kulaheen biaapat moh keech ||
verses.translation: I am deceitful, hard-hearted, lowly and entangled in the mud of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਮਲ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਅਹੰ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mal bharam karam aha(n) mamataa maran cheet na aave ||
verses.translation: I am stuck in the filth of doubt and egotistical actions, and I try not to think of death.

verses.original: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਲਪਟਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: banitaa binodh ana(n)dh maiaa agiaanataa lapaTaave ||
verses.translation: In ignorance, I cling to the pleasures of woman and the joys of Maya.

verses.original: ਖਿਸੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਧੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: khisai joban badhai jarooaa dhin nihaare sa(n)g meech ||
verses.translation: My youth is wasting away, old age is approaching, and Death, my companion, is counting my days.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak aas teree saran saadhoo raakh neech ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, Lord; please preserve me, the lowly one, in the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਨ ॥
verses.translit: bharame janam anek sa(n)kaT mahaa jon ||
verses.translation: I have wandered through countless incarnations, suffering terrible pain in these lives.

verses.original: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਭੋਗ ਸੋਨ ॥
verses.translit: lapaT rahio teh sa(n)g meeThe bhog son ||
verses.translation: I am entangled in sweet pleasures and gold.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਆਇਓ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸਹ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat bhaar aganat aaio bahu pradheseh dhaio ||
verses.translation: After wandering around with such great loads of sin, I have come, after wandering through so many foreign lands.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਓਟ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ab oT dhaaree prabh muraaree sarab sukh har naio ||
verses.translation: Now, I have taken the protection of God, and I have found total peace in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਨ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaare prabh piaare mujh te kachhoo na hoaa hon ||
verses.translation: God, my Beloved, is my protector; nothing was done, or will ever be done, by myself alone.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਰੈ ਭਉਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh naanak kirapaa teree tarai bhaun ||3||
verses.translation: I have found peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak; by Your mercy, I swim across the world-ocean. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਗਤਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਕਉਨ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaareek udhaare bhagateh sa(n)saa kaun ||
verses.translation: You saved those who only pretended to believe, so what doubts should Your true devotees have?

verses.original: ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: jen ken parakaare har har jas sunahu sravan ||
verses.translation: By every means possible, listen to the Praises of the Lord with your ears.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun sravan baanee purakh giaanee man nidhaanaa paavahe ||
verses.translation: Listen with your ears to the Word of the Lord's Bani, the hymns of spiritual wisdom; thus you shall obtain the treasure in your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raate prabh bidhaate raam ke gun gaavahe ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Love of the Lord God, the Architect of Destiny, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧ ਕਾਗਦ ਬਨਰਾਜ ਕਲਮਾ ਲਿਖਣ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: basudh kaagadh banaraaj kalamaa likhan kau je hoi pavan ||
verses.translation: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,

verses.original: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਨ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
verses.translit: bea(n)t a(n)t na jai paiaa gahee naanak charan saran ||4||5||8||
verses.translation: but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: purakh pate bhagavaan taa kee saran gahee ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਪਰਾਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਲਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe paraan chi(n)taa sagal lahee ||
verses.translation: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਇਸਟ ਬੰਧਪ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut meet surijan isaT ba(n)dhap jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੰਤ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: geh ka(n)Th laiaa gur milaiaa jas bimal sa(n)t vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.

verses.original: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bea(n)t gun anek mahimaa keemat kachhoo na jai kahee ||
verses.translation: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਲਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh ek anik alakh Thaakur oT naanak tis gahee ||1||
verses.translation: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped His protection. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ban sa(n)saar sahaiee aap bhe ||
verses.translation: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ur haar bikh ke dhivas ge ||
verses.translation: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.

verses.original: ਗਤੁ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਆਵਣ ਸਭ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gat bharam moh bikaar binase jon aavan sabh rahe ||
verses.translation: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation into the womb is totally ended.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਧ ਅੰਚਲ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: agan saagar bhe seetal saadh a(n)chal geh rahe ||
verses.translation: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh gupaal dhiaal sa(n)mrith bol saadhoo har jai je ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord - the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaai pooran saadhasa(n)g paiee param gate ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh sa(n)g eko rav rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT vaasee aap viralai kinai lahiaa ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal poor pooran keeT hasat samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is contained in the ant and the elephant.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)te madh soiee gur prasaadhee jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He is known.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੀਲਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: braham pasariaa braham leelaa govi(n)dh gun nidh jan kahiaa ||
verses.translation: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. His humble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee har ek naanak rav rahiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain suhaavaRee aaiee simarat naam hare ||
verses.translation: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sa(n)g preet kalamal paap Tare ||
verses.translation: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bhookh dhaaridhr naaThe pragaT mag dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge man loReedhaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har dhekh dharasan ichh pu(n)nee kul sa(n)boohaa sabh tare ||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain ana(n)dh anadhin simara(n)t naanak har hare ||4||6||9||
verses.translation: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)dh raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਨੜੀਐ ਚਾਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)nee rainaReeaai chaamakan taare ||
verses.translation: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaageh sa(n)t janaa mere raam piaare ||
verses.translation: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: raam piaare sadhaa jaageh naam simareh anadhino ||
verses.translation: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal dhiaan hiradhai prabh bisar naahee ik khino ||
verses.translation: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh bikaar man kaa kalamalaa dhukh jaare ||
verses.translation: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa jaageh har dhaas sa(n)t piaare ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਡੰਬਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: meree sejaReeaai aadda(n)bar baniaa ||
verses.translation: My bed is adorned in splendor.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man anadh bhiaa prabh aavat suniaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mile suaamee sukheh gaamee chaav ma(n)gal ras bhare ||
verses.translation: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.

verses.original: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਭਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)g sa(n)g laage dhookh bhaage praan man tan sabh hare ||
verses.translation: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man ichh paiee prabh dhiaaiee sa(n)jog saahaa subh ganiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak mile sreedhar sagal aana(n)dh ras baniaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mil sakheeaa puchheh kahu ka(n)t neesaanee ||
verses.translation: I meet with my companions and say, ""Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord.""

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ras prem bharee kachh bol na jaanee ||
verses.translation: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gooR gupat apaar karate nigam a(n)t na paavahe ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhai dhiaai suaamee sadhaa har gun gaavahe ||
verses.translation: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal gun sugiaan pooran aapane prabh bhaanee ||
verses.translation: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak ra(n)g raatee prem sahaj samaanee ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sohilaRe har gaavan laage || saajan sarasiaRe dhukh dhusaman bhaage ||
verses.translation: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord, my friends became glad, and my troubles and enemies departed.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sahaj sarase har naam rahase prabh aap kirapaa dhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har charan laage sadhaa jaage mile prabh banavaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: subh dhivas aae sahaj paae sagal nidh prabh paage ||
verses.translation: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sadhaa har jan taage ||4||1||10||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਠਿ ਵੰਞੁ ਵਟਾਊੜਿਆ ਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: auTh va(n)n(j) vaTaauooRiaa tai kiaa chir laiaa ||
verses.translation: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?

verses.original: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੜੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: muhalat pu(n)naReeaa kit kooR lobhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?

verses.original: ਕੂੜੇ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooRe lubhaiaa dhoh maiaa kareh paap amitiaa ||
verses.translation: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਢੇਰੀ ਜਮਹਿ ਹੇਰੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਬਪੁੜੈ ਜਿਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan bhasam dderee jameh heree kaal bapuRai jitiaa ||
verses.translation: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵੈਸੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maal joban chhodd vaisee rahio painan khaiaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਲਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kamaanaa sa(n)g juliaa neh jai kirat miTaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actions cannot be erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਾਥੋਹੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: faathoh mirag jivai pekh rain cha(n)dhrain ||
verses.translation: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,

verses.original: ਸੂਖਹੁ ਦੂਖ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sookhahu dhookh bhe nit paap kamain ||
verses.translation: so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.

verses.original: ਪਾਪਾ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paapaa kamaane chhaddeh naahee lai chale ghat galaaviaa ||
verses.translation: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: haricha(n)dhauree dhekh mooThaa kooR sejaa raaviaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.

verses.original: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh aha(n)kaar maataa garab bhiaa samain ||
verses.translation: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak mirag agiaan binase neh miTai aavan jain ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings and goings shall never end. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਠੈ ਮਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: miThai makh muaa kiau le oddaaree ||
verses.translation: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਗਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee garat piaa kiau tareeaai taaree ||
verses.translation: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?

verses.original: ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: taran dhuhelaa bhiaa khin meh khasam chit na aaio ||
verses.translation: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord and Master, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਦੂਖਾ ਸਜਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhookhaa sajaiee ganat naahee keeaa apanaa paio ||
verses.translation: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

verses.original: ਗੁਝਾ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਈਤ ਉਤਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gujhaa kamaanaa pragaT hoaa ieet uteh khuaaree ||
verses.translation: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਮੂਠਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur baajh mooThaa manmukho aha(n)kaaree ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਜੀਵੇ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas jeeve lag prabh kee charanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lagai le'ee tis Thaakur saranee ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bal budh giaan dhiaan apanaa aap naam japaiaa ||
verses.translation: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspires them to chant His Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat aap hoaa aap jagat taraiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves the world.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee rakhanahaarai sadhaa niramal karanee ||
verses.translation: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak narak na jaeh kabahoo(n) har sa(n)t har kee saranee ||4||2||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord's Protection. ||4||2||11||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੰਞੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਲਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: va(n)n(j) mere aalasaa har paas bena(n)tee ||
verses.translation: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਵਉ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: raavau sahu aapanaRaa prabh sa(n)g soha(n)tee ||
verses.translation: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.

verses.original: ਸੰਗੇ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਰਾਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ge soha(n)tee ka(n)t suaamee dhinas rainee raaveeaai ||
verses.translation: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas chitaar jeevaa prabh pekh har gun gaaveeaai ||
verses.translation: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਲਜਾਇਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿੰਚੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: birahaa lajaiaa dharas paiaa amiau dhirasaT si(n)cha(n)tee ||
verses.translation: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak meree ichh pu(n)nee mile jis khoja(n)tee ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਸਿ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nas va(n)n(j)h kilavikhahu karataa ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.

verses.original: ਦੂਤਹ ਦਹਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhooteh dhahan bhiaa govi(n)dh pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTe gupaal gobi(n)dh laalan saadhasa(n)g vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.

verses.original: ਆਚਰਜੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aacharaj ddeeThaa amiau vooThaa gur prasaadhee jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਨਹ ਅੰਤੁ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man saa(n)t aaiee vajee vadhaiee neh a(n)t jaiee paiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sukh sahaj melaa prabhoo aap banaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਨ ਡੀਠੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: narak na ddeeThaRiaa simarat naarain ||
verses.translation: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਭਏ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai dharam kare dhoot bhe palain ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runs away from them.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharam dheeraj sahaj sukhe'ee saadhasa(n)gat har bhaje ||
verses.translation: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਭ ਤਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar anugrahu raakh leene moh mamataa sabh taje ||
verses.translation: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਅਘਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: geh ka(n)Th laae gur milaae govi(n)dh japat aghain ||
verses.translation: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, we are satisfied.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak simar suaamee sagal aas pujain ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: nidh sidh charan gahe taa kehaa kaaRaa ||
verses.translation: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh vas jisai so prabhoo asaaRaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa leene naam dheene kar dhaar masatak raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Holding me by the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar neh viaapai amiau har ras chaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge ran jeet vaddaa akhaaRaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victorious on the great battlefield of life.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee bahuR jam na upaaRaa ||4||3||12||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger of Death shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ ਸੋ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin raat kamaiaRo so aaio maathai ||
verses.translation: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis paas lukaidhaRo so vekhee saathai ||
verses.translation: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g dhekhai karanahaaraa kai paap kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sukirat keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall never have to go to hell.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har naam simarahu chalai terai saathe ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaj saadhasa(n)gat sadhaa naanak miTeh dhokh kamaate ||1||
verses.translation: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and the sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: valava(n)ch kar udhar bhareh moorakh gaavaaraa ||
verses.translation: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh dhe rahiaa har dhevanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhaataar sadhaa dhiaal suaamee kai manahu visaareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from our minds?

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge kul samoohaa taareeaai ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik dhev mun jan bhagat naam adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa bhajeeaai prabh ek karanaihaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਖੋਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: khoT na keechiee prabh parakhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੜੇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT kamaavadhaRe janameh sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar tin(h)ee tariaa jin(h)ee ek dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taj kaam karodh ani(n)dh ni(n)dhaa prabh saranaiee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal raviaa suaamee uooch agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak Tek jan kee charan kamal adhaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their only sustenance. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੇਖੁ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੜੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: pekh haricha(n)dhauraRee asathir kichh naahee ||
verses.translation: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ra(n)g jete se sa(n)g na jaahee ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g saathee sadhaa terai dhinas rain samaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har ek bin kachh avar naahee bhaau dhuteeaa jaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: meet joban maal sarabas prabh ek kar man maahee ||
verses.translation: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak vaddabhaag paieeaai sookh sahaj samaahee ||4||4||13||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ghar atthvaa
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Eighth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: kamalaa bhram bheet kamalaa bhram bheet he teekhan madh bipareet he avadh akaarath jaat ||
verses.translation: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful and destructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.

verses.original: ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: gahabar ban ghor gahabar ban ghor he gireh moosat man chor he dhinakaro anadhin khaat ||
verses.translation: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life is being consumed.

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhin khaat jaat bihaat prabh bin milahu prabh karunaa pate ||
verses.translation: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਬੀਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran anek beete pria sa(n)g bin kachh neh gate ||
verses.translation: I passed through so many births and deaths; without Union with the Beloved, I did not obtain salvation.

verses.original: ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: kul roop dhoop giaanaheenee tujh binaa moh kavan maat ||
verses.translation: I am without the status of high birth, beauty, glory or spiritual wisdom; without You, who is mine, O Mother?

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak saran aaio pria naath narahar karahu gaat ||1||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I enter the Lord's Sanctuary; O beloved almighty Lord and Master, please, save me! ||1||

verses.original: ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: meenaa jalaheen meenaa jalaheen he oh bichhurat man tan kheen he kat jeevan pria bin hot ||
verses.translation: Like a fish out of water - like a fish out of water, separated from the Lord, the mind and body perish; how can I live, without my Beloved?

verses.original: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਰਪੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: sanamukh seh baan sanamukh seh baan he mirag arape man tan praan he oh bedhio sahaj sarot ||
verses.translation: Facing the arrow head-on - facing the arrow head-on, the deer surrenders his mind, body and breath of life; he is struck by the hunter's soothing music.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: pria preet laagee mil bairaagee khin rahan dhirag tan tis binaa ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined love for my Beloved. In order to meet Him, I have become a renunciate. Cursed is that body which remains without Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਪਲਕਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: palakaa na laagai pria prem paagai chitava(n)t anadhin prabh manaa ||
verses.translation: My eyelids do not close, for I am absorbed in the love of my Beloved. Day and night, my mind thinks only of God.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਖੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: sreera(n)g raate naam maate bhai bharam dhuteeaa sagal khot ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Lord, intoxicated with the Naam, fear, doubt and duality have all left me.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar miaa dhiaa dhiaal pooran har prem naanak magan hot ||2||
verses.translation: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may be intoxicated with Your Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਤ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਮਲ ਬੰਧਾਵਤ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: aleeal gu(n)jaat aleeal gu(n)jaat he makara(n)dh ras baasan maat he preet kamal ba(n)dhaavat aap ||
verses.translation: The bumble-bee is buzzing - the bumble-bee is buzzing, intoxicated with the honey, the flavor and the fragrance; because of its love for the lotus, it entangles itself.

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੇ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਹੇ ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak chit piaas chaatirak chit piaas he ghan boo(n)dh bachitr man aas he al peevat binasat taap ||
verses.translation: The mind of the rainbird thirsts - the mind of the rainbird thirsts; its mind longs for the beautiful rain-drops from the clouds. Drinking them in, its fever departs.

verses.original: ਤਾਪਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: taapaa binaasan dhookh naasan mil prem man tan at ghanaa ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of fever, Remover of pain, please unite me with You. My mind and body have such great love for You.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar chatur sujaan suaamee kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
verses.translation: O my beautiful, wise and all-knowing Lord and Master, with what tongue should I chant Your Praises?

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa levahu naam dhevahu dhirasaT dhaarat miTat paap ||
verses.translation: Take me by the arm, and grant me Your Name. One who is blessed with Your Glance of Grace, has his sins erased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak ja(n)pai patit paavan har dharas pekhat neh sa(n)taap ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates on the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; beholding His Vision, he suffers no more. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਚਾਉ ਚਾਈਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: chitavau chit naath chitavau chit naath he rakh levahu saran anaath he mil chaau chaieele praan ||
verses.translation: I focus my consciousness on the Lord - I focus my consciousness upon the Lord; I am helpless - please, keep me under Your Protection. I yearn to meet You, my soul hungers for You.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਤ ਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar tan dhiaan su(n)dhar tan dhiaan he man lubadh gopaal giaan he jaachik jan raakhat maan ||
verses.translation: I meditate on Your beautiful body - I meditate on Your beautiful body; my mind is fascinated by Your spiritual wisdom, O Lord of the world. Please, preserve the honor of Your humble servants and beggars.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh maan pooran dhukh bidheeran sagal ichh puja(n)teeaa ||
verses.translation: God bestows perfect honor and destroys pain; He has fulfilled all my desires.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਹ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ka(n)Th laage dhin sabhaage mil naeh sej soha(n)teeaa ||
verses.translation: How very blessed was that day when the Lord embraced me; meeting my Husband Lord, my bed was beautified.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhirasaT dhaaree mile muraaree sagal kalamal bhe haan ||
verses.translation: When God granted His Grace and met me, all my sins were erased.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak meree aas pooran mile sreedhar gun nidhaan ||4||1||14||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||14||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਲੋਕ ਭੀ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਅਸ ਰਾਜੈ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaar salokaa naal salok bhee mahale pahile ke likhe Tu(n)dde as raajai kee dhunee ||
verses.translation: Vaar With Shaloks, And Shaloks Written By The First Mehla. To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Tunda-Asraajaa':

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane dhiauhaaRee sadh vaar ||
verses.translation: A hundred times a day, I am a sacrifice to my Guru;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin maanas te dhevate ke'ee karat na laagee vaar ||1||
verses.translation: He made angels out of men, without delay. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ ਉਗਵਹਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਹਿ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: je sau cha(n)dhaa ugaveh sooraj chaReh hajaar ||
verses.translation: If a hundred moons were to rise, and a thousand suns appeared,

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਦਿਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ete chaanan hodhiaa(n) gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: even with such light, there would still be pitch darkness without the Guru. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: naanak guroo na chetanee man aapanai suchet ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not think of the Guru, and who think of themselves as clever,

verses.original: ਛੁਟੇ ਤਿਲ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: chhuTe til booaaR jiau su(n)n(j)e a(n)dhar khet ||
verses.translation: shall be left abandoned in the field, like the scattered sesame.

verses.original: ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛੁਟਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: khetai a(n)dhar chhuTiaa kahu naanak sau naeh ||
verses.translation: They are abandoned in the field, says Nanak, and they have a hundred masters to please.

verses.original: ਫਲੀਅਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: fale'eeh fule'eeh bapuRe bhee tan vich suaaeh ||3||
verses.translation: The wretches bear fruit and flower, but within their bodies, they are filled with ashes. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapeen(h)ai aap saajio aapeen(h)ai rachio naau ||
verses.translation: He Himself created Himself; He Himself assumed His Name.

verses.original: ਦੁਯੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhuyee kudharat saajeeaai kar aasan ddiTho chaau ||
verses.translation: Secondly, He fashioned the creation; seated within the creation, He beholds it with delight.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaataa karataa aap too(n) tus dheveh kareh pasaau ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; by Your Pleasure, You bestow Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਲੈਸਹਿ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jaanoiee sabhasai dhe laiseh ji(n)dh kavaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Knower of all; You give life, and take it away again with a word.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar aasan ddiTho chaau ||1||
verses.translation: Seated within the creation, You behold it with delight. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਸਚੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
verses.translit: sache tere kha(n)dd sache brahama(n)dd ||
verses.translation: True are Your worlds, True are Your solar Systems.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਲੋਅ ਸਚੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sache tere loa sache aakaar ||
verses.translation: True are Your realms, True is Your creation.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਸਰਬ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sache tere karane sarab beechaar ||
verses.translation: True are Your actions, and all Your deliberations.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa teraa amar sachaa dheebaan ||
verses.translation: True is Your Command, and True is Your Court.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa teraa hukam sachaa furamaan ||
verses.translation: True is the Command of Your Will, True is Your Order.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa teraa karam sachaa neesaan ||
verses.translation: True is Your Mercy, True is Your Insignia.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਹਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: sache tudh aakheh lakh karoR ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands and millions call You True.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabh taan sachai sabh jor ||
verses.translation: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: sachee teree sifat sachee saalaeh ||
verses.translation: True is Your Praise, True is Your Adoration.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: sachee teree kudharat sache paatisaeh ||
verses.translation: True is Your almighty creative power, True King.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sach dhiaain sach ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, true are those who meditate on the True One.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਸੁ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo mar ja(n)me su kach nikach ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are subject to birth and death are totally false. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਵਡਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa vaddaa naau ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa sach niaau ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa nihachal thaau ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaanai aalaau ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee bujhai sabh bhaau ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa puchh na dhaat ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa aape aap ||
verses.translation: Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kaar na kathanee jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keetaa karanaa sarab rajai ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag sachai kee hai koThaRee sache kaa vich vaas ||
verses.translation: This world is the room of the True Lord; within it is the dwelling of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa hukam samai le ikan(h)aa hukame kare vinaas ||
verses.translation: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa bhaanai kadd le ikan(h)aa maiaa vich nivaas ||
verses.translation: Some, by the Pleasure of His Will, are lifted up out of Maya, while others are made to dwell within it.

verses.original: ਏਵ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਆਣੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: ev bh aakh na jaapiee j kisai aane raas ||
verses.translation: No one can say who will be rescued.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh jaaneeaai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is known as Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jeea upai kai likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, having created the souls, the Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record their accounts.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: othai sache hee sach nibaRai chun vakh kadde jajamaaliaa ||
verses.translation: There, only the Truth is judged true; the sinners are picked out and separated.

verses.original: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੑੈ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: thaau na pain kooRiaar muh kaal(h)ai dhojak chaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The false find no place there, and they go to hell with their faces blackened.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਠਗਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: terai nai rate se jin ge haar ge s Thagan vaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Name win, while the cheaters lose.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record the accounts. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh naadh visamaadh vedh ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is the sound current of the Naad, wonderful is the knowledge of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਜੀਅ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh jeea visamaadh bhedh ||
verses.translation: Wonderful are the beings, wonderful are the species.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh roop visamaadh ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Wonderful are the forms, wonderful are the colors.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਗੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh naage fireh ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: Wonderful are the beings who wander around naked.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh paun visamaadh paanee ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is the wind, wonderful is the water.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਖੇਡਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh aganee kheddeh viddaanee ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is fire, which works wonders.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh dharatee visamaadh khaanee ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is the earth, wonderful the sources of creation.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh saadh lageh paraanee ||
verses.translation: Wonderful are the tastes to which mortals are attached.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh sa(n)jog visamaadh vijog ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is union, and wonderful is separation.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh bhukh visamaadh bhog ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is hunger, wonderful is satisfaction.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh sifat visamaadh saalaeh ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is His Praise, wonderful is His adoration.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਉਝੜ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh ujhaR visamaadh raeh ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is the wilderness, wonderful is the path.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh neRai visamaadh dhoor ||
verses.translation: Wonderful is closeness, wonderful is distance.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: visamaadh dhekhai haajaraa hajoor ||
verses.translation: How wonderful to behold the Lord, ever-present here.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: vekh viddaan rahiaa visamaadh ||
verses.translation: Beholding His wonders, I am wonder-struck.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਝਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bujhan poorai bhaag ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who understand this are blessed with perfect destiny. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat dhisai kudharat suneeaai kudharat bhau sukh saar ||
verses.translation: By His Power we see, by His Power we hear; by His Power we have fear, and the essence of happiness.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat paataalee aakaasee kudharat sarab aakaar ||
verses.translation: By His Power the nether worlds exist, and the Akaashic ethers; by His Power the entire creation exists.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat vedh puraan katebaa kudharat sarab veechaar ||
verses.translation: By His Power the Vedas and the Puraanas exist, and the Holy Scriptures of the Jewish, Christian and Islamic religions. By His Power all deliberations exist.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat khaanaa peenaa pain(h)n kudharat sarab piaar ||
verses.translation: By His Power we eat, drink and dress; by His Power all love exists.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat jaatee jinasee ra(n)gee kudharat jeea jahaan ||
verses.translation: - By His Power come the species of all kinds and colors; by His Power the living beings of the world exist.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਦੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat nekeeaa kudharat badheeaa kudharat maan abhimaan ||
verses.translation: By His Power virtues exist, and by His Power vices exist. By His Power come honor and dishonor.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat paun paanee baisa(n)tar kudharat dharatee khaak ||
verses.translation: By His Power wind, water and fire exist; by His Power earth and dust exist.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਾਦਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teree kudharat too(n) kaadhir karataa paakee naiee paak ||
verses.translation: Everything is in Your Power, Lord; You are the all-powerful Creator. Your Name is the Holiest of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੋ ਤਾਕੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hukamai a(n)dhar vekhai varatai taako taak ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Command of His Will, He beholds and pervades the creation; He is absolutely unrivalled. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮੜਿ ਭਉਰੁ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapeen(h)ai bhog bhog kai hoi bhasamaR bhaur sidhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Enjoying his pleasures, one is reduced to a pile of ashes, and the soul passes away.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa hoaa dhuneedhaar gal sa(n)gal ghat chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: He may be great, but when he dies, the chain is thrown around his neck, and he is led away.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agai karanee keerat vaacheeaai beh lekhaa kar samajhaiaa ||
verses.translation: There, his good and bad deeds are added up; sitting there, his account is read.

verses.original: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਉਦੀਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: thaau na hovee paudheeiee hun suneeaai kiaa rooaaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is whipped, but finds no place of rest, and no one hears his cries of pain.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man a(n)dhai janam gavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The blind man has wasted his life away. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਸਦਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich pavan vahai sadhavaau ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the wind and breezes ever blow.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich chaleh lakh dhareeaau ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, thousands of rivers flow.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਢੈ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich agan kaddai vegaar ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, fire is forced to labor.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਦਬੀ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich dharatee dhabee bhaar ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the earth is crushed under its burden.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich i(n)dh firai sir bhaar ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the clouds move across the sky.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich raajaa dharam dhuaar ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands at His Door.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich sooraj bhai vich cha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the sun shines, and in the Fear of God, the moon reflects.

verses.original: ਕੋਹ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: koh karoRee chalat na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: They travel millions of miles, endlessly.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich sidh budh sur naath ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the Siddhas exist, as do the Buddhas, the demi-gods and Yogis.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich aaddaane aakaas ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the Akaashic ethers are stretched across the sky.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich jodh mahaabal soor ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the warriors and the most powerful heroes exist.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich aaveh jaaveh poor ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, multitudes come and go.

verses.original: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਭਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sagaliaa bhau likhiaa sir lekh ||
verses.translation: God has inscribed the Inscription of His Fear upon the heads of all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nirabhau nira(n)kaar sach ek ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: naanak nirabhau nira(n)kaar hor kete raam ravaal ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is fearless and formless; myriads of others, like Rama, are mere dust before Him.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੰਨੑ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: keteeaa ka(n)n(h) kahaaneeaa kete bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: There are so many stories of Krishna, so many who reflect over the Vedas.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਚਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਗਿੜਿ ਮੁੜਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kete nacheh ma(n)gate giR muR pooreh taal ||
verses.translation: So many beggars dance, spinning around to the beat.

verses.original: ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕਢਹਿ ਬਾਜਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baajaaree baajaar meh aai kaddeh baajaar ||
verses.translation: The magicians perform their magic in the market place, creating a false illusion.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੀਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh raaje raaneeaa boleh aal pataal ||
verses.translation: They sing as kings and queens, and speak of this and that.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: lakh Takiaa ke mu(n)dhaRe lakh Takiaa ke haar ||
verses.translation: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jit tan paie'eeh naanakaa se tan hoveh chhaar ||
verses.translation: Those bodies on which they are worn, O Nanak, those bodies turn to ashes.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਗਲੀਈ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan na galeeiee ddooddeeaai kathanaa karaRaa saar ||
verses.translation: Wisdom cannot be found through mere words. To explain it is as hard as iron.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam milai taa paieeaai hor hikamat hukam khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: When the Lord bestows His Grace, then alone it is received; other tricks and orders are useless. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kareh je aapanee taa nadharee satigur paiaa ||
verses.translation: If the Merciful Lord shows His Mercy, then the True Guru is found.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh jeeau bahute janam bhara(n)miaa taa satigur sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: This soul wandered through countless incarnations, until the True Guru instructed it in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jevadd dhaataa ko nahee sabh suniahu lok sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: There is no giver as great as the True Guru; hear this, all you people.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai sach paiaa jin(h)ee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the True Lord is found; He removes self-conceit from within,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jin sacho sach bujhaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: and instructs us in the Truth of Truths. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਘੜੀਆ ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਪਹਰ ਕੰਨੑ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ghaReeaa sabhe gopeeaa pahar ka(n)n(h) gopaal ||
verses.translation: All the hours are the milk-maids, and the quarters of the day are the Krishnas.

verses.original: ਗਹਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gahane paun paanee baisa(n)tar cha(n)dh sooraj avataar ||
verses.translation: The wind, water and fire are the ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee dharatee maal dhan varatan sarab ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: All of the earth, property, wealth and articles are all entanglements.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਸੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਖਾਇ ਗਇਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak musai giaan vihoonee khai giaa jamakaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without divine knowledge, one is plundered, and devoured by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਇਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ॥
verses.translit: vain chele nachan gur ||
verses.translation: The disciples play the music, and the gurus dance.

verses.original: ਪੈਰ ਹਲਾਇਨਿ ਫੇਰਨਿੑ ਸਿਰ ॥
verses.translit: pair halain ferani(h) sir ||
verses.translation: They move their feet and roll their heads.

verses.original: ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਰਾਵਾ ਝਾਟੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: audd udd raavaa jhaaTai pai ||
verses.translation: The dust flies and falls upon their hair.

verses.original: ਵੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਹਸੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vekhai lok hasai ghar jai ||
verses.translation: Beholding them, the people laugh, and then go home.

verses.original: ਰੋਟੀਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: roTeeaa kaaran pooreh taal ||
verses.translation: They beat the drums for the sake of bread.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾੜਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaaReh dharatee naal ||
verses.translation: They throw themselves upon the ground.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਨੑ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan gopeeaa gaavan kaan(h) ||
verses.translation: They sing of the milk-maids, they sing of the Krishnas.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan seetaa raaje raam ||
verses.translation: They sing of Sitas, and Ramas and kings.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau nira(n)kaar sach naam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is fearless and formless; His Name is True.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||
verses.translation: The entire universe is His Creation.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sevak seveh karam chaRaau ||
verses.translation: Those servants, whose destiny is awakened, serve the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)nee rain jin(h)aa man chaau ||
verses.translation: The night of their lives is cool with dew; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਖੀ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sikhee sikhiaa gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Guru, I have been taught these teachings;

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee karam laghaae paar ||
verses.translation: granting His Grace, He carries His servants across.

verses.original: ਕੋਲੂ ਚਰਖਾ ਚਕੀ ਚਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: koloo charakhaa chakee chak ||
verses.translation: The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the grinding stones, the potter's wheel,

verses.original: ਥਲ ਵਾਰੋਲੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: thal vaarole bahut ana(n)t ||
verses.translation: the numerous, countless whirlwinds in the desert,

verses.original: ਲਾਟੂ ਮਾਧਾਣੀਆ ਅਨਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: laaToo maadhaaneeaa anagaeh ||
verses.translation: the spinning tops, the churning sticks, the threshers,

verses.original: ਪੰਖੀ ਭਉਦੀਆ ਲੈਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)khee bhaudheeaa lain na saeh ||
verses.translation: the breathless tumblings of the birds,

verses.original: ਸੂਐ ਚਾੜਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: sooaai chaaR bhavaie'eeh ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: and the men moving round and round on spindles

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉਦਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaudhiaa ganat na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the tumblers are countless and endless.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaae soi ||
verses.translation: The Lord binds us in bondage - so do we spin around.

verses.original: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਨਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: piaai kirat nachai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: According to their actions, so do all people dance.

verses.original: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nach nach haseh chaleh se roi ||
verses.translation: Those who dance and dance and laugh, shall weep on their ultimate departure.

verses.original: ਉਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: audd na jaahee sidh na hoh ||
verses.translation: They do not fly to the heavens, nor do they become Siddhas.

verses.original: ਨਚਣੁ ਕੁਦਣੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nachan kudhan man kaa chaau ||
verses.translation: They dance and jump around on the urgings of their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin(h) man bhau tin(h)aa man bhaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Fear of God, have the love of God in their minds as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naau teraa nira(n)kaar hai nai liaai narak na jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Fearless Lord; chanting Your Name, one does not have to go to hell.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ ਆਖਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa dhe khaajai aakh gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Soul and body all belong to Him; asking Him to give us sustenance is a waste.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je loReh cha(n)gaa aapanaa kar pu(n)nahu neech sadhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: If you yearn for goodness, then perform good deeds and feel humble.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je jaravaanaa paraharai jar ves karedhee aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Even if you remove the signs of old age, old age shall still come in the guise of death.

verses.original: ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ko rahai na bhareeaai paieeaai ||5||
verses.translation: No one remains here when the count of the breaths is full. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
