verses.translit: musalamaanaa sifat sareeat paR paR kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Muslims praise the Islamic law; they read and reflect upon it.

verses.original: ਬੰਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੰਦੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhe se j paveh vich ba(n)dhee vekhan kau dheedhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's bound servants are those who bind themselves to see the Lord's Vision.

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo saalaahee saalaahan dharasan roop apaar ||
verses.translation: The Hindus praise the Praiseworthy Lord; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, His form is incomparable.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅਰਚਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਗਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: teerath naaveh arachaa poojaa agar vaas bahakaar ||
verses.translation: They bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, making offerings of flowers, and burning incense before idols.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਿੑ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਲਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jogee su(n)n dhiaavani(h) jete alakh naam karataar ||
verses.translation: The Yogis meditate on the absolute Lord there; they call the Creator the Unseen Lord.

verses.original: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sookham moorat naam nira(n)jan kaiaa kaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

verses.original: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sateeaa man sa(n)tokh upajai dhenai kai veechaar ||
verses.translation: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

verses.original: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhe dhe ma(n)geh sahasaa goonaa sobh kare sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

verses.original: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: choraa jaaraa tai kooRiaaraa khaaraabaa vekaar ||
verses.translation: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik hodhaa khai chaleh aaithaauoo tinaa bh kaiee kaar ||
verses.translation: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal jeeaa pureeaa loaa aakaaraa aakaar ||
verses.translation: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: oi j aakheh su too(n)hai jaaneh tinaa bh teree saar ||
verses.translation: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa bhukh saalaahan sach naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh dhin raatee gunava(n)tiaa paa chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: miTee musalamaan kee peRai piee kumi(h)aar ||
verses.translation: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

verses.original: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaR bhaa(n)dde iTaa keeaa jaladhee kare pukaar ||
verses.translation: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: jal jal rovai bapuRee jhaR jhaR paveh a(n)giaar ||
verses.translation: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin karatai kaaran keeaa so jaanai karataar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kinai na paio bin satigur kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich aap rakhion kar paragaT aakh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai sadhaa mukat hai jin vichahu moh chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

verses.original: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: autam eh beechaar hai jin sache siau chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhaataa paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich aaiaa hau vich giaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich ja(n)miaa hau vich muaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich dhitaa hau vich liaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich khaTiaa hau vich giaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich sachiaar kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: In ego they become truthful or false.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich paap pu(n)n veechaar ||
verses.translation: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich narak surag avataar ||
verses.translation: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich hasai hau vich rovai ||
verses.translation: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich bhareeaai hau vich dhovai ||
verses.translation: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich jaatee jinasee khovai ||
verses.translation: In ego they lose social status and class.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich moorakh hau vich siaanaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

verses.original: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: mokh mukat kee saar na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau vich maiaa hau vich chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai kar kar ja(n)t upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai boojhai taa dhar soojhai ||
verses.translation: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan vihoonaa kath kath loojhai ||
verses.translation: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak hukamee likheeaai lekh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jehaa vekheh tehaa vekh ||1||
verses.translation: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai ehaa jaat hai haumai karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai eiee ba(n)dhanaa fir fir jonee paeh ||
verses.translation: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai kithahu uoopajai kit sa(n)jam ieh jai ||
verses.translation: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai eho hukam hai piaai kirat firaeh ||
verses.translation: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai dheeragh rog hai dhaaroo bhee is maeh ||
verses.translation: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa gur kaa sabadh kamaeh ||
verses.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai sunahu janahu it sa(n)jam dhukh jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀੲਂੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sev keetee sa(n)tokhe'ee(n)ee jin(h)ee sacho sach dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: on(h)ee ma(n)dhai pair na rakhio kar sukirat dharam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.

verses.original: ਓਨੑੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: on(h)ee dhuneeaa toRe ba(n)dhanaa a(n)n paanee thoRaa khaiaa ||
verses.translation: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) bakhaseesee agalaa nit dheveh chaReh savaiaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.

verses.original: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: vaddiaaiee vaddaa paiaa ||7||
verses.translation: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: purakhaa(n) birakhaa(n) teerathaa(n) taTaa(n) meghaa(n) khetaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,

verses.original: ਦੀਪਾਂ ਲੋਆਂ ਮੰਡਲਾਂ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਰਭੰਡਾਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: dheepaa(n) loaa(n) ma(n)ddalaa(n) kha(n)ddaa(n) varabha(n)ddaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾਂ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੇਤਜਾਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj utabhujaa(n) khaanee setajaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: so mit jaanai naanakaa saraa(n) meraa(n) ja(n)taeh ||
verses.translation: oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ja(n)t upai kai sa(n)maale sabhanaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jin karatai karanaa keeaa chi(n)taa bh karanee taeh ||
verses.translation: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: so karataa chi(n)taa kare jin upaiaa jag ||
verses.translation: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis johaaree suasat tis tis dheebaan abhag ||
verses.translation: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin kiaa Tikaa kiaa tag ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh nekeeaa cha(n)giaaieeaa lakh pu(n)naa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands of blessed charities,

verses.original: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: lakh tap upar teerathaa(n) sahaj jog bebaan ||
verses.translation: hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga in the wilderness,

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: lakh sooratan sa(n)garaam ran meh chhuTeh paraan ||
verses.translation: hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: lakh suratee lakh giaan dhiaan paRe'eh paaTh puraan ||
verses.translation: hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divine wisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin karatai karanaa keeaa likhiaa aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak matee mithiaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib ek too(n) jin sacho sach varataiaa ||
verses.translation: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheh tis milai sach taa tin(h)ee sach kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai sach paiaa jin(h) kai hiradhai sach vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh sach na jaanan(h)ee manmukhee janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away in vain.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: vich dhuneeaa kaahe aaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Why have they even come into the world? ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR gaddee ladhe'eeh paR paR bhare'eh saath ||
verses.translation: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes of books.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR beRee paieeaai paR paR gadde'eeh khaat ||
verses.translation: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits with them.

verses.original: ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: paRe'eh jete baras baras paRe'eh jete maas ||
verses.translation: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are there are.

verses.original: ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: paReeaai jetee aarajaa paRe'eh jete saas ||
verses.translation: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak lekhai ik gal hor haumai jhakhanaa jhaakh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idle talk in ego. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: likh likh paRiaa ||
verses.translation: The more one writes and reads,

verses.original: ਤੇਤਾ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tetaa kaRiaa ||
verses.translation: the more one burns.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahu teerath bhaviaa ||
verses.translation: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage,

verses.original: ਤੇਤੋ ਲਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: teto laviaa ||
verses.translation: the more one talks uselessly.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bhekh keeaa dhehee dhukh dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahu ve jeeaa apanaa keeaa ||
verses.translation: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n na khaiaa saadh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahu dhukh paiaa dhoojaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: basatr na pahirai ||
verses.translation: One who does not wear any clothes,

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਹਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis kaharai ||
verses.translation: suffers night and day.

verses.original: ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mon vigootaa ||
verses.translation: Through silence, he is ruined.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau jaagai gur bin sootaa ||
verses.translation: How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?

verses.original: ਪਗ ਉਪੇਤਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pag upetaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who goes barefoot

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa keeaa kamaanaa ||
verses.translation: suffers by his own actions.

verses.original: ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: al mal khaiee sir chhaiee paiee ||
verses.translation: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh a(n)dhai pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: the blind fool loses his honor.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai kichh thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: rahai bebaanee maRee masaanee ||
verses.translation: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh na jaanai fir pachhutaanee ||
verses.translation: - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe so sukh paae ||
verses.translation: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kare so paae ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aas a(n)dhese te nihakeval haumai sabadh jalaae ||2||
verses.translation: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat terai man bhaavadhe dhar sohan keerat gaavadhe ||
verses.translation: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak karamaa baahare dhar ddoa na lahan(h)ee dhaavadhe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik mool na bujhani(h) aapanaa anahodhaa aap ganaidhe ||
verses.translation: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddaaddee kaa neech jaat hor utam jaat sadhaidhe ||
verses.translation: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: tin(h) ma(n)gaa j tujhai dhiaaidhe ||9||
verses.translation: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR raajaa kooR parajaa kooR sabh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR ma(n)ddap kooR maaRee kooR baisanahaar ||
verses.translation: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR suinaa kooR rupaa kooR pain(h)nahaar ||
verses.translation: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kaiaa kooR kapaR kooR roop apaar ||
verses.translation: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR meeaa kooR beebee khap hoe khaar ||
verses.translation: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kooRai neh lagaa visariaa karataar ||
verses.translation: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kis naal keechai dhosatee sabh jag chalanahaar ||
verses.translation: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR miThaa kooR maakhiau kooR ddobe poor ||
verses.translation: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai benatee tudh baajh kooRo kooR ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa ridhai sachaa hoi ||
verses.translation: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kee mal utarai tan kare hachhaa dhoi ||
verses.translation: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau sun man rahaseeaai taa paae mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa jugat jaanai jeeau ||
verses.translation: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

verses.original: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharat kaiaa saadh kai vich dhei karataa beeau ||
verses.translation: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach taa par jaaneeaai jaa sikh sachee lei ||
verses.translation: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa jaanai jeea kee kichh pu(n)n dhaan karei ||
verses.translation: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach taa(n) par jaaneeaai jaa aatam teerath kare nivaas ||
verses.translation: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo no puchh kai beh rahai kare nivaas ||
verses.translation: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sabhanaa hoi dhaaroo paap kaddai dhoi ||
verses.translation: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vakhaanai benatee jin sach palai hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhaan mahi(n)ddaa talee khaak je milai ta masatak laieeaai ||
verses.translation: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kooRaa laalach chhaddeeaai hoi ik man alakh dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

verses.original: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: fal teveho paieeaai jevehee kaar kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je hovai poorab likhiaa taa dhooR tin(h)aa dhee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: mat thoRee sev gavaieeaai ||10||
verses.translation: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sach kaal kooR varatiaa kal kaalakh betaal ||
verses.translation: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

verses.original: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: beeau beej pat lai ge ab kiau ugavai dhaal ||
verses.translation: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ik hoi ta ugavai rutee hoo rut hoi ||
verses.translation: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak paahai baaharaa korai ra(n)g na soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich khu(n)b chaRaieeaai saram paahu tan hoi ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagatee je rapai kooRai soi na koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab paap dhui raajaa mahataa kooR hoaa sikadhaar ||
verses.translation: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam neb sadh puchheeaai beh beh kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੀ ਰਯਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhee rayat giaan vihoonee bhaeh bhare muradhaar ||
verses.translation: Their subjects are blind, and without wisdom, they try to please the will of the dead.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਚਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee nacheh vaaje vaaveh roop kareh seegaar ||
verses.translation: The spiritually wise dance and play their musical instruments, adorning themselves with beautiful decorations.

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਹਿ ਵਾਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: uooche kookeh vaadhaa gaaveh jodhaa kaa veechaar ||
verses.translation: They shout out loud, and sing epic poems and heroic stories.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਸੰਜੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh pa(n)ddit hikamat hujat sa(n)jai kareh piaar ||
verses.translation: The fools call themselves spiritual scholars, and by their clever tricks, they love to gather wealth.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharamee dharam kareh gaavaaveh ma(n)geh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The righteous waste their righteousness, by asking for the door of salvation.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਛਡਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jatee sadhaaveh jugat na jaaneh chhadd baheh ghar baar ||
verses.translation: They call themselves celibate, and abandon their homes, but they do not know the true way of life.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko pooraa aape hovai ghaT na koiee aakhai ||
verses.translation: Everyone calls himself perfect; none call themselves imperfect.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pat paravaanaa pichhai paieeaai taa naanak toliaa jaapai ||2||
verses.translation: If the weight of honor is placed on the scale, then, O Nanak, one sees his true weight. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vadhee su vajag naanakaa sachaa vekhai soi ||
verses.translation: Evil actions become publicly known; O Nanak, the True Lord sees everything.

verses.original: ਸਭਨੀ ਛਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੀਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanee chhaalaa maareeaa karataa kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone makes the attempt, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: agai jaat na jor hai agai jeeau nave ||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul is new.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin kee lekhai pat pavai cha(n)ge seiee kei ||3||
verses.translation: Those few, whose honor is confirmed, are good. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhur karam jinaa kau tudh paiaa taa tinee khasam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Only those whose karma You have pre-ordained from the very beginning, O Lord, meditate on You.

verses.original: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: enaa ja(n)taa kai vas kichh naahee tudh vekee jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nothing is in the power of these beings; You created the various worlds.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no too(n) mel laih ik aapahu tudh khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some, You unite with Yourself, and some, You lead astray.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te jaaniaa jithai tudh aap bujhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace You are known; through Him, You reveal Yourself.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee sach samaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: We are easily absorbed in You. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dhaaroo sukh rog bhiaa jaa sukh taam na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa karanaa mai naahee jaa hau karee na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Creator Lord; I can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree kudharat vasiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power which is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na jaiee lakhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your limits cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaat meh jot jot meh jaataa akal kalaa bharapoor rahiaa ||
verses.translation: Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light; Your almighty power is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿੑਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa saahib sifat suaali(h)au jin keetee so paar piaa ||
verses.translation: You are the True Lord and Master; Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak karate keeaa baataa jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the stories of the Creator Lord; whatever He is to do, He does. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
verses.translit: jog sabadha(n) giaan sabadha(n) bedh sabadha(n) braahamaneh ||
verses.translation: The Way of Yoga is the Way of spiritual wisdom; the Vedas are the Way of the Brahmins.

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
verses.translit: khatree sabadha(n) soor sabadha(n) soodhr sabadha(n) paraa kirateh ||
verses.translation: The Way of the Khshatriya is the Way of bravery; the Way of the Shudras is service to others.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab sabadha(n) ek sabadha(n) je ko jaanai bheau || naanak taa kaa dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||3||
verses.translation: The Way of all is the Way of the One; Nanak is a slave to one who knows this secret; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek kirasana(n) sarab dhevaa dhev dhevaa ta aatamaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord Krishna is the Divine Lord of all; He is the Divinity of the individual soul.

verses.original: ਆਤਮਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਸੵਿ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aatamaa baasudhevasiye je ko jaanai bheau || naanak taa kaa dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is a slave to anyone who understands this mystery of the all-pervading Lord; he himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||4||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁੰਭੇ ਬਧਾ ਜਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)bhe badhaa jal rahai jal bin ku(n)bh na hoi ||
verses.translation: Water remains confined within the pitcher, but without water, the pitcher could not have been formed;

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਬਧਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: giaan kaa badhaa man rahai gur bin giaan na hoi ||5||
verses.translation: just so, the mind is restrained by spiritual wisdom, but without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਓਮੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaa hovai gunahagaar taa omee saadh na maareeaai ||
verses.translation: If an educated person is a sinner, then the illiterate holy man is not to be punished.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਘਾਲੇ ਘਾਲਣਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਨਾਉ ਪਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa ghaale ghaalanaa teveho naau pachaareeaai ||
verses.translation: As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਖੇਡੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਇਆ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee kalaa na kheddeeaai jit dharageh giaa haareeaai ||
verses.translation: So do not play such a game, which will bring you to ruin at the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੜਿਆ ਅਤੈ ਓਮੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaa atai omeeaa veechaar agai veechaareeaai ||
verses.translation: The accounts of the educated and the illiterate shall be judged in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: muh chalai su agai maareeaai ||12||
verses.translation: One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer in the world hereafter. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak mer sareer kaa ik rath ik rathavaahu ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug fer vaTaie'eeh giaanee bujheh taeh ||
verses.translation: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satajug rath sa(n)tokh kaa dharam agai rathavaahu ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness the charioteer.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: tretai rath jatai kaa jor agai rathavaahu ||
verses.translation: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.

verses.original: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaapur rath tapai kaa sat agai rathavaahu ||
verses.translation: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kalajug rath agan kaa kooR agai rathavaahu ||1||
verses.translation: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saam kahai seta(n)bar suaamee sach meh aachhai saach rahe || sabh ko sach samaavai ||
verses.translation: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth, everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.

verses.original: ਰਿਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: rig kahai rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhevaa meh soor ||
verses.translation: among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nai liaai paraachhat jaeh ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name, sins depart;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tau mokha(n)tar paeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.

verses.original: ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: juj meh jor chhalee cha(n)dhraaval kaan(h) kirasan jaadham bhiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarajaat gopee lai aaiaa bi(n)dhraaban meh ra(n)g keeaa ||
verses.translation: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh bedh atharaban hooaa naau khudhaiee alahu bhiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became the Name of God.

verses.original: ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: neel basatr le kapaRe pahire turak paThaanee amal keeaa ||
verses.translation: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: chaare vedh hoe sachiaar ||
verses.translation: The four Vedas each claim to be true.

verses.original: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: paReh guneh tin(h) chaar veechaar ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat kar neech sadhaae || tau naanak mokha(n)tar paae ||2||
verses.translation: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility, O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur viTahu vaariaa jit miliaai khasam samaaliaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the Lord Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin kar upadhes giaan a(n)jan dheeaa in(h)ee netree jagat nihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and with these eyes, I behold the world.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khasam chhodd dhoojai lage ddube se vanajaariaa ||
verses.translation: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another, are drowned.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo hai bohithaa viralai kinai veechaariaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa paar utaariaa ||13||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mal rukh sarairaa at dheeragh at much ||
verses.translation: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: oi j aaveh aas kar jaeh niraase kit ||
verses.translation: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.

verses.original: ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
verses.translit: fal fike ful bakabake ka(n)m na aaveh pat ||
verses.translation: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: miThat neevee naanakaa gun cha(n)giaaieeaa tat ||
verses.translation: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko nivai aap kau par kau nivai na koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.

verses.original: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhar taaraajoo toleeaai nivai su gauraa hoi ||
verses.translation: When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side which descends is heavier.

verses.original: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aparaadhee dhoonaa nivai jo ha(n)taa miragaeh ||
verses.translation: The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.

verses.original: ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sees nivaiaai kiaa theeaai jaa ridhai kusudhe jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
verses.translit: paR pusatak sa(n)dhiaa baadha(n) ||
verses.translation: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;

verses.original: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
verses.translit: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
verses.translation: you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਭੂਖਣ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: mukh jhooTh bibhookhan saara(n) ||
verses.translation: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with precious decorations;

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
verses.translation: you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
verses.translit: gal maalaa tilak lilaaTa(n) ||
verses.translation: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dhotee basatr kapaaTa(n) ||
verses.translation: upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: je jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
verses.translation: If you knew the nature of God,

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: sabh fokaT nisachau karama(n) ||
verses.translation: you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak nihachau dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vin satigur vaaT na paavai ||2||
verses.translation: without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kapaR roop suhaavanaa chhadd dhuneeaa a(n)dhar jaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa cha(n)gaa aapanaa aape hee keetaa paavanaa ||
verses.translation: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukam ke'ee man bhaavadhe raeh bheeRai agai jaavanaa ||
verses.translation: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter.

verses.original: ਨੰਗਾ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: na(n)gaa dhojak chaaliaa taa dhisai kharaa ddaraavanaa ||
verses.translation: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kar aaugan pachhotaavanaa ||14||
verses.translation: He regrets the sins he committed. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਪਾਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa kapaeh sa(n)tokh soot jat ga(n)ddee sat vaT ||
verses.translation: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh janeuoo jeea kaa hiee ta paadde ghat ||
verses.translation: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa eh tuTai naa mal lagai naa eh jalai na jai ||
verses.translation: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਗਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su maanas naanakaa jo gal chale pai ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around their necks.

verses.original: ਚਉਕੜਿ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਬਹਿ ਚਉਕੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chaukaR mul anaiaa beh chaukai paiaa ||
verses.translation: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.

verses.original: ਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਚੜਾਈਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sikhaa ka(n)n chaRaieeaa gur braahaman thiaa ||
verses.translation: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ ਓਹੁ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਵੇਤਗਾ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oh muaa oh jhaR piaa vetagaa giaa ||1||
verses.translation: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਲਖ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: lakh choreeaa lakh jaareeaa lakh kooReeaa lakh gaal ||
verses.translation: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: lakh Thageeaa pahinaameeaa raat dhinas jeea naal ||
verses.translation: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against his fellow beings.

verses.original: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮੑਣੁ ਵਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: tag kapaahahu kateeaai baam(h)n vaTe aai ||
verses.translation: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.

verses.original: ਕੁਹਿ ਬਕਰਾ ਰਿੰਨਿੑ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kuh bakaraa ri(n)ni(h) khaiaa sabh ko aakhai pai ||
verses.translation: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, ""Put on the sacred thread.""

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸੁਟੀਐ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hoi puraanaa suTeeaai bhee fir paieeaai hor ||
verses.translation: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਤਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tag na tuTiee je tag hovai jor ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: nai ma(n)niaai pat uoopajai saalaahee sach soot ||
verses.translation: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharageh a(n)dhar paieeaai tag na tooTas poot ||3||
verses.translation: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tag na i(n)dhree tag na naaree ||
verses.translation: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake thuk pavai nit dhaaRee ||
verses.translation: The man's beard is spat upon daily.

verses.original: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: tag na pairee tag na hathee ||
verses.translation: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;

verses.original: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਅਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: tag na jihavaa tag na akhee ||
verses.translation: no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.

verses.original: ਵੇਤਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: vetagaa aape vatai ||
verses.translation: The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.

verses.original: ਵਟਿ ਧਾਗੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਘਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaT dhaage avaraa ghatai ||
verses.translation: Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਭਾੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: lai bhaaR kare veeaahu ||
verses.translation: He takes payment for performing marriages;

verses.original: ਕਢਿ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kadd kaagal dhase raahu ||
verses.translation: reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun vekhahu lokaa eh viddaan ||
verses.translation: Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man a(n)dhaa naau sujaan ||4||
verses.translation: He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: saahib hoi dhiaal kirapaa kare taa saiee kaar karaisee ||
verses.translation: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak sevaa kare jis no hukam manaisee ||
verses.translation: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)niaai hovai paravaan taa khasamai kaa mahal paisee ||
verses.translation: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai bhaavai so kare manahu chi(n)dhiaa so fal paisee ||
verses.translation: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: taa dharageh paidhaa jaisee ||15||
verses.translation: Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਊ ਬਿਰਾਹਮਣ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਰਿ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: guoo biraahaman kau kar laavahu gobar taran na jaiee ||
verses.translation: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen will not save them.

verses.original: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛਾਂ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhotee Tikaa tai japamaalee dhaan malechhaa(n) khaiee ||
verses.translation: They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar poojaa paReh katebaa sa(n)jam turakaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamic sacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.

verses.original: ਛੋਡੀਲੇ ਪਾਖੰਡਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddeele paakha(n)ddaa ||
verses.translation: Renounce your hypocrisy!

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਇਐ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਰੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam liaai jaeh tara(n)dhaa ||1||
verses.translation: Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: maanas khaane kareh nivaaj ||
verses.translation: The man-eaters say their prayers.

verses.original: ਛੁਰੀ ਵਗਾਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: chhuree vagain tin gal taag ||
verses.translation: Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: tin ghar brahaman pooreh naadh ||
verses.translation: In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.

verses.original: ਉਨੑਾ ਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਓਈ ਸਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: aun(h)aa bh aaveh oiee saadh ||
verses.translation: They too have the same taste.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooRee raas kooRaa vaapaar ||
verses.translation: False is their capital, and false is their trade.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR bol kareh aahaar ||
verses.translation: Speaking falsehood, they take their food.

verses.original: ਸਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saram dharam kaa dderaa dhoor ||
verses.translation: The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kooR rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.

verses.original: ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੇੜਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mathai Tikaa teR dhotee kakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;

verses.original: ਹਥਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hath chhuree jagat kaasaiee ||
verses.translation: in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world!

verses.original: ਨੀਲ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: neel vasatr pahir hoveh paravaan ||
verses.translation: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.

verses.original: ਮਲੇਛ ਧਾਨੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: malechh dhaan le poojeh puraan ||
verses.translation: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਅਭਾਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਬਕਰਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: abhaakhiaa kaa kuThaa bakaraa khaanaa ||
verses.translation: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,

verses.original: ਚਉਕੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chauke upar kisai na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

verses.original: ਦੇ ਕੈ ਚਉਕਾ ਕਢੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhe kai chaukaa kaddee kaar ||
verses.translation: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.

verses.original: ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: aupar aai baiThe kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: The false come and sit within them.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ਵੇ ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ॥ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਫਿਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: mat bhiTai ve mat bhiTai || ih a(n)n asaaddaa fiTai ||
verses.translation: They cry out, ""Do not touch our food, or it will be polluted!""

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਫਿਟੈ ਫੇੜ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan fiTai feR karen ||
verses.translation: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: man jooThai chulee bharen ||
verses.translation: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sach dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: such hovai taa sach paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਿਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: chitai a(n)dhar sabh ko vekh nadharee heTh chalaidhaa ||
verses.translation: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhe vaddiaaieeaa aape hee karam karaidhaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.

verses.original: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddahu vaddaa vadd medhanee sire sir dha(n)dhai laidhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਉਪਠੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar upaThee je kare sulataanaa ghaahu karaidhaa ||
verses.translation: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਭਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: dhar ma(n)gan bhikh na paidhaa ||16||
verses.translation: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: je mohaakaa ghar muhai ghar muh pitaree dhei ||
verses.translation: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: agai vasat sin(j)aaneeaai pitaree chor karei ||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves as well.

verses.original: ਵਢੀਅਹਿ ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: vadde'eeh hath dhalaal ke musafee eh karei ||
verses.translation: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak agai so milai j khaTe ghaale dhei ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਰੂ ਸਿਰਨਾਵਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jiau joroo siranaavanee aavai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: As a woman has her periods, month after month,

verses.original: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jooThe jooThaa mukh vasai nit nit hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again and again.

verses.original: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਿੰਡਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sooche eh na aakhe'eeh bahan j pi(n)ddaa dhoi ||
verses.translation: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.

verses.original: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sooche seiee naanakaa jin man vasiaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ture palaane paun veg har ra(n)gee haram savaariaa ||
verses.translation: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;

verses.original: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa lai baiThe kar paasaariaa ||
verses.translation: in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

verses.original: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: cheej karan man bhaavadhe har bujhan naahee haariaa ||
verses.translation: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar furamais khaiaa vekh mahalat maran visaariaa ||
verses.translation: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget about death.

verses.original: ਜਰੁ ਆਈ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jar aaiee joban haariaa ||17||
verses.translation: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je kar sootak ma(n)neeaai sabh tai sootak hoi ||
verses.translation: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gohe atai lakaRee a(n)dhar keeRaa hoi ||
verses.translation: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jete dhaane a(n)n ke jeeaa baajh na koi ||
verses.translation: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa paanee jeeau hai jit hariaa sabh koi ||
verses.translation: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.

verses.original: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sootak kiau kar rakheeaai sootak pavai rasoi ||
verses.translation: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sootak ev na utarai giaan utaare dhoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa sootak lobh hai jihavaa sootak kooR ||
verses.translation: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: akhee sootak vekhanaa par tria par dhan roop ||
verses.translation: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and his wealth.

verses.original: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੰਨਿ ਪੈ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)nee sootak ka(n)n pai laitabaaree khaeh ||
verses.translation: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਸਾ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ha(n)saa aadhamee badhe jam pur jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabho sootak bharam hai dhoojai lagai jai ||
verses.translation: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa hukam hai bhaanai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

verses.original: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: khaanaa peenaa pavitr hai dhiton rijak sa(n)baeh ||
verses.translation: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jin(h)ee gurmukh bujhiaa tin(h)aa sootak naeh ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vaddaa kar saalaaheeaai jis vich vaddeeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.

verses.original: ਸਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: seh mele taa nadharee aaieeaa ||
verses.translation: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaanaa taa man vasaieeaa ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar hukam masatak hath dhar vichahu maar kaddeeaa buriaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.

verses.original: ਸਹਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: seh tuThai nau nidh paieeaa ||18||
verses.translation: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa suchaa aap hoi suchai baiThaa aai ||
verses.translation: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.

verses.original: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭਿਟਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: suche agai rakhion koi na bhiTio jai ||
verses.translation: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.

verses.original: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਵਿਆ ਲਗਾ ਪੜਣਿ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: suchaa hoi kai jeviaa lagaa paRan salok ||
verses.translation: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.

verses.original: ਕੁਹਥੀ ਜਾਈ ਸਟਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: kuhathee jaiee saTiaa kis eh lagaa dhokh ||
verses.translation: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੂਣੁ ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n dhevataa paanee dhevataa baisa(n)tar dhevataa loon pa(n)javaa paiaa ghirat ||
verses.translation: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well; when the fifth thing, the ghee, is added,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa hoaa paak pavit ||
verses.translation: then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਗਡਿਆ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਤਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: paapee siau tan gaddiaa thukaa pieeaa tit ||
verses.translation: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that is is spat upon.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jit mukh naam na uoochareh bin naavai ras khaeh ||
verses.translation: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak evai jaaneeaai tit mukh thukaa paeh ||1||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੰਡਿ ਜੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਨਿੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)dd ja(n)meeaai bha(n)dd ni(n)meeaai bha(n)dd ma(n)gan veeaahu ||
verses.translation: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engaged and married.

verses.original: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)ddahu hovai dhosatee bha(n)ddahu chalai raahu ||
verses.translation: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.

verses.original: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)dd muaa bha(n)dd bhaaleeaai bha(n)dd hovai ba(n)dhaan ||
verses.translation: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau ma(n)dhaa aakheeaai jit ja(n)meh raajaan ||
verses.translation: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

verses.original: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)ddahu hee bha(n)dd uoopajai bha(n)ddai baajh na koi ||
verses.translation: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bha(n)ddai baaharaa eko sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jit mukh sadhaa saalaaheeaai bhaagaa ratee chaar ||
verses.translation: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak te mukh uoojale tit sachai dharabaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa jis naahee so chun kaddeeaai ||
verses.translation: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਸੰਢੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa aapo aapanaa aape hee lekhaa sa(n)ddeeaai ||
verses.translation: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਹੰਢੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa rahanaa naahee aait jag taa kait gaarab ha(n)ddeeaai ||
verses.translation: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himself in pride?

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kisai na aakheeaai paR akhar eho bujheeaai ||
verses.translation: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲੁਝੀਐ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: moorakhai naal na lujheeaai ||19||
verses.translation: Don't argue with fools. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਕੈ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak fikai boliaai tan man fikaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.

verses.original: ਫਿਕੋ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਦੀਐ ਫਿਕੇ ਫਿਕੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: fiko fikaa sadheeaai fike fikee soi ||
verses.translation: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is his reputation.

verses.original: ਫਿਕਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਟੀਐ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਫਿਕੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fikaa dharageh saTeeaai muh thukaa fike pai ||
verses.translation: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.

verses.original: ਫਿਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਾਣਾ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fikaa moorakh aakheeaai paanaa lahai sajai ||1||
verses.translation: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu jhooThe paij baahar dhuneeaa a(n)dhar fail ||
verses.translation: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in this world.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath je naaveh utarai naahee mail ||
verses.translation: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, their filth does not depart.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਪਟੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗੁਦੜੁ ਤੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) paT a(n)dhar baahar gudhaR te bhale sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in this world.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੇਖਨੑੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) neh lagaa rab setee dhekhan(h)e veechaar ||
verses.translation: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਚੁਪ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g haseh ra(n)g roveh chup bhee kar jaeh ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keep silent.

verses.original: ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: paravaeh naahee kisai keree baajh sache naeh ||
verses.translation: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਉਪਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਬੈ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhar vaaT upar kharach ma(n)gaa jabai dhei ta khaeh ||
verses.translation: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.

verses.original: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਕਲਮ ਏਕਾ ਹਮਾ ਤੁਮੑਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheebaan eko kalam ekaa hamaa tum(h)aa mel ||
verses.translation: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shall meet.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਲਏ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੀੜਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhar le lekhaa peeR chhuTai naanakaa jiau tel ||2||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners are crushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਓ ਕਲ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee karanaa keeo kal aape hee tai dhaareeaai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhekheh keetaa aapanaa dhar kachee pakee saareeaai ||
verses.translation: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo aaiaa so chalasee sabh koiee aaiee vaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke jeea paraan heh kiau saahib manahu visaareeaai ||
verses.translation: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: aapan hathee aapanaa aape hee kaaj savaareeaai ||20||
verses.translation: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh kinehee aasakee dhoojai lagai jai ||
verses.translation: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aasak kaa(n)ddeeaai sadh hee rahai samai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.

verses.original: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa kar ma(n)ne ma(n)dhai ma(n)dhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when things go badly

verses.original: ਆਸਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aasak eh na aakheeaai j lekhai varatai soi ||1||
verses.translation: - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਲਾਮੁ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: salaam jabaab dhovai kare mu(n)ddahu ghuthaa jai ||
verses.translation: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gone wrong from the very beginning.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhovai kooReeaa thai na kaiee pai ||2||
