verses.translation: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai sukh paieeaai so saahib sadhaa sam(h)aaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਘਾਲ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jit keetaa paieeaai aapanaa saa ghaal buree kiau ghaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa mool na keechiee dhe la(n)mee nadhar nihaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤੇਵੇਹਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jiau saahib naal na haareeaai tevehaa paasaa ddaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: kichh laahe upar ghaaleeaai ||21||
verses.translation: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaakar lagai chaakaree naale gaarab vaadh ||
verses.translation: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,

verses.original: ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: galaa kare ghanereeaa khasam na paae saadh ||
verses.translation: he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap gavai sevaa kare taa kichh paae maan ||
verses.translation: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and then performs service, he shall be honored.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਗਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so paravaan ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jeei hoi su ugavai muh kaa kahiaa vaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.

verses.original: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: beeje bikh ma(n)gai a(n)mrit vekhahu eh niaau ||2||
verses.translation: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice is this? ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naal iaane dhosatee kadhe na aavai raas ||
verses.translation: Friendship with a fool never works out right.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa jaanai teho varatai vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
verses.translation: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.

verses.original: ਵਸਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: vasatoo a(n)dhar vasat samaavai dhoojee hovai paas ||
verses.translation: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saahib setee hukam na chalai kahee banai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kooR kamaanai kooRo hovai naanak sifat vigaas ||3||
verses.translation: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵਡਾਰੂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: naal iaane dhosatee vaddaaroo siau neh ||
verses.translation: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: paanee a(n)dhar leek jiau tis dhaa thaau na theh ||4||
verses.translation: are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ਕਰੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਆਣਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoi iaanaa kare ka(n)m aan na sakai raas ||
verses.translation: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਅਧ ਚੰਗੀ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਭੀ ਵੇਰਾਸਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je ik adh cha(n)gee kare dhoojee bhee veraas ||5||
verses.translation: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaakar lagai chaakaree je chalai khasamai bhai ||
verses.translation: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,

verses.original: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: huramat tis no agalee oh vajahu bh dhoonaa khai ||
verses.translation: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗੈਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai kare baraabaree fir gairat a(n)dhar pai ||
verses.translation: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.

verses.original: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਗਲਾ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vajahu gavaae agalaa muhe muh paanaa khai ||
verses.translation: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa dhitaa khaavanaa tis kaheeaai saabaas ||
verses.translation: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮ ਚਲੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na chaliee naal khasam chalai aradhaas ||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: eh kinehee dhaat aapas te jo paieeaai ||
verses.translation: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saa karamaat saahib tuThai jo milai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਉ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh kinehee chaakaree jit bhau khasam na jai ||
verses.translation: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sevak kaaddeeaai j setee khasam samai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)t na jaapan(h)ee har taa ke paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae saakhatee fir aap karaae maar ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ ਇਕਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਹਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa galee ja(n)jeereeaa ik turee chaReh biseeaar ||
verses.translation: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siau karee pukaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak karanaa jin keeaa fir tis hee karanee saar ||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhaa(n)dde saajian aape pooran dhei ||
verses.translation: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਇਕਿ ਚੁਲੑੈ ਰਹਨਿੑ ਚੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)ee dhudh samaieeaai ik chul(h)ai rahani(h) chaRe ||
verses.translation: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੈ ਸਵਨਿੑ ਇਕਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik nihaalee pai savani(h) ik upar rahan khaRe ||
verses.translation: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h)aa savaare naanakaa jin(h) kau nadhar kare ||1||
verses.translation: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਈ ਭਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape saaje kare aap jaiee bh rakhai aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich ja(n)t upai kai dhekhai thaap uthaap ||
verses.translation: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai naanakaa sabh kichh aape aap ||2||
verses.translation: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vadde keeaa vaddiaaieeaa kichh kahanaa kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰੀਮੁ ਦੇ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: so karataa kaadhar kareem dhe jeeaa rijak sa(n)baeh ||
verses.translation: He is the Creator, all-powerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਤਿੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saiee kaar kamaavanee dhur chhoddee ti(n)nai pai ||
verses.translation: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ekee baaharee hor dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: so kare j tisai rajai ||24||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) guraprasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa baanee bhagataa kee ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jeeau naamadheau jeeau ravidhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ਪੂਛਤ ਕਹ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan laag ham binavataa poochhat keh jeeau paiaa ||
verses.translation: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, ""Why was man created?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kavan kaaj jag upajai binasai kahahu moh samajhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand.""||1||

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhev karahu dhiaa moh maarag laavahu jit bhai ba(n)dhan tooTai ||
verses.translation: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by which the bonds of fear may be cut away.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫੇੜ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਨਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh feR karam sukh jeea janam te chhooTai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes when the soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਫਾਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਲੂਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa faas ba(n)dh nahee faarai ar man su(n)n na looke ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does not seek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਭਿਉ ਨ ਚੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aapaa padh nirabaan na cheeni(h)aa in bidh abhiau na chooke ||2||
verses.translation: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubt does not depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੀ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਬਿਹੂਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahee na upajai upajee jaanai bhaav abhaav bihoonaa ||
verses.translation: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.

verses.original: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: audhai asat kee man budh naasee tau sadhaa sahaj liv leenaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantly absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ ਉਦਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਬਿਗਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau pratibi(n)b bi(n)b kau milee hai udhak ku(n)bh bigaraanaa ||
verses.translation: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer aaisaa gun bhram bhaagaa tau man su(n)n samaanaa(n) ||4||1||
verses.translation: says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ ਤਿਹਰੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਤਗ ॥
verses.translit: gaj saadde tai tai dhoteeaa tihare pain tag ||
verses.translation: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.

verses.original: ਗਲੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀਆ ਲੋਟੇ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬਗ ॥
verses.translit: galee jin(h)aa japamaaleeaa loTe hath nibag ||
verses.translation: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oi har ke sa(n)t na aakhe'eeh baanaaras ke Thag ||1||
verses.translation: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaise sa(n)t na mo kau bhaaveh ||
verses.translation: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;

verses.original: ਡਾਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਪੇਡਾ ਗਟਕਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ddaalaa siau peddaa gaTakaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਂਜਿ ਚਰਾਵਹਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਠੀ ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: baasan maa(n)j charaaveh uoopar kaaThee dhoi jalaaveh ||
verses.translation: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash the wood before lighting it.

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੇੑ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: basudhaa khodh kareh dhui choole(h) saare maanas khaaveh ||2||
verses.translation: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi paapee sadhaa fireh aparaadhee mukhahu aparas kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch-nothing saints.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਡੁਬਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa fireh abhimaanee sagal kuTa(n)b ddubaaveh ||3||
verses.translation: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families are drowned. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaavai ||
verses.translation: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jis satigur bheTai punarap janam na aavai ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਬਾਪਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: baap dhilaasaa mero keen(h)aa || sej sukhaalee mukh a(n)mrit dheen(h)aa ||
verses.translation: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed, and placed His Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis baap kau kiau manahu visaaree ||
verses.translation: How could I forget that Father from my mind?

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aagai giaa na baajee haaree ||1||
verses.translation: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: muiee meree maiee hau kharaa sukhaalaa ||
verses.translation: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰਉ ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pahirau nahee dhagalee lagai na paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bal tis baapai jin hau jaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.

verses.original: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)chaa te meraa sa(n)g chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਾ ਤਲਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch maar paavaa tal dheene ||
verses.translation: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har simaran meraa man tan bheene ||2||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਵਡ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa hamaaro vadd gosaiee ||
verses.translation: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਹਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis pitaa peh hau kiau kar jaiee ||
verses.translation: How shall I go to that Father?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mile ta maarag dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.

verses.original: ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jagat pitaa merai man bhaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau poot teraa too(n) baap meraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your son, and You are my Father.

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਠਾਹਰ ਦੁਹਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekai Thaahar dhuhaa baseraa ||
verses.translation: We both dwell in the same place.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jan eko boojhiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh mai sabh kichh soojhiaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਉਰਕਟ ਕੁਰਕਟ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: eikat patar bhar urakaT kurakaT ikat patar bhar paanee ||
verses.translation: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.

verses.original: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਚਿ ਨਕਟ ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas paas pa(n)ch jogeeaa baiThe beech nakaT dhe raanee ||1||
verses.translation: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one, the shameless queen. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਕਟੀ ਕੋ ਠਨਗਨੁ ਬਾਡਾ ਡੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: nakaTee ko Thanagan baaddaa ddoo(n) ||
verses.translation: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kineh bibekee kaaTee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਕਟੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal maeh nakaTee kaa vaasaa sagal maar aauheree ||
verses.translation: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.

verses.original: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਹਿਨ ਭਾਨਜੀ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sagaliaa kee hau bahin bhaanajee jineh baree tis cheree ||2||
verses.translation: She says, ""I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me.""||2||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hamaro bharataa baddo bibekee aape sa(n)t kahaavai ||
verses.translation: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਕਾਇਮੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oh hamaarai maathai kaim aaur hamarai nikaT na aavai ||3||
verses.translation: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਕਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਨਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naakahu kaaTee kaanahu kaaTee kaaT kooT kai ddaaree ||
verses.translation: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelled her.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਰਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer sa(n)tan kee bairan teen lok kee piaaree ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jogee jatee tapee sa(n)niaasee bahu teerath bhramanaa ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacred places.

verses.original: ਲੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਟਾਧਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lu(n)jit mu(n)jit mon jaTaadhar a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in the end, they all shall die. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੇਵੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa te seveeale raamanaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਰਗਮ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਆਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagam niragam jotik jaaneh bahu bahu biaakaranaa ||
verses.translation: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages;

verses.original: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t ma(n)tr sabh aaukhadh jaaneh a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||2||
verses.translation: those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਰਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raaj bhog ar chhatr si(n)ghaasan bahu su(n)dhar ramanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautiful women,

verses.original: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੁਬਾਸਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paan kapoor subaasak cha(n)dhan a(n)t tuoo maranaa ||3||
verses.translation: betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan si(n)mirat sabh khoje kahoo na uoobaranaa ||
verses.translation: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can save anyone.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜੰਪਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer iau raameh ja(n)pau meT janam maranaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਕਊਆ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: feel rabaabee baladh pakhaavaj kuooaa taal bajaavai ||
verses.translation: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays the cymbals.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਗਦਹਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pahir cholanaa gadhahaa naachai bhaisaa bhagat karaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performs devotional worship. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਕਰੀਆ ਬਰੇ ਪਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam kakareeaa bare pakaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,

verses.original: ਕਿਨੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੈ ਖਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kinai boojhanahaarai khaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੈਠਿ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ ਗਲਉਰੇ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baiTh si(n)gh ghar paan lagaavai ghees galaure liaavai ||
verses.translation: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betel nuts.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਛੂਆ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar musaree ma(n)gal gaaveh kachhooaa sa(n)kh bajaavai ||2||
verses.translation: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows on the conch-shell. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)s ko poot beeaahan chaliaa suine ma(n)ddap chhaae ||
verses.translation: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spread out for him.

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: roop ka(n)niaa su(n)dhar bedhee sasai si(n)gh gun gaae ||3||
verses.translation: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu keeTee parabat khaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.

verses.original: ਕਛੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ ਭਿ ਲੋਰਉ ਲੂਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: kachhooaa kahai a(n)gaar bh lorau lookee sabadh sunaiaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: The turtle says, ""I need a burning coal, also."" Listen to this mystery of the Shabad. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਬਟੂਆ ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baTooaa ek bahatar aadhaaree eko jiseh dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: navai kha(n)dd kee pirathamee maagai so jogee jag saaraa ||1||
verses.translation: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nine regions. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa jogee nau nidh paavai ||
verses.translation: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੇ ਗਗਨਿ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tal kaa braham le gagan charaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਮਥਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)thaa giaan dhiaan kar sooiee sabadh taagaa math ghaalai ||
verses.translation: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists the thread of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat kee kar miragaanee gur kai maarag chaalai ||2||
verses.translation: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਧੂਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa faahuree kaiaa kar dhooiee dhirasaT kee agan jalaavai ||
verses.translation: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis kaa bhaau le ridh a(n)tar chahu jug taaRee laavai ||3||
verses.translation: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout the four ages. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jogatan raam naam hai jis kaa pi(n)dd paraanaa ||
verses.translation: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer je kirapaa dhaarai dhei sachaa neesaanaa ||4||7||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo turak kahaa te aae kin eh raeh chalaiee ||
verses.translation: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their different paths?

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਵਾਦੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਦੋਜਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhil meh soch bichaar kavaadhe bhisat dhojak kin paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who will go to heaven and hell? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee tai kavan kateb bakhaanee ||
verses.translation: O Qazi, which book have you read?

verses.original: ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਗੁਨਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paRhat gunat aaise sabh maare kinahoo(n) khabar na jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਕਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਦਉਗਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sakat saneh kar su(n)nat kareeaai mai na badhaugaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕਰੈਗਾ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jau re khudhai moh turak karaigaa aapan hee kaT jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕੀਏ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਅਉਰਤ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)nat ke'ee turak je hoigaa aaurat kaa kiaa kareeaai ||
verses.translation: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?

verses.original: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹੀ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aradh sareeree naar na chhoddai taa te hi(n)dhoo hee raheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu. ||3||

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੁਲਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd kateb raam bhaj baure julam karat hai bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressing others so badly.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਪਕਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਰਕ ਰਹੇ ਪਚਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: kabeerai pakaree Tek raam kee turak rahe pachihaaree ||4||8||
verses.translation: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਤੀ ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag tel dheeve mukh baatee tab soojhai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated.

verses.original: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ ਠਹਰਾਨੀ ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tel jale baatee Thaharaanee soo(n)naa ma(n)dhar hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: re baure tuh gharee na raakhai koiee ||
verses.translation: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) raam naam jap soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaa kee maat pitaa kahu kaa ko kavan purakh kee joiee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?

verses.original: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT fooTe kouoo baat na poochhai kaaddahu kaaddahu hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, ""Take him away, take him away!""||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhehuree baiThee maataa rovai khaTeeaa le ge bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.

verses.original: ਲਟ ਛਿਟਕਾਏ ਤਿਰੀਆ ਰੋਵੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: laT chhiTakaae tireeaa rovai ha(n)s ikelaa jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs all alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu bhai saagar kai taiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: eis ba(n)dhe sir julam hot hai jam nahee haTai gusaiee ||4||9||
verses.translation: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, O Lord of the World. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
verses.translit: dhutuke
verses.translation: Dho-Thukay

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke chaupadhe ikatuke ||
verses.translation: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padhay, Ek-Thukay:

verses.original: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sanak sana(n)dh a(n)t nahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bedh paRe paR brahame janam gavaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj bilovahu jaise tat na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tan kar maTukee man maeh biloiee ||
verses.translation: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eis maTukee meh sabadh sa(n)joiee ||2||
verses.translation: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh paavai a(n)mirat dhaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਂੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer nadhar kare je ma(n)eeraa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: raam naam lag utare teeraa ||4||1||10||
verses.translation: one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਬਾਤੀ ਸੂਕੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਿਖੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: baatee sookee tel nikhooTaa ||
verses.translation: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਲੁ ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhal na baajai naT pai sootaa ||1||
verses.translation: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਧੂੰਆ ॥
verses.translit: bujh giee agan na nikasio dhoo(n)aa ||
verses.translation: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa ek avar nahee dhooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਟੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
verses.translit: TooTee ta(n)t na bajai rabaab ||
verses.translation: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhool bigaario apanaa kaaj ||2||
verses.translation: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥ ਸਮਝਿ ਪਰੀ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee kahan kahaavan || samajh paree tau bisario gaavan ||3||
verses.translation: When one comes to understand, he forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਜੋ ਚੂਰੇ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch jo choore || tin te naeh param padh dhoore ||4||2||11||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far from those who conquer the five demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਸੁਤੁ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sut aparaadh karat hai jete ||
verses.translation: As many mistakes as the son commits,

verses.original: ਜਨਨੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਤੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jananee cheet na raakhas tete ||1||
verses.translation: his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਈਆ ਹਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raamieeaa hau baarik teraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I am Your child.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਖੰਡਸਿ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe na kha(n)ddas avagan meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: je at karop kare kar dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: If the son, in anger, runs away,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa bhee cheet na raakhas maiaa ||2||
verses.translation: even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤ ਭਵਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)t bhavan man pario hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kaise utaras paaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheh bimal mat sadhaa sareeraa ||
verses.translation: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj sahaj gun ravai kabeeraa ||4||3||12||
verses.translation: in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਹਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਤੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: haj hamaaree gomatee teer ||
verses.translation: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jahaa baseh peeta(n)bar peer ||1||
verses.translation: the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੂਬੁ ਗਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu kiaa khoob gaavataa hai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam merai man bhaavataa hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: naaradh saaradh kareh khavaasee ||
verses.translation: Naarada the sage, and Shaarada the goddess of knowledge, serve the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਬੀਬੀ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paas baiThee beebee kavalaa dhaasee ||2||
verses.translation: The goddess Lakhshmi sits by Him as His slave. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੰਠੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)The maalaa jihavaa raam ||
verses.translation: The mala is around my neck, and the Lord's Name is upon my tongue.

verses.original: ਸਹੰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਰਉ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saha(n)s naam lai lai karau salaam ||3||
verses.translation: I repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a thousand times, and bow in reverence to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer raam gun gaavau ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo turak dhouoo samajhaavau ||4||4||13||
verses.translation: I teach both Hindus and Muslims. ||4||4||13||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ੯ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੫
verses.translit: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke pa(n)chapadhe 9 dhutuke 5
verses.translation: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee, 9 Panch-Padhay, 5 Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਮਾਲਿਨੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: paatee torai maalinee paatee paatee jeeau ||
verses.translation: You tear off the leaves, O gardener, but in each and every leaf, there is life.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਹਨ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis paahan kau paatee torai so paahan nirajeeau ||1||
verses.translation: That stone idol, for which you tear off those leaves - that stone idol is lifeless. ||1||

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਮਾਲਨੀ ਹੈ ਏਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee maalanee hai eau ||
verses.translation: In this, you are mistaken, O gardener.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jaagataa hai dheau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Living Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਾਤੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਡਾਰੀ ਫੂਲ ਸੰਕਰਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: braham paatee bisan ddaaree fool sa(n)karadheau ||
verses.translation: Brahma is in the leaves, Vishnu is in the branches, and Shiva is in the flowers.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਤੋਰਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teen dhev pratakh toreh kareh kis kee seau ||2||
verses.translation: When you break these three gods, whose service are you performing? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਖਾਨ ਗਢਿ ਕੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਛਾਤੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paakhaan gadd kai moorat keen(h)ee dhe kai chhaatee paau ||
verses.translation: The sculptor carves the stone and fashions it into an idol, placing his feet upon its chest.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਏਹ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਗੜ੍ਹਣਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je eh moorat saachee hai tau gaRhanahaare khaau ||3||
verses.translation: If this stone god was true, it would devour the sculptor for this! ||3||

verses.original: ਭਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਕਰਾ ਕਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaat pahit ar laapasee karakaraa kaasaar ||
verses.translation: Rice and beans, candies, cakes and cookies

verses.original: ਭੋਗਨਹਾਰੇ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhoganahaare bhogiaa is moorat ke mukh chhaar ||4||
verses.translation: - the priest enjoys these, while he puts ashes into the mouth of the idol. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਲਿਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maalin bhoolee jag bhulaanaa ham bhulaane naeh ||
verses.translation: The gardener is mistaken, and the world is mistaken, but I am not mistaken.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ham raam raakhe kirapaa kar har rai ||5||1||14||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord preserves me; the Lord, my King, has showered His Blessings upon me. ||5||1||14||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਬਰਸ ਬਾਲਪਨ ਬੀਤੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: baareh baras baalapan beete bees baras kachh tap na keeo ||
verses.translation: Twelve years pass in childhood, and for another twenty years, he does not practice self-discipline and austerity.

verses.original: ਤੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tees baras kachh dhev na poojaa fir pachhutaanaa biradh bhio ||1||
verses.translation: For another thirty years, he does not worship God in any way, and then, when he is old, he repents and regrets. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree karate janam gio ||
verses.translation: His life wastes away as he cries out, ""Mine, mine!""

verses.original: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੋਖਿ ਭੁਜੰ ਬਲਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sair sokh bhuja(n) balio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The pool of his power has dried up. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੂਕੇ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਲੂਣੈ ਖੇਤਿ ਹਥ ਵਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sooke saravar paal ba(n)dhaavai loonai khet hath vaar karai ||
verses.translation: He makes a dam around the dried-up pool, and with his hands, he makes a fence around the harvested field.

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਤੁਰੰਤਹ ਲੇ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਤ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਫਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaio chor tura(n)teh le gio meree raakhat mugadh firai ||2||
verses.translation: When the thief of Death comes, he quickly carries away what the fool had tried to preserve as his own. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਅਸਾਰ ਬਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan sees kar ka(n)pan laage nainee neer asaar bahai ||
verses.translation: His feet and head and hands begin to tremble, and the tears flow copiously from his eyes.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਬ ਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jihavaa bachan sudh nahee nikasai tab re dharam kee aas karai ||3||
verses.translation: His tongue has not spoken the correct words, but now, he hopes to practice religion! ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa karai liv laavai laahaa har har naam leeo ||
verses.translation: If the Dear Lord shows His Mercy, one enshrines love for Him, and obtains the Profit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅੰਤੇ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har dhan paio a(n)te chaladhiaa naal chalio ||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he receives the wealth of the Lord's Name, which alone shall go with him, when he departs in the end. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਛੂਐ ਲੈ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu an dhan kachhooaai lai na gio ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - he shall not take any other wealth with him.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਤਲਬ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aaiee talab gopaal rai kee maiaa ma(n)dhar chhodd chalio ||5||2||15||
verses.translation: When the summons comes from the King, the Lord of the Universe, the mortal departs, leaving behind his wealth and mansions. ||5||2||15||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਲਘ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo dheen(h)e paaT paTa(n)bar kaahoo palagh nivaaraa ||
verses.translation: To some, the Lord has given silks and satins, and to some, beds decorated with cotton ribbons.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਗਰੀ ਗੋਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਖਾਨ ਪਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaahoo garee godharee naahee kaahoo khaan paraaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Some do not even have a poor patched coat, and some live in thatched huts. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਰਖ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥
verses.translit: ahirakh vaadh na keejai re man ||
verses.translation: Do not indulge in envy and bickering, O my mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukirat kar kar leejai re man ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By continually doing good deeds, these are obtained, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਜੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੂੰਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਨੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kum(h)aarai ek ju maaTee goo(n)dhee bahu bidh baanee laiee ||
verses.translation: The potter works the same clay, and colors the pots in different ways.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaahoo meh motee mukataahal kaahoo biaadh lagaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Into some, he sets pearls, while to others, he attaches filth. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਮਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: soomeh dhan raakhan kau dheeaa mugadh kahai dhan meraa ||
verses.translation: God gave wealth to the miser for him to preserve, but the fool calls it his own.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jam kaa dda(n)dd moo(n)dd meh laagai khin meh karai niberaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jan uootam bhagat sadhaavai aagiaa man sukh paiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command of the Lord's Order, and obtains peace.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai sat kar maanai bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu meree meree jhooThee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, ""Mine, mine.""

verses.original: ਚਿਰਗਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਚਟਾਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਓ ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: chiragaT faar chaTaaraa lai gio taree taagaree chhooTee ||5||3||16||
verses.translation: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain. ||5||3||16||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ham masakeen khudhaiee ba(n)dhe tum raajas man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਅਲਹ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aleh aval dheen ko saahib jor nahee furamaavai ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they should be oppressed. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਬਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee boliaa ban nahee aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: rojaa dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalamaa bhisat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed, shall not take you to paradise.

verses.original: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾਬਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satar kaabaa ghaT hee bheetar je kar jaanai koiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Temple of Mecca is hidden within your mind, if you only knew it. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਨਿਆਉ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਅਕਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: nivaaj soiee jo niaau bichaarai kalamaa akaleh jaanai ||
verses.translation: That should be your prayer, to administer justice. Let your Kalma be the knowledge of the unknowable Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਚਹੁ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਤਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paachahu mus musalaa bichhaavai tab tau dheen pachhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: Spread your prayer mat by conquering your five desires, and you shall recognize the true religion. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ਤਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: khasam pachhaan taras kar jeea meh maar manee kar feekee ||
verses.translation: Recognize Your Lord and Master, and fear Him within your heart; conquer your egotism, and make it worthless.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਜਨਾਇ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਿਸਤ ਸਰੀਕੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aap janai avar kau jaanai tab hoi bhisat sareekee ||4||
verses.translation: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner in heaven. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਭੇਖ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee ek bhekh dhar naanaa taa meh braham pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: The clay is one, but it has taken many forms; I recognize the One Lord within them all.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਭਿਸਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੪॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeeraa bhisat chhodd kar dhojak siau man maanaa ||5||4||17||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have abandoned paradise, and reconciled my mind to hell. ||5||4||17||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਬਰਖੈ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gagan nagar ik boo(n)dh na barakhai naadh kahaa ju samaanaa ||
verses.translation: From the city of the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, not even a drop rains down. Where is the music of the sound current of the Naad, which was contained in it?

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਲੇ ਸਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesur maadho param ha(n)s le sidhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Master of wealth has taken away the Supreme Soul. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਗਏ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa bolate te kahaa ge dhehee ke sa(n)g rahate ||
verses.translation: O Father, tell me: where has it gone? It used to dwell within the body,

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਤੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਰਤਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: surat maeh jo nirate karate kathaa baarataa kahate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and dance in the mind, teaching and speaking. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: bajaavanahaaro kahaa gio jin ih ma(n)dhar keen(h)aa ||
verses.translation: Where has the player gone - he who made this temple his own?

verses.original: ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਲੀਨੑਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saakhee sabadh surat nahee upajai khi(n)ch tej sabh leen(h)aa ||2||
verses.translation: No story, word or understanding is produced; the Lord has drained off all the power. ||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sravanan bikal bhe sa(n)g tere i(n)dhree kaa bal thaakaa ||
verses.translation: The ears, your companions, have gone deaf, and the power of your organs is exhausted.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਢਰਕਿ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan rahe kar ddarak pare hai mukhahu na nikasai baataa ||3||
verses.translation: Your feet have failed, your hands have gone limp, and no words issue forth from your mouth. ||3||

verses.original: ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭ ਤਸਕਰ ਆਪ ਆਪਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: thaake pa(n)ch dhoot sabh tasakar aap aapanai bhramate ||
verses.translation: Having grown weary, the five enemies and all the thieves have wandered away according to their own will.

verses.original: ਥਾਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਉਰੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਧਰਿ ਰਮਤੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: thaakaa man ku(n)char ur thaakaa tej soot dhar ramate ||4||
verses.translation: The elephant of the mind has grown weary, and the heart has grown weary as well; through its power, it used to pull the strings. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਭਏ ਦਸੈ ਬੰਦ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mritak bhe dhasai ba(n)dh chhooTe mitr bhaiee sabh chhore ||
verses.translation: He is dead, and the bonds of the ten gates are opened; he has left all his friends and brothers.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeeraa jo har dhiaavai jeevat ba(n)dhan tore ||5||5||18||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who meditates on the Lord, breaks his bonds, even while yet alive. ||5||5||18||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ikatuke 4 ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, 4 Ek-Thukay:

verses.original: ਸਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarapanee te uoopar nahee baleeaa ||
verses.translation: No one is more powerful than the she-serpent Maya,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin brahamaa bisan mahaadheau chhaleeaa ||1||
verses.translation: who deceived even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਪੈਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: maar maar srapanee niramal jal paiThee ||
verses.translation: Having bitten and struck them down, she now sits in the immaculate waters.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਡਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin tirabhavan ddaseeale gur prasaadh ddeeThee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have seen her, who has bitten the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: srapanee srapanee kiaa kahahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, why is she called a she-serpent?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin saach pachhaaniaa tin srapanee khaiee ||2||
verses.translation: One who realizes the True Lord, devours the she-serpent. ||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਆਨ ਛੂਛ ਨਹੀ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: srapanee te aan chhoochh nahee avaraa ||
verses.translation: No one else is more frivolous than this she-serpent.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਜੀਤੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: srapanee jeetee kahaa karai jamaraa ||3||
verses.translation: When the she-serpent is overcome, what can the Messengers of the King of Death do? ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eeh srapanee taa kee keetee hoiee ||
verses.translation: This she-serpent is created by Him.

verses.original: ਬਲੁ ਅਬਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bal abal kiaa is te hoiee ||4||
verses.translation: What power or weakness does she have by herself? ||4||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਸਤੀ ਤਾ ਬਸਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eeh basatee taa basat sareeraa ||
verses.translation: If she abides with the mortal, then his soul abides in his body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਰੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh sahaj tare kabeeraa ||5||6||19||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Kabeer has easily crossed over. ||5||6||19||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa suaan kau simirat sunaae ||
verses.translation: Why bother to read the Simritees to a dog?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa saakat peh har gun gaae ||1||
verses.translation: Why bother to sing the Lord's Praises to the faithless cynic? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੇ ਰਮਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam raam rame ram raheeaai ||
verses.translation: Remain absorbed in the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਭੂਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saakat siau bhool nahee kaheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Do not bother to speak of it to the faithless cynic, even by mistake. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਊਆ ਕਹਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਚਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kuooaa kahaa kapoor charaae ||
verses.translation: Why offer camphor to a crow?

verses.original: ਕਹ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keh biseear kau dhoodh peeaae ||2||
verses.translation: Why give the snake milk to drink? ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil bibek budh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, discriminating understanding is attained.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paaras paras lohaa ka(n)chan soiee ||3||
verses.translation: That iron which touches the Philosopher's Stone becomes gold. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saakat suaan sabh kare karaiaa ||
verses.translation: The dog, the faithless cynic, does everything as the Lord causes him to do.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: He does the deeds pre-ordained from the very beginning. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਨੀਮੁ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit lai lai neem si(n)chaiee ||
verses.translation: If you take Ambrosial Nectar and irrigate the neem tree with it,

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੭॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer uaa ko sahaj na jaiee ||5||7||20||
verses.translation: still, says Kabeer, its natural qualities are not changed. ||5||7||20||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਲੰਕਾ ਸਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)kaa saa koT samu(n)dh see khaiee ||
verses.translation: A fortress like that of Sri Lanka, with the ocean as a moat around it

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teh raavan ghar khabar na paiee ||1||
verses.translation: - there is no news about that house of Raavan. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaiee ||
verses.translation: What shall I ask for? Nothing is permanent.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhat nain chalio jag jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I see with my eyes that the world is passing away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਨਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik lakh poot savaa lakh naatee ||
verses.translation: Thousands of sons and thousands of grandsons

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਬਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teh raavan ghar dheeaa na baatee ||2||
verses.translation: - but in that house of Raavan, the lamps and wicks have gone out. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj jaa ke tapat rasoiee ||
verses.translation: The moon and the sun cooked his food.

verses.original: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਧੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baisa(n)tar jaa ke kapare dhoiee ||3||
verses.translation: The fire washed his clothes. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat raamai naam basaiee ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instructions, one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: asathir rahai na katahoo(n) jaiee ||4||
verses.translation: becomes permanent, and does not go anywhere. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re loiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, people:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੮॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee ||5||8||21||
verses.translation: without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated. ||5||8||21||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਛੈਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa poot pichhairee maiee ||
verses.translation: First, the son was born, and then, his mother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਚੇਲੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur laago chele kee paiee ||1||
verses.translation: The guru falls at the feet of the disciple. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek acha(n)bhau sunahu tum(h) bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Listen to this wonderful thing, O Siblings of Destiny!

verses.original: ਦੇਖਤ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhat si(n)gh charaavat gaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I saw the lion herding the cows. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਬਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jal kee machhulee taravar biaaiee ||
verses.translation: The fish of the water gives birth upon a tree.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਤ ਕੁਤਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhekhat kutaraa lai giee bilaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I saw a cat carrying away a dog. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਲੈ ਰੇ ਬੈਸਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: talai re baisaa uoopar soolaa ||
verses.translation: The branches are below, and the roots are above.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੇ ਫਲ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis kai pedd lage fal foolaa ||3||
verses.translation: The trunk of that tree bears fruits and flowers. ||3||

verses.original: ਘੋਰੈ ਚਰਿ ਭੈਸ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghorai char bhais charaavan jaiee ||
verses.translation: Riding a horse, the buffalo takes him out to graze.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਗੋਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: baahar bail gon ghar aaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The bull is away, while his load has come home. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁ ਇਸ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer ju is padh boojhai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who understands this hymn,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੫॥੯॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: raam ramat tis sabh kichh soojhai ||5||9||22||
verses.translation: and chants the Lord's Name, comes to understand everything. ||5||9||22||

verses.original: ਬਾਈਸ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਤਥਾ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੮ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੭ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ੧
verses.translit: baiees chaupadhe tathaa pa(n)chapadhe aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke tipadhe 8 dhutuke 7 ikatukaa 1
verses.translation: 22 Chau-Padhay And Panch-Padhay, Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, 8 Thri-Padhay, 7 Dho-Thukay, 1 Ik-Tuka:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dh te jin pi(n)dd keeaa agan ku(n)dd rahaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord created the body from sperm, and protected it in the fire pit.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhas maas maataa udhar raakhiaa bahur laagee maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: For ten months He preserved you in your mother's womb, and then, after you were born, you became attached to Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: praanee kaahe kau lobh laage ratan janam khoiaa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, why have you attached yourself to greed, and lost the jewel of life?

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorab janam karam bhoom beej naahee boiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You did not plant the seeds of good actions in the earth of your past lives. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਹੋਨਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baarik te biradh bhiaa honaa so hoiaa ||
verses.translation: From an infant, you have grown old. That which was to happen, has happened.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਝੋਟ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਬਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa jam aai jhoT pakarai tabeh kaahe roiaa ||2||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by your hair, why do you cry out then? ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨੈ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevanai kee aas kareh jam nihaarai saasaa ||
verses.translation: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਚੇਤਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: baajeegaree sa(n)saar kabeeraa chet ddaal paasaa ||3||1||23||
verses.translation: The world is a game, O Kabeer, so throw the dice consciously. ||3||1||23||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਪੁਨ ਰਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉ ਪਾਚਉ ਤਤ ਬਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: tan rainee man pun rap kar hau paachau tat baraatee ||
verses.translation: I make my body the dying vat, and within it, I dye my mind. I make the five elements my marriage guests.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਵਰਿ ਲੈਹਉ ਆਤਮ ਤਿਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam rai siau bhaavar laihau aatam teh ra(n)g raatee ||1||
verses.translation: I take my marriage vows with the Lord, my King; my soul is imbued with His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਾਉ ਗਾਉ ਰੀ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaau gaau ree dhulahanee ma(n)galachaaraa ||
verses.translation: Sing, sing, O brides of the Lord, the marriage songs of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere gireh aae raajaa raam bhataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my King, has come to my house as my Husband. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੀ ਰਚਿ ਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naabh kamal meh bedhee rach le braham giaan uchaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the lotus of my heart, I have made my bridal pavilion, and I have spoken the wisdom of God.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਦੂਲਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਸ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam rai so dhoolahu paio as baddabhaag hamaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Lord King as my Husband - such is my great good fortune. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਉਤਕ ਆਏ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan kautak aae koT tetees ujaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: The angles, holy men, silent sages, and the 330,000,000 deities have come in their heavenly chariots to see this spectacle.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਹਿ ਚਲੇ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਖ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੨॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer moh biaaeh chale hai purakh ek bhagavaanaa ||3||2||24||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have been taken in marriage by the One Supreme Being, the Lord God. ||3||2||24||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੇਠ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਡਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas kee dhukhee sasur kee piaaree jeTh ke naam ddarau re ||
verses.translation: I am bothered by my mother-in-law, Maya, and loved by my father-in-law, the Lord. I fear even the name of my husband's elder brother, Death.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਨਦ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee nanadh gahelee dhevar kai bireh jarau re ||1||
verses.translation: O my mates and companions, my husband's sister, misunderstanding has seized me, and I am burning with the pain of separation from my husband's younger brother, divine knowledge. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਬਉਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਰਹਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: meree mat bauree mai raam bisaario kin bidh rahan rahau re ||
verses.translation: My mind has gone insane, since I forgot the Lord. How can I lead a virtuous lifestyle?

verses.original: ਸੇਜੈ ਰਮਤੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਉ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾ ਸਉ ਕਹਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sejai ramat nain nahee pekhau ih dhukh kaa sau kahau re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He rests in the bed of my mind, but I cannot see Him with my eyes. Unto whom should I tell my sufferings? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਪੁ ਸਾਵਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਰਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਦ ਮਤਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: baap saavakaa karai laraiee maiaa sadh matavaaree ||
verses.translation: My step-father, egotism, fights with me, and my mother, desire, is always intoxicated.

verses.original: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ਜਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: badde bhaiee kai jab sa(n)g hotee tab hau naeh piaaree ||2||
verses.translation: When I stayed with my elder brother, meditation, then I was loved by my Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਝਗਰਾ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer pa(n)ch ko jhagaraa jhagarat janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the five passions argue with me, and in these arguments, my life is wasting away.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: jhooThee maiaa sabh jag baadhiaa mai raam ramat sukh paiaa ||3||3||25||
verses.translation: The false Maya has bound the whole world, but I have obtained peace, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||3||3||25||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਨਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham ghar soot taneh nit taanaa ka(n)Th janeuoo tumaare ||
verses.translation: In my house, I constantly weave the thread, while you wear the thread around your neck, O Brahmin.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum(h) tau bedh paRahu gaitree gobi(n)dh ridhai hamaare ||1||
verses.translation: You read the Vedas and sacred hymns, while I have enshrined the Lord of the Universe in my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree jihabaa bisan nain naarain hiradhai baseh gobi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Upon my tongue, within my eyes, and within my heart, abides the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਬ ਪੂਛਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਸਿ ਮੁਕੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhuaar jab poochhas bavare tab kiaa kahas muka(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When you are interrogated at Death's door, O mad-man, what will you say then? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗੋਰੂ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਆਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham goroo tum guaar gusaiee janam janam rakhavaare ||
verses.translation: I am a cow, and You are the herdsman, the Sustainer of the World. You are my Saving Grace, lifetime after lifetime.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਚਰਾਇਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kabahoo(n) na paar utaar charaih kaise khasam hamaare ||2||
verses.translation: You have never taken me across to graze there - what sort of a herdsman are You? ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਬਾਮੑਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਮੋਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) baam(h)n mai kaaseek julahaa boojhahu mor giaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are a Brahmin, and I am a weaver of Benares; can You understand my wisdom?

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਜਾਚੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਮੋਰ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: tum(h) tau jaache bhoopat raaje har sau mor dhiaanaa ||3||4||26||
verses.translation: You beg from emperors and kings, while I meditate on the Lord. ||3||4||26||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: jag jeevan aaisaa supane jaisaa jeevan supan samaana(n) ||
verses.translation: The life of the world is only a dream; life is just a dream.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਠਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saach kar ham gaaTh dheenee chhodd param nidhaana(n) ||1||
verses.translation: Believing it to be true, I grasped at it, and abandoned the supreme treasure. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਤੁ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa maiaa moh hit keen(h) ||
verses.translation: O Father, I have enshrined love and affection for Maya,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin giaan ratan hir leen(h) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which has taken the jewel of spiritual wisdom away from me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਉਰਝੈ ਪਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: nain dhekh pata(n)g urajhai pas na dhekhai aag ||
verses.translation: The moth sees with its eyes, but it still becomes entangled; the insect does not see the fire.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaal faas na mugadh chetai kanik kaamin laag ||2||
verses.translation: Attached to gold and woman, the fool does not think of the noose of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar bichaar bikaar parahar taran taaran soi ||
verses.translation: Reflect upon this, and abandon sin; the Lord is a boat to carry you across.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥੫॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer jagajeevan aaisaa dhuteea naahee koi ||3||5||27||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, such is the Lord, the Life of the World; there is no one equal to Him. ||3||5||27||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਅਬ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jau mai roop ke'ee bahutere ab fun roop na hoiee ||
verses.translation: In the past, I have taken many forms, but I shall not take form again.

verses.original: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taagaa ta(n)t saaj sabh thaakaa raam naam bas hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: The strings and wires of the musical instrument are worn out, and I am in the power of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh naachano na aavai ||
verses.translation: Now, I no longer dance to the tune.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੀਆ ਨ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man ma(n)dhareeaa na bajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind no longer beats the drum. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਫੂਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa lai jaaree tirasanaa gaagar fooTee ||
verses.translation: I have burnt away sexual desire, anger and attachment to Maya, and the pitcher of my desires has burst.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam cholanaa bhiaa hai puraanaa giaa bharam sabh chhooTee ||2||
verses.translation: The gown of sensuous pleasures is worn out, and all my doubts have been dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab bhoot ekai kar jaaniaa chooke baadh bibaadhaa ||
verses.translation: I look upon all beings alike, and my conflict and strife are ended.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer mai pooraa paiaa bhe raam parasaadhaa ||3||6||28||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, when the Lord showed His Favor, I obtained Him, the Perfect One. ||3||6||28||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
