verses.translit: rojaa dharai manaavai alahu suaadhat jeea sa(n)ghaarai ||
verses.translation: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.

verses.original: ਆਪਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapaa dhekh avar nahee dhekhai kaahe kau jhakh maarai ||1||
verses.translation: You look after your own interests, and so not see the interests of others. What good is your word? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੋਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee saahib ek tohee meh teraa soch bichaar na dhekhai ||
verses.translation: O Qazi, the One Lord is within you, but you do not behold Him by thought or contemplation.

verses.original: ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khabar na kareh dheen ke baure taa te janam alekhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You do not care for others, you are a religious fanatic, and your life is of no account at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saach kateb bakhaanai alahu naar purakh nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: Your holy scriptures say that Allah is True, and that he is neither male nor female.

verses.original: ਪਢੇ ਗੁਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: padde gune naahee kachh baure jau dhil meh khabar na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: But you gain nothing by reading and studying, O mad-man, if you do not gain the understanding in your heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਲਹੁ ਗੈਬੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: alahu gaib sagal ghaT bheetar hiradhai leh bichaaree ||
verses.translation: Allah is hidden in every heart; reflect upon this in your mind.

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੭॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo turak dhuhoo(n) meh ekai kahai kabeer pukaaree ||3||7||29||
verses.translation: The One Lord is within both Hindu and Muslim; Kabeer proclaims this out loud. ||3||7||29||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥ ਤਿਪਦਾ ॥ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa || tipadhaa || ikatukaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Ti-Pada, Ik-Tuka:

verses.original: ਕੀਓ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੇ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keeo si(n)gaar milan ke taiee ||
verses.translation: I have decorated myself to meet my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har na mile jagajeevan gusaiee ||1||
verses.translation: But the Lord, the Life of the Word, the Sustainer of the Universe, has not come to meet me. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har mero pir hau har kee bahureeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Husband, and I am the Lord's bride.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਬਡੇ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam badde mai tanak lahureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is so great, and I am infinitesimally small. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਏਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir ekai sa(n)g baseraa ||
verses.translation: The bride and the Groom dwell together.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਮਿਲਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sej ek pai milan dhuheraa ||2||
verses.translation: They lie upon the one bed, but their union is difficult. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n suhaagan jo peea bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer fir janam na aavai ||3||8||30||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, she shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||3||8||30||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: aasaa sree kabeer jeeau ke dhupadhe
verses.translation: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: heerai heeraa bedh pavan man sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: When the Diamond of the Lord pierces the diamond of my mind, the fickle mind waving in the wind is easily absorbed into Him.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨਿ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal jot in heerai bedhee satigur bachanee mai paiee ||1||
verses.translation: This Diamond fills all with Divine Light; through the True Guru's Teachings, I have found Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kee kathaa anaahadh baanee ||
verses.translation: The sermon of the Lord is the unstruck, endless song.

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s hui heeraa lei pachhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Becoming a swan, one recognizes the Diamond of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਸ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹ ਰਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer heeraa as dhekhio jag meh rahaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have seen such a Diamond, permeating and pervading the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: gupataa heeraa pragaT bhio jab gur gam dheeaa dhikhaiee ||2||1||31||
verses.translation: The hidden diamond became visible, when the Guru revealed it to me. ||2||1||31||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੀ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pahilee karoop kujaat kulakhanee saahurai peieeaai buree ||
verses.translation: My first wife, ignorance, was ugly, of low social status and bad character; she was evil in my home, and in her parents' home.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਉਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ab kee saroop sujaan sulakhanee sahaje udhar dharee ||1||
verses.translation: My present bride, divine understanding, is beautiful, wise and well-behaved; I have taken her to my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਬਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhalee saree muiee meree pahilee baree ||
verses.translation: It has turned out so well, that my first wife has died.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug jeevau meree ab kee dharee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: May she, whom I have now married, live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਬ ਲਹੁਰੀ ਆਈ ਬਡੀ ਕਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਟਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jab lahuree aaiee baddee kaa suhaag Tario ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, when the younger bride came, the elder one lost her husband.

verses.original: ਲਹੁਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਅਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੇਠੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: lahuree sa(n)g bhiee ab merai jeThee aaur dhario ||2||2||32||
verses.translation: The younger bride is with me now, and the elder one has taken another husband. ||2||2||32||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਕੋ ਧਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meree bahureeaa ko dhaneeaa naau ||
verses.translation: My daughter-in-law was first called Dhannia, the woman of wealth,

verses.original: ਲੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਜਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: le raakhio raam janeeaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: but now she is called Raam-jannia, the servant of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਧੁੰਧਰਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: ein(h) mu(n)ddeean meraa ghar dhu(n)dharaavaa ||
verses.translation: These shaven-headed saints have ruined my house.

verses.original: ਬਿਟਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਊਆ ਲਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: biTaveh raam ramuooaa laavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They have caused my son to start chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu meree maiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O mother:

verses.original: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: ein(h) mu(n)ddeean meree jaat gavaiee ||2||3||33||
verses.translation: these shaven-headed saints have done away with my low social status. ||2||3||33||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਰਹੁ ਰਹੁ ਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: rahu rahu ree bahureeaa ghoo(n)ghaT jin kaaddai ||
verses.translation: Stay, stay, O daughter-in-law - do not cover your face with a veil.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਲਹੈਗੀ ਨ ਆਢੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kee baar lahaigee na aaddai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the end, this shall not bring you even half a shell. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਗਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghoo(n)ghaT kaadd giee teree aagai ||
verses.translation: The one before you used to veil her face;

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਗੈਲਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aun kee gail toh jin laagai ||1||
verses.translation: do not follow in her footsteps. ||1||

verses.original: ਘੂੰਘਟ ਕਾਢੇ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghoo(n)ghaT kaadde kee ihai baddaiee ||
verses.translation: The only merit in veiling your face is

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਪਾਂਚ ਬਹੂ ਭਲੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhin dhas paa(n)ch bahoo bhale aaiee ||2||
verses.translation: that for a few days, people will say, ""What a noble bride has come"". ||2||

verses.original: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਉ ਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghoo(n)ghaT tero tau par saachai ||
verses.translation: Your veil shall be true only if

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੂਦਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਚੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har gun gai koodheh ar naachai ||3||
verses.translation: you skip, dance and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੂ ਤਬ ਜੀਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer bahoo tab jeetai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the soul-bride shall win,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavat janam biteetai ||4||1||34||
verses.translation: only if she passes her life singing the Lord's Praises. ||4||1||34||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਕਰਵਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਕਰਵਟ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karavat bhalaa na karavaT teree ||
verses.translation: I would rather be cut apart by a saw, than have You turn Your back on me.

verses.original: ਲਾਗੁ ਗਲੇ ਸੁਨੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laag gale sun binatee meree ||1||
verses.translation: Hug me close, and listen to my prayer. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree mukh fer piaare ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to You - please, turn Your face to me, O Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਵਟੁ ਦੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karavaT dhe mo kau kaahe kau maare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why do You kill me by turning Your back to me? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੋਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau tan cheereh a(n)g na morau ||
verses.translation: Even if You cut my body apart, I shall not pull my limbs away from You.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰੈ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੋਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd parai tau preet na torau ||2||
verses.translation: Even if my body falls, I shall not break my bonds of love with You. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਬੀਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham tum beech bhio nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: Between You and I, there is no other.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tumeh su ka(n)t naar ham soiee ||3||
verses.translation: You are the Husband Lord, and I am the soul-bride. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re loiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O people:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: ab tumaree parateet na hoiee ||4||2||35||
verses.translation: now, I place no reliance in you. ||4||2||35||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਕੋਰੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: koree ko kaahoo maram na jaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: No one knows the secret of God, the Cosmic Weaver.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਨਿ ਤਨਾਇਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag aan tanaio taanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has stretched out the fabric of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jab tum sun le bedh puraanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: When you listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਹਮ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab ham itanak pasario taanaa(n) ||1||
verses.translation: you shall know that the whole world is only a small piece of His woven fabric. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਗਹ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dharan akaas kee karageh banaiee ||
verses.translation: He has made the earth and sky His loom.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਥ ਚਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui saath chalaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Upon it, He moves the two bobbins of the sun and the moon. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਈ ਜੋਰਿ ਬਾਤ ਇਕ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਹ ਤਾਂਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: paiee jor baat ik keenee teh taa(n)tee man maanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Placing my feet together, I have accomplished one thing - my mind is pleased with that Weaver.

verses.original: ਜੋਲਾਹੇ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਚੀਨੑਾਂ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jolaahe ghar apanaa cheen(h)aa(n) ghaT hee raam pachhaanaa(n) ||3||
verses.translation: I have come to understand my own home, and recognize the Lord within my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਾਰਗਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer kaarageh toree ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, when my body workshop breaks,

verses.translit: sootai soot milaae koree ||4||3||36||
verses.translation: the Weaver shall blend my thread with His thread. ||4||3||36||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail je teerath naavai tis baiku(n)Th na jaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: With filth within the heart, even if one bathes at sacred places of pilgrimage, still, he shall not go to heaven.

verses.original: ਲੋਕ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਯਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lok pateene kachhoo na hovai naahee raam ayaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nothing is gained by trying to please others - the Lord cannot be fooled. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojahu raam ek hee dhevaa ||
verses.translation: Worship the One Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa naavan gur kee sevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The true cleansing bath is service to the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਕੈ ਮਜਨਿ ਜੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal kai majan je gat hovai nit nit me(n)dduk naaveh ||
verses.translation: If salvation can be obtained by bathing in water, then what about the frog, which is always bathing in water?

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਤੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਨਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaise me(n)dduk taise oi nar fir fir jonee aaveh ||2||
verses.translation: As is the frog, so is that mortal; he is reincarnated, over and over again. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਨ ਬਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manahu kaThor marai baanaaras narak na baa(n)chiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: If the hard-hearted sinner dies in Benaares, he cannot escape hell.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਾੜੰਬੈ ਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੈਨ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa sa(n)t marai haaRa(n)bai ta sagalee sain taraiee ||3||
verses.translation: And even if the Lord's Saint dies in the cursed land of Haramba, still, he saves all his family. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas na rain bedh nahee saasatr tahaa basai nira(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Where there is neither day nor night, and neither Vedas nor Shaastras, there, the Formless Lord abides.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਰ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer nar tiseh dhiaavahu baavariaa sa(n)saaraa ||4||4||37||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate on Him, O mad-men of the world. ||4||4||37||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: aasaa baanee sree naamadheau jee kee
verses.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਆਪਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ek anek biaapak poorak jat dhekhau tat soiee ||
verses.translation: In the one and in the many, He is pervading and permeating; wherever I look, there He is.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maiaa chitr bachitr bimohit biralaa boojhai koiee ||1||
verses.translation: The marvellous image of Maya is so fascinating; how few understand this. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh gobi(n)dh hai sabh gobi(n)dh hai gobi(n)dh bin nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: God is everything, God is everything. Without God, there is nothing at all.

verses.original: ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਣਿ ਸਤ ਸਹੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soot ek man sat saha(n)s jaise ot pot prabh soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As one thread holds hundreds and thousands of beads, He is woven into His creation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਫੇਨ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jal tara(n)g ar fen budhabudhaa jal te bhi(n)n na hoiee ||
verses.translation: The waves of the water, the foam and bubbles, are not distinct from the water.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih parapa(n)ch paarabraham kee leelaa bicharat aan na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: This manifested world is the playful game of the Supreme Lord God; reflecting upon it, we find that it is not different from Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa bharam ar supan manorath sat padhaarath jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: False doubts and dream objects - man believes them to be true.

verses.original: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਨਸਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukirat manasaa gur upadhesee jaagat hee man maaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has instructed me to try to do good deeds, and my awakened mind has accepted this. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naamadheau har kee rachanaa dhekhahu ridhai beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, see the Creation of the Lord, and reflect upon it in your heart.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar keval ek muraaree ||4||1||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, and deep within the very nucleus of all, is the One Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaieele uoodhak Thaakur kau isanaan karau ||
verses.translation: Bringing the pitcher, I fill it with water, to bathe the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਇਆਲੀਸ ਲਖ ਜੀ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: biaalees lakh jee jal meh hote beeThal bhailaa kai karau ||1||
verses.translation: But 4.2 million species of beings are in the water - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਉ ਤਤ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jatr jaau tat beeThal bhailaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, the Lord is there.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh kare sadh kelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He continually plays in supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਫੂਲ ਪਰੋਈਲੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaneele fool paroieele maalaa Thaakur kee hau pooj karau ||
verses.translation: I bring flowers to weave a garland, in worshipful adoration of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਹ ਬੀਠਲ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pahile baas liee hai bhavareh beeThal bhailaa kai karau ||2||
verses.translation: But the bumble bee has already sucked out the fragrance - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਰੀਧਾਈਲੇ ਖੀਰੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਨੈਵੇਦੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaneele dhoodh reedhaieele kheera(n) Thaakur kau naivedh karau ||
verses.translation: I carry milk and cook it to make pudding, with which to feed the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ਬਛਰੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pahile dhoodh biTaario bachharai beeThal bhailaa kai karau ||3||
verses.translation: But the calf has already tasted the milk - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||3||

verses.original: ਈਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਊਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਬੀਠਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: e'eebhai beeThal uoobhai beeThal beeThal bin sa(n)saar nahee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is here, the Lord is there; without the Lord, there is no world at all.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar naamaa pranavai poor rahio too(n) sarab mahee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are totally permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਗਜੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mero gaj jihabaa meree kaatee ||
verses.translation: My mind is the yardstick, and my tongue is the scissors.

verses.original: ਮਪਿ ਮਪਿ ਕਾਟਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: map map kaaTau jam kee faasee ||1||
verses.translation: I measure it out and cut off the noose of death. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਹ ਕਰਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa karau jaatee keh karau paatee ||
verses.translation: What do I have to do with social status? What do I have to with ancestry?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam ko naam japau dhin raatee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਂਗਨਿ ਰਾਂਗਉ ਸੀਵਨਿ ਸੀਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: raa(n)gan raa(n)gau seevan seevau ||
verses.translation: I dye myself in the color of the Lord, and sew what has to be sewn.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀਅ ਨ ਜੀਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin ghareea na jeevau ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, I cannot live, even for a moment. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karau har ke gun gaavau ||
verses.translation: I perform devotional worship, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar apanaa khasam dhiaavau ||3||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਸੂਈ ਰੁਪੇ ਕਾ ਧਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: suine kee sooiee rupe kaa dhaagaa ||
verses.translation: My needle is gold, and my thread is silver.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naame kaa chit har sau laagaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's mind is attached to the Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਸਾਪੁ ਕੁੰਚ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਡੈ ॥
verses.translit: saap ku(n)ch chhoddai bikh nahee chhaaddai ||
verses.translation: The snake sheds its skin, but does not lose its venom.

verses.original: ਉਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਡੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: audhak maeh jaise bag dhiaan maaddai ||1||
verses.translation: The heron appears to be meditating, but it is concentrating on the water. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਪੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe kau keejai dhiaan japa(n)naa ||
verses.translation: Why do you practice meditation and chanting,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab te sudh naahee man apanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: when your mind is not pure? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਘਚ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)ghach bhojan jo nar jaanai ||
verses.translation: That man who feeds like a lion,

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਠਗਦੇਉ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaise hee Thagadheau bakhaanai ||2||
verses.translation: is called the god of thieves. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਝਗਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naame ke suaamee laeh le jhagaraa ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master has settled my inner conflicts.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਉ ਰੇ ਦਗਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: raam rasain peeau re dhagaraa ||3||4||
verses.translation: Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O deceitful one. ||3||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿ ਚੀਨੑਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham j cheen(h)see aasaa te na bhaavasee ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God, dislikes other desires.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਹ ਚੇਤੀਅਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raamaa bhagateh cheteeale achi(n)t man raakhasee ||1||
verses.translation: He focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship, and keeps his mind free of anxiety. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਹਿਗਾ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaise man tarahigaa re sa(n)saar saagar bikhai ko banaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water of corruption?

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThee maiaa dhekh kai bhoolaa re manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the falseness of Maya, you have gone astray, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੈਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: chheepe ke ghar janam dhailaa gur upadhes bhailaa ||
verses.translation: You have given me birth in the house of a calico-printer, but I have found the Teachings of the Guru.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੁਲਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)teh kai parasaadh naamaa har bheTulaa ||2||5||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saint, Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: aasaa baanee sree ravidhaas jeeau kee
verses.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਏਕ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: mirag meen bhira(n)g pata(n)g ku(n)char ek dhokh binaas ||
verses.translation: The deer, the fish, the bumble bee, the moth and the elephant are destroyed, each for a single defect.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhokh asaadh jaa meh taa kee ketak aas ||1||
verses.translation: So the one who is filled with the five incurable vices - what hope is there for him? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧੋ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਿਤ ਕੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: maadho abidhiaa hit keen ||
verses.translation: O Lord, he is in love with ignorance.

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਦੀਪ ਮਲੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bibek dheep maleen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His lamp of clear wisdom has grown dim. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਸੰਭਵ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੋਚ ॥
verses.translit: tiragadh jon achet sa(n)bhav pu(n)n paap asoch ||
verses.translation: The creeping creatures live thoughtless lives, and cannot discriminate between good and evil.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਤਿਹੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maanukhaa avataar dhulabh tihee sa(n)gat poch ||2||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and yet, they keep company with the low. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t jahaa jahaa lag karam ke bas jai ||
verses.translation: Wherever the beings and creatures are, they are born according to the karma of their past actions.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਅਬਧ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaal faas abadh laage kachh na chalai upai ||3||
verses.translation: The noose of death is unforgiving, and it shall catch them; it cannot be warded off. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਤਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਪਨ ਤਪੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas dhaas udhaas taj bhram tapan tap gur giaan ||
verses.translation: O servant Ravi Daas, dispel your sorrow and doubt, and know that Guru-given spiritual wisdom is the penance of penances.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat jan bhai haran paramaana(n)dh karahu nidhaan ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, Destroyer of the fears of Your humble devotees, make me supremely blissful in the end. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਝੀ ਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t tujhee tan sa(n)gat praan ||
verses.translation: Your Saints are Your body, and their company is Your breath of life.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan jaanai sa(n)t dhevaa dhev ||1||
verses.translation: By the True Guru-given spiritual wisdom, I know the Saints as the gods of gods. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ॥ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਝੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t chee sa(n)gat sa(n)t kathaa ras || sa(n)t prem maajhai dheejai dhevaa dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, God of gods, grant me the Society of the Saints, the sublime essence of the Saints' conversation, and the Love of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਆਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਚ ਓਲ੍ਹਗ ਓਲ੍ਹਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t aacharan sa(n)t cho maarag sa(n)t ch olhag olhaganee ||2||
verses.translation: The Character of the Saints, the lifestyle of the Saints, and the service of the servant of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਇਕ ਮਾਗਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaur ik maagau bhagat chi(n)taaman ||
verses.translation: I ask for these, and for one thing more - devotional worship, which shall fulfill my desires.

verses.original: ਜਣੀ ਲਖਾਵਹੁ ਅਸੰਤ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਣਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janee lakhaavahu asa(n)t paapee san ||3||
verses.translation: Do not show me the wicked sinners. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas bhanai jo jaanai so jaan ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, he alone is wise, who knows this:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੰਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ana(n)teh a(n)tar naahee ||4||2||
verses.translation: there is no difference between the Saints and the Infinite Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਇਰੰਡ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum cha(n)dhan ham ira(n)dd baapure sa(n)g tumaare baasaa ||
verses.translation: You are sandalwood, and I am the poor castor oil plant, dwelling close to you.

verses.original: ਨੀਚ ਰੂਖ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: neech rookh te uooch bhe hai ga(n)dh suga(n)dh nivaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: From a lowly tree, I have become exalted; Your fragrance, Your exquisite fragrance now permeates me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maadhau satasa(n)gat saran tum(h)aaree ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of the company of Your Saints;

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਉਗਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham aaugan tum(h) upakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, and You are so benevolent. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਮਖਤੂਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਸਪੀਅਲ ਹਮ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜਸ ਕੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum makhatool supedh sapeeal ham bapure jas keeraa ||
verses.translation: You are the white and yellow threads of silk, and I am like a poor worm.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਖੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil raheeaai maadhau jaise madhup makheeraa ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord, I seek to live in the Company of the Saints, like the bee with its honey. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਪਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaatee ochhaa paatee ochhaa ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my birth is low as well.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam kee sev na keenee keh ravidhaas chamaaraa ||3||3||
verses.translation: I have not performed the service of the Lord, the Lord, says Ravi Daas the cobbler. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhio jau tan bhio chhin chhin ||
verses.translation: What would it matter, if my body were cut into pieces?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਉ ਡਰਪੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prem jai tau ddarapai tero jan ||1||
verses.translation: If I were to lose Your Love, Lord, then Your humble servant would be afraid. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਵਨ ਮਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tujheh charan arabi(n)dh bhavan man ||
verses.translation: Your lotus feet are the home of my mind.

verses.original: ਪਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paan karat paio paio raamieeaa dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Drinking in Your Nectar, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਟਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pat bipat paTal maiaa dhan ||
verses.translation: Prosperity, adversity, property and wealth are just Maya.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa meh magan hot na tero jan ||2||
verses.translation: Your humble servant is not engrossed in them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: prem kee jevaree baadhio tero jan ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant is tied by the rope of Your Love.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਛੂਟਿਬੋ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas chhooTibo kavan gun ||3||4||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, what benefit would I get by escaping from it? ||3||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har har har hare ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨ ਗਏ ਨਿਸਤਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat jan ge nisatar tare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the humble are carried across to salvation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਜਾਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kabeer ujaagar ||
verses.translation: Through the Lord's Name, Kabeer became famous and respected.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kaaTe kaagar ||1||
verses.translation: The accounts of his past incarnations were torn up. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਮਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nimat naamadheau dhoodh peeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Because of Naam Dayv's devotion, the Lord drank the milk he offered.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜਗ ਜਨਮ ਸੰਕਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau jag janam sa(n)kaT nahee aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He shall not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation into the world again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jan ravidhaas raam ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: Servant Ravi Daas is imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: eiau gur parasaadh narak nahee jaataa ||3||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he shall not have to go to hell. ||3||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੋ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਚਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee ko putaraa kaise nachat hai ||
verses.translation: How does the puppet of clay dance?

verses.original: ਦੇਖੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਉਰਿਓ ਫਿਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhai dhekhai sunai bolai dhaurio firat hai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He looks and listens, hears and speaks, and runs around. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab kachh paavai tab garab karat hai ||
verses.translation: When he acquires something, he is inflated with ego.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਈ ਤਬ ਰੋਵਨੁ ਲਗਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maiaa giee tab rovan lagat hai ||1||
verses.translation: But when his wealth is gone, then he cries and bewails. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਕਸਹਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam ras kaseh lubhaanaa ||
verses.translation: In thought, word and deed, he is attached to the sweet and tangy flavors.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binas giaa jai kahoo(n) samaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: When he dies, no one knows where he has gone. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਬਾਜੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas baajee jag bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the world is just a dramatic play, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸਉ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: baajeegar sau muoh preet ban aaiee ||3||6||
verses.translation: I have enshrined love for the Lord, the star of the show. ||3||6||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਧੰਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: aasaa baanee bhagat dha(n)ne jee kee
verses.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of Devotee Dhanna Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਲਾਨੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat firat bahu janam bilaane tan man dhan nahee dheere ||
verses.translation: I wandered through countless incarnations, but mind, body and wealth never remain stable.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਮ ਲੁਬਧ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laalach bikh kaam lubadh raataa man bisare prabh heere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Attached to, and stained by the poisons of sexual desire and greed, the mind has forgotten the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਮੀਠ ਲਗੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bikh fal meeTh lage man baure chaar bichaar na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The poisonous fruit seems sweet to the demented mind, which does not know the difference between good and evil.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਢੀ ਅਨ ਭਾਂਤੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun te preet baddee an bhaa(n)tee janam maran fir taaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Turning away from virtue, his love for other things increases, and he weaves again the web of birth and death. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਜਲਤ ਜਾਲ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jugat jaan nahee ridhai nivaasee jalat jaal jam fa(n)dh pare ||
verses.translation: He does not know the way to the Lord, who dwells within his heart; burning in the trap, he is caught by the noose of death.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਸੰਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bikh fal sa(n)ch bhare man aaise param purakh prabh man bisare ||2||
verses.translation: Gathering the poisonous fruits, he fills his mind with them, and he forgets God, the Supreme Being, from his mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਏਕ ਮਏ ॥
verses.translit: giaan praves gureh dhan dheeaa dhiaan maan man ek me ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given the wealth of spiritual wisdom; practicing meditation, the mind becomes one with Him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat maanee sukh jaaniaa tirapat aghaane mukat bhe ||3||
verses.translation: Embracing loving devotional worship for the Lord, I have come to know peace; satisfied and satiated, I have been liberated. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਛਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jot samai samaanee jaa kai achhalee prabh pahichaaniaa ||
verses.translation: One who is filled with the Divine Light, recognizes the undeceivable Lord God.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nai dhan paiaa dharaneedhar mil jan sa(n)t samaaniaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Dhanna has obtained the Lord, the Sustainer of the World, as his wealth; meeting the humble Saints, he merges in the Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh sa(n)g naamadheau man leenaa ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's mind was absorbed into God, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind.

verses.original: ਆਢ ਦਾਮ ਕੋ ਛੀਪਰੋ ਹੋਇਓ ਲਾਖੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aadd dhaam ko chheeparo hoio laakheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The calico-printer, worth half a shell, became worth millions. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੁਨਨਾ ਤਨਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bunanaa tananaa tiaag kai preet charan kabeeraa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning weaving and stretching thread, Kabeer enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲਾ ਜੋਲਾਹਰਾ ਭਇਓ ਗੁਨੀਯ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: neech kulaa jolaaharaa bhio guneey gaheeraa ||1||
verses.translation: A weaver from a lowly family, he became an ocean of excellence. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਢੁਵੰਤਾ ਢੋਰ ਨੀਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas dduva(n)taa ddor neet tin tiaagee maiaa ||
verses.translation: Ravi Daas, who used to carry dead cows every day, renounced the world of Maya.

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paragaT hoaa saadhasa(n)g har dharasan paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He became famous in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੈਨੁ ਨਾਈ ਬੁਤਕਾਰੀਆ ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sain naiee butakaareeaa oh ghar ghar suniaa ||
verses.translation: Sain, the barber, the village drudge, became famous in each and every house.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hiradhe vasiaa paarabraham bhagataa meh ganiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God dwelled in his heart, and he was counted among the devotees. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਟਰੋ ਉਠਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh sun kai jaaTaro uTh bhagatee laagaa ||
verses.translation: Hearing this, Dhanna the Jaat applied himself to devotional worship.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਧੰਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: mile pratakh gusaieeaa dha(n)naa vaddabhaagaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe met him personally; Dhanna was so very blessed. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਬਿਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: re chit chetas kee na dhayaal dhamodhar bibeh na jaanas koiee ||
verses.translation: O my consciousness, why don't you remain conscious of the Merciful Lord? How can you recognize any other?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je dhaaveh brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd kau karataa karai su hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You may run around the whole universe, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਨੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਉਦਰ ਉਦਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jananee kere udhar udhak meh pi(n)dd keeaa dhas dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the water of the mother's womb, He fashioned the body with ten gates.

verses.original: ਦੇਇ ਅਹਾਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਐਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhei ahaar agan meh raakhai aaisaa khasam hamaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: He gives it sustenance, and preserves it in fire - such is my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੁੰਮੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਖੀਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)mee jal maeh tan tis baahar pa(n)kh kheer tin naahee ||
verses.translation: The mother turtle is in the water, and her babies are out of the water. She has no wings to protect them, and no milk to feed them.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਸਮਝਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pooran paramaana(n)dh manohar samajh dhekh man maahee ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, the Fascinating Lord takes care of them. See this, and understand it in your mind||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਖਣਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਾ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: paakhan keeT gupat hoi rahataa taa cho maarag naahee ||
verses.translation: The worm lies hidden under the stone - there is no way for him to escape.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਧੰਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਮਤ ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਂਹੀ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahai dha(n)naa pooran taahoo ko mat re jeea ddaraa(n)hee ||3||3||
verses.translation: Says Dhanna, the Perfect Lord takes care of him. Fear not, O my soul. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ
verses.translit: aasaa sekh fareedh jeeau kee baanee
verses.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦਿਲਹੁ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿੰਨੑ ਸੇਈ ਸਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhilahu muhabat ji(n)n(h) seiee sachiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone are true, whose love for God is deep and heart-felt.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਿ ਕਾਂਢੇ ਕਚਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin(h) man hor mukh hor s kaa(n)dde kachiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have one thing in their heart, and something else in their mouth, are judged to be false. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਤੇ ਇਸਕ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: rate isak khudhai ra(n)g dheedhaar ke ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with love for the Lord, are delighted by His Vision.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: visariaa jin(h) naam te bhui bhaar the'ee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are a burden on the earth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap le'ee laR lai dhar dharaves se ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord attaches to the hem of His robe, are the true dervishes at His Door.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਉ ਆਏ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin dha(n)n janedhee maau aae safal se ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them, and fruitful is their coming into the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: paravadhagaar apaar agam bea(n)t too ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Sustainer and Cherisher, You are infinite, unfathomable and endless.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁੰਮਾ ਪੈਰ ਮੂੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jinaa pachhaataa sach chu(n)maa pair moo(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Those who recognize the True Lord - I kiss their feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਤੂ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: teree paneh khudhai too bakhasa(n)dhagee ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Protection - You are the Forgiving Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਖੈਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਦਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sekh fareedhai khair dheejai ba(n)dhagee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Please, bless Shaykh Fareed with the bounty of Your meditative worship. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa:

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਲਹ ਲਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: bolai sekh fareedh piaare aleh lage ||
verses.translation: Says Shaykh Fareed, O my dear friend, attach yourself to the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖਾਕ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਗੋਰ ਘਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eih tan hosee khaak nimaanee gor ghare ||1||
verses.translation: This body shall turn to dust, and its home shall be a neglected graveyard. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਟਾਕਿਮ ਕੂੰਜੜੀਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਮਚਿੰਦੜੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaj milaavaa sekh fareedh Taakim koo(n)jaReeaa manahu machi(n)dhaReeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You can meet the Lord today, O Shaykh Fareed, if you restrain your bird-like desires which keep your mind in turmoil. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਘੁਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je jaanaa mar jaieeaai ghum na aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: If I had known that I was to die, and not return again,

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhooThee dhuneeaa lag na aap van(j)aieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: I would not have ruined myself by clinging to the world of falsehood. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: boleeaai sach dharam jhooTh na boleeaai ||
verses.translation: So speak the Truth, in righteousness, and do not speak falsehood.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ਵਾਟ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਜੋਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo gur dhasai vaaT mureedhaa joleeaai ||3||
verses.translation: The disciple ought to travel the route, pointed out by the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਛੈਲ ਲੰਘੰਦੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chhail la(n)gha(n)dhe paar goree man dheeriaa ||
verses.translation: Seeing the youths being carried across, the hearts of the beautiful young soul-brides are encouraged.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਕਲਵਤਿ ਚੀਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan va(n)ne paase kalavat cheeriaa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who side with the glitter of gold, are cut down with a saw. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੇਖ ਹੈਯਾਤੀ ਜਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sekh haiyaatee jag na koiee thir rahiaa ||
verses.translation: O Shaykh, no one's life is permanent in this world.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਸਣਿ ਹਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੈਸਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jis aasan ham baiThe kete bais giaa ||5||
verses.translation: That seat, upon which we now sit - many others sat on it and have since departed. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਤਿਕ ਕੂੰਜਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਡਉ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: katik koo(n)jaa(n) chet ddau saavan bijuleeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: As the swallows appear in the month of Katik, forest fires in the month of Chayt, and lightning in Saawan,

verses.original: ਸੀਆਲੇ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆਂ ਪਿਰ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਂ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: seeaale soha(n)dheeaa(n) pir gal baahaReeaa(n) ||6||
verses.translation: and as the bride's arms adorn her husband's neck in winter;||6||

verses.original: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਮਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: chale chalanahaar vichaaraa lei mano ||
verses.translation: Just so, the transitory human bodies pass away. Reflect upon this in your mind.

verses.original: ਗੰਢੇਦਿਆਂ ਛਿਅ ਮਾਹ ਤੁੜੰਦਿਆ ਹਿਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ga(n)ddedhiaa(n) chhia maeh tuRa(n)dhiaa hik khino ||7||
verses.translation: It takes six months to form the body, but it breaks in an instant. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਮੀ ਪੁਛੈ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖੇਵਟ ਕਿੰਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: jimee puchhai asamaan fareedhaa khevaT ki(n)n ge ||
verses.translation: O Fareed, the earth asks the sky, ""Where have the boatmen gone?""

verses.original: ਜਾਲਣ ਗੋਰਾਂ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਲਾਮੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਹੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaalan goraa(n) naal ulaame jeea sahe ||8||2||
verses.translation: Some have been cremated, and some lie in their graves; their souls are suffering rebukes. ||8||2||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag goojaree mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਚਨਣਾਠੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਉਰਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam karee chananaaTheeaa je man urasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: I would make Your Name the sandalwood, and my mind the stone to rub it on;

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਜੇ ਰਲੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karanee ku(n)goo je ralai ghaT a(n)tar poojaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: for saffron, I would offer good deeds; thus, I perform worship and adoration within my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa keechai naam dhiaaieeaai bin naavai pooj na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Perform worship and adoration by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, there is no worship and adoration. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baahar dhev pakhaale'eeh je man dhovai koi ||
verses.translation: If one were to wash his heart inwardly, like the stone idol which is washed on the outside,

verses.original: ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਮੋਖ ਪਇਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jooTh lahai jeeau maajeeaai mokh piaanaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: his filth would be removed, his soul would be cleansed, and he would be liberated when he departs. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo mileh cha(n)giaaieeaa khaR khaaveh a(n)mrit dheh ||
verses.translation: Even beasts have value, as they eat grass and give milk.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam vihoone aadhamee dhirag jeevan karam kareh ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the mortal's life is cursed, as are the actions he performs. ||3||

verses.original: ਨੇੜਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: neRaa hai dhoor na jaaniahu nit saare sa(n)m(h)aale ||
verses.translation: The Lord is near at hand - do not think that He is far away. He always cherishes us, and remembers us.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo dhevai so khaavanaa kahu naanak saachaa he ||4||1||
verses.translation: Whatever He gives us, we eat; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਪਜੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naabh kamal te brahamaa upaje bedh paReh mukh ka(n)Th savaar ||
verses.translation: From the lotus of Vishnu's navel, Brahma was born; He chanted the Vedas with a melodious voice.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਣਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa ko a(n)t na jaiee lakhanaa aavat jaat rahai gubaar ||1||
verses.translation: He could not find the Lord's limits, and he remained in the darkness of coming and going. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: preetam kiau bisareh mere praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: Why should I forget my Beloved? He is the support of my very breath of life.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee bhagat kareh jan poore mun jan seveh gur veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The perfect beings perform devotional worship to Him. The silent sages serve Him through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: rav sas dheepak jaa ke tirabhavan ekaa jot muraar ||
verses.translation: His lamps are the sun and the moon; the One Light of the Destroyer of ego fills the three worlds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su ahinis niramal manmukh rain a(n)dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh remains immaculately pure, day and night, while the self-willed manmukh is enveloped by the darkness of night. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਿਆ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sidh samaadh kareh nit jhagaraa dhuh lochan kiaa herai ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi are continually in conflict; what can they see with their two eyes?

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot sabadh dhun jaagai satigur jhagar niberai ||3||
verses.translation: One who has the Divine Light within his heart, and is awakened to the melody of the Word of the Shabad - the True Guru settles his conflicts. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar naath bea(n)t ajonee saachai mahal apaaraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord of angels and men, infinite and unborn, Your True Mansion is incomparable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan nadhar karahu nisataaraa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Nanak merges imperceptibly into the Life of the world; shower Your mercy upon him, and save him. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag goojaree mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag ivehaa jeevanaa jit har preet na pai ||
verses.translation: Cursed is that life, in which the Lord's Love is not obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit ka(n)m har veesarai dhoojai lagai jai ||1||
verses.translation: Cursed is that occupation, in which the Lord is forgotten, and one becomes attached to duality. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur seveeaai manaa jit seviaai govidh preet uoopajai avar visar sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Serve such a True Guru, O my mind, that by serving Him, God's Love may be produced, and all others may be forgotten.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har setee chit geh rahai jaraa kaa bhau na hoviee jeevan padhavee pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your consciousness shall remain attached to the Lord; there shall be no fear of old age, and the supreme status shall be obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਵੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh preet siau ik sahaj upajiaa vekh jaisee bhagat banee ||
verses.translation: A divine peace wells up from God's Love; behold, it comes from devotional worship.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap setee aap khaiaa taa man niramal hoaa jotee jot samiee ||2||
verses.translation: When my identity consumed my identical identity, then my mind became immaculately pure, and my light was blended with the Divine Light. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa aaisaa satigur na paieeaai je lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Without good fortune, such a True Guru cannot be found, no matter how much all may yearn for Him.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kooRai kee paal vichahu nikalai taa sadhaa sukh hoi ||3||
verses.translation: If the veil of falsehood is removed from within, then lasting peace is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aaise satigur kee kiaa oh sevak sevaa kare gur aagai jeeau dharei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, what service can the servant perform for such a True Guru? He should offer his life, his very soul, to the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit kare satigur aape kirapaa karei ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: If he focuses his consciousness on the Will of the True Guru, then the True Guru Himself will bless him. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kee tum sevaa karahu dhoojee sevaa karahu na koi jee ||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa te manahu chi(n)dhiaa fal paieeaai dhoojee sevaa janam birathaa jai jee ||1||
verses.translation: Serving the Lord, you shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires; serving another, your life shall pass away in vain. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਨੀ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: har meree preet reet hai har meree har meree kathaa kahaanee jee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Love, the Lord is my way of life, the Lord is my speech and conversation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਨੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh meraa man bheejai ehaa sev banee jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, my mind is saturated with the Lord's Love; this is what makes up my service. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har meraa simirat har meraa saasatr har meraa ba(n)dhap har meraa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Simritees, the Lord is my Shaastras; the Lord is my relative and the Lord is my brother.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kee mai bhookh laagai har naam meraa man tirapatai har meraa saak a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I am hungry for the Lord; my mind is satisfied with the Name of the Lord. The Lord is my relation, my helper in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੀ ਹੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bin hor raas kooRee hai chaladhiaa naal na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, other assets are false. They do not go with the mortal when he departs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਹਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har meraa dhan merai saath chaalai jahaa hau jaau teh jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord is my wealth, which shall go with me; wherever I go, it will go. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so jhooThaa jo jhooThe laagai jhooThe karam kamaiee ||
verses.translation: One who is attached to falsehood is false; false are the deeds he does.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਹੋਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak har kaa bhaanaa hoaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaiee ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, everything happens according to the Will of the Lord; no one has any say in this at all. ||4||2||4||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jug maeh naam dhula(n)bh hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in this age; only the Gurmukh obtains it.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai mukat na hoviee vekhahu ko viaupai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no one is liberated; let anyone make other efforts, and see. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai har man vasai sahaje rahai samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one remains absorbed in Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) bhau paae aapanaa bairaag upajai man aai ||
verses.translation: When God instills His fear, a balanced detachment springs up in the mind.

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bairaagai te har paieeaai har siau rahai samai ||2||
verses.translation: Through this detachment, the Lord is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਇ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: sei mukat j man jineh fir dhaat na laagai aai ||
verses.translation: He alone is liberated, who conquers his mind; Maya does not stick to him again.

verses.original: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਹਤ ਕਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhasavai dhuaar rahat kare tirabhavan sojhee pai ||3||
verses.translation: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, and obtains the understanding of the three worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gur te gur hoiaa vekhahu tis kee rajai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru, one becomes the Guru; behold, His Wondrous Will.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: eih kaaran karataa kare jotee jot samai ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: This deed was done by the Creator Lord; one's light merges into the Light. ||4||3||5||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam sabh ko kahai kahiaai raam na hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone chants the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam; but by such chanting, the Lord is not obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee raam man vasai taa fal paavai koi ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, the fruits are obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar govi(n)dh jis laagai preet ||
verses.translation: One who enshrines love for God within his mind,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har tis kadhe na veesarai har har kareh sadhaa man cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: never forgets the Lord; he continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in his conscious mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai jin(h) kai kapaT vasai baaharahu sa(n)t kahaeh ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with hypocrisy, who are called saints only for their outward show

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa mool na chukiee a(n)t ge pachhutaeh ||2||
verses.translation: - their desires are never satisfied, and they depart grieving in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anek teerath je jatan karai taa a(n)tar kee haumai kadhe na jai ||
verses.translation: Although one may bathe at many places of pilgrimage, still, his ego never departs.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis nar kee dhubidhaa na jai dharam rai tis dhei sajai ||3||
verses.translation: That man, whose sense of duality does not depart - the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall punish him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai soiee jan paae gurmukh boojhai koiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being, unto whom God showers His Mercy, obtains Him; how few are the Gurmukhs who understand Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak vichahu haumai maare taa(n) har bheTai soiee ||4||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan saa(n)t sadhaa mat nihachal jis kaa abhimaan gavaae ||
verses.translation: That humble being who eliminates his ego is at peace; he is blessed with an ever-stable intellect.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so jan niramal j gurmukh boojhai har charanee chit laae ||1||
verses.translation: That humble being is immaculately pure, who, as Gurmukh, understands the Lord, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har chet achet manaa jo ichheh so fal hoiee ||
verses.translation: O my unconscious mind, remain conscious of the Lord, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ras paaveh peevat raheh sadhaa sukh hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the sublime elixir of the Lord; by continually drinking it in, you shall have eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe taa paaras hovai paaras hoi ta pooj karaae ||
verses.translation: When one meets the True Guru, he becomes the philosopher's stone, with the ability to transform others, inspiring them to worship the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਸੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo us pooje so fal paae dheekhiaa dhevai saach bujhaae ||2||
verses.translation: One who worships the Lord in adoration, obtains his rewards; instructing others, he reveals the Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਸੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vin paarasai pooj na hoviee vin man parache avaraa samajhaae ||
verses.translation: Without becoming the philosopher's stone, he does not inspire others to worship the Lord; without instructing his own mind, how can he instruct others?

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਏ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: guroo sadhaae agiaanee a(n)dhaa kis oh maarag paae ||3||
verses.translation: The ignorant, blind man calls himself the guru, but to whom can he show the way? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak vin nadharee kichhoo na paieeaai jis nadhar kare so paae ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without His Mercy, nothing can be obtained. One upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, obtains Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee dhe vaddiaaiee apanaa sabadh varataae ||4||5||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, God bestows greatness, and projects the Word of His Shabad. ||4||5||7||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa pa(n)chapadhe ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa kaasee mat uoopajai naa kaasee mat jai ||
verses.translation: Wisdom is not produced in Benares, nor is wisdom lost in Benares.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai mat uoopajai taa ieh sojhee pai ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, wisdom is produced, and then, one obtains this understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kathaa too(n) sun re man sabadh ma(n)n vasai ||
verses.translation: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, O mind, and enshrine the Shabad of His Word within your mind.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh mat teree thir rahai taa(n) bharam vichahu jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If your intellect remains stable and steady, then doubt shall depart from within you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: har charan ridhai vasai too kilavikh hoveh naas ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within your heart, and your sins shall be erased.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa vas kareh taa teerath kareh nivaas ||2||
verses.translation: If your soul overcomes the five elements, then you shall come to have a home at the true place of pilgrimage. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ih man mugadh hai sojhee kichhoo na pai ||
verses.translation: This mind of the self-centered manmukh is so stupid; it does not obtain any understanding at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam na bujhiee a(n)t giaa pachhutai ||3||
verses.translation: It does not understand the Name of the Lord; it departs repenting in the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man kaasee sabh teerath simirat satigur dheeaa bujhai ||
verses.translation: In this mind are found Benares, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the Shaastras; the True Guru has explained this.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath tis sa(n)g raheh jin har hiradhai rahiaa samai ||4||
verses.translation: The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage remain with one, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai hukam bujhiaa ek vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, upon meeting the True Guru, the Order of the Lord's Will is understood, and the One Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥੮॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai sabh sach hai sache rahai samai ||5||6||8||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to You, O True Lord, are true. They remain absorbed in You. ||5||6||8||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eko naam nidhaan pa(n)ddit sun sikh sach soiee ||
verses.translation: The One Name is the treasure, O Pandit. Listen to these True Teachings.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਤ ਗੁਣਤ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai jetaa paReh paRat gunat sadhaa dhukh hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: No matter what you read in duality, reading and contemplating it, you shall only continue to suffer. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har charanee too(n) laag rahu gur sabadh sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: So grasp the Lord's lotus feet; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall come to understand.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ras rasanaa chaakh too(n) taa(n) man niramal hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, taste the sublime elixir of the Lord, and your mind shall be rendered immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai man sa(n)tokheeaai taa fir tirasanaa bhookh na hoi ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the mind becomes content, and then, hunger and desire will not trouble you any longer.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan paiaa par ghar jai na koi ||2||
verses.translation: Obtaining the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one does not go knocking at other doors. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee je kare manmukh boojh na hoi ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh babbles on and on, but he does not understand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa har naam paavai soi ||3||
verses.translation: One whose heart is illumined, by Guru's Teachings, obtains the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬੁਝਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sun saasatr too(n) na bujhahee taa fireh baaro baar ||
verses.translation: You may listen to the Shaastras, but you do not understand, and so you wander from door to door.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: so moorakh jo aap na pachhaaniee sach na dhare piaar ||4||
verses.translation: He is a fool, who does not understand his own self, and who does not enshrine love for the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਹਕਾਇਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachai jagat ddahakaiaa kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has fooled the world - no one has any say in this at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੫॥੭॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jiau tis kee rajai ||5||7||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He does whatever He pleases, according to His Will. ||5||7||9||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਹਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke jan satigur sat purakhaa hau binau karau gur paas ||
verses.translation: O Servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being, I offer my prayers to You, O Guru.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham keere kiram satigur saranaiee kar dhiaa naam paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: I am an insect and a worm; O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, be merciful and bestow upon me the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere meet gurdhev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
verses.translation: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please illuminate me with the Light of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam meraa praan sakhaiee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Instructions, the Naam is my breath of life, and the Praise of the Lord is my occupation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: har jan ke vaddabhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servants have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, Har, Har, and a thirst for the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har naam milai tirapataaseh mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
verses.translation: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Company of the Holy, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) har har har ras naam na paiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
verses.translation: Those who have not obtained the essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are taken away by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhirag jeeve dhirag jeevaas ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Company of the Holy - cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paiee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
