verses.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord, who have obtained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paiaa mil naanak naam paragaas ||4||1||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Naam shines forth. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh govi(n)dh preetam man preetam mil satasa(n)gat sabadh man mohai ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe is the Beloved of the minds of those who join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. The Shabad of His Word fascinates their minds.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਓਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap govi(n)dh govi(n)dh dhiaaieeaai sabh kau dhaan dhei prabh ohai ||1||
verses.translation: Chant, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; God is the One who gives gifts to all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: mere bhaiee janaa mo kau govi(n)dh govi(n)dh govi(n)dh man mohai ||
verses.translation: O my Siblings of Destiny, the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind, has enticed and fascinated my mind.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh govi(n)dh govi(n)dh gun gaavaa mil gur saadhasa(n)gat jan sohai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind; joining the Holy Society of the Guru, Your humble servant is beautified. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਉਲਾ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਗਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar har bhagat hai gurmat kaulaa ridh sidh laagai pag ohai ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship to the Lord is an ocean of peace; through the Guru's Teachings, wealth, prosperity and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas fall at our feet.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan kau raam naam aadhaaraa har naam japat har naame sohai ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the Support of His humble servant; he chants the Lord's Name, and with the Lord's Name he is adorned. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat bhaagaheen mat feeke naam sunat aavai man rohai ||
verses.translation: Evil-minded, unfortunate and shallow-minded are those who feel anger in their minds, when they hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਊਆ ਕਾਗ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kuooaa kaag kau a(n)mirat ras paieeaai tirapatai visaTaa khai mukh gohai ||3||
verses.translation: You may place ambrosial nectar before crows and ravens, but they will be satisfied only by eating manure and dung with their mouths. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਕਊਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat sar satigur sativaadhee jit naatai kuooaa ha(n)s hohai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Speaker of Truth, is the pool of Ambrosial Nectar; bathing within it, the crow becomes a swan.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhan dha(n)n vadde vaddabhaagee jin(h) gurmat naam ridhai mal dhohai ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those who, through the Guru's Teachings, with the Naam, wash away the filth of their hearts. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan uootam uootam baanee mukh boleh paraupakaare ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted, and exalted is their speech. With their mouths, they speak for the benefit of others.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jan sunai saradhaa bhagat setee kar kirapaa har nisataare ||1||
verses.translation: Those who listen to them with faith and devotion, are blessed by the Lord; showering His Mercy, He saves them. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
verses.translation: Lord, please, let me meet the beloved servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam praan satigur gur pooraa ham paapee gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Perfect Guru, is my Beloved, my very breath of life; the Guru has saved me, the sinner. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vaddabhaagee vaddabhaage jin har har naam adhaare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are fortunate, so very fortunate; their Support is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mrit har ras paaveh gurmat bhagat bha(n)ddaare ||2||
verses.translation: They obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain this treasure-house of devotional worship. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin dharasan satigur sat purakh na paiaa te bhaagaheen jam maare ||
verses.translation: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the True Primal Being, are most unfortunate; they are destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਗਰਧਭ ਪਵਹਿ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se kookar sookar garadhabh paveh garabh jonee dhay maare mahaa hatiaare ||3||
verses.translation: They are like dogs, pigs and jackasses; they are cast into the womb of reincarnation, and the Lord strikes them down as the worst of murderers. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal hoh jan uoopar kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Kind to the poor, please shower Your mercy upon Your humble servant, and save him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jan har kee saranaiee har bhaavai har nisataare ||4||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary; if it pleases You, Lord, please save him. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal meraa man laavahu hau anadhin raam naam nit dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful and attune my mind, so that I might meditate continually on the Lord's Name, night and day.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh sabh gun sabh nidhaan har jit japiaai dhukh bhukh sabh leh jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery and hunger depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere meraa raam naam sakhaa har bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Lord's Name is my companion and brother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat raam naam jas gaavaa a(n)t belee dharageh le chhaddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I sing the Praises of the Lord's Name; it shall be my help and support in the end, and it shall deliver me in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape dhaataa prabh a(n)tarajaamee kar kirapaa loch merai man laiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver, O God, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; by Your Grace, You have infused longing for You in my mind.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai man tan loch lagee har setee prabh loch pooree satigur saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: My mind and body long for the Lord; God has fulfilled my longing. I have entered the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam pu(n)n kar paiaa bin naavai dhirag dhirag birathaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Human birth is obtained through good actions; without the Name, it is cursed, totally cursed, and it passes away in vain.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਥੁਕ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam binaa ras kas dhukh khaavai mukh feekaa thuk thook mukh paiee ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains only suffering for his delicacies to eat. His mouth is insipid, and his face is spat upon, again and again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan har prabh har har saranaa tin dharageh har har dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, who have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord God, Har, Har, are blessed with glory in the Court of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n saabaas kahai prabh jan kau jan naanak mel le gal laiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed and congratulations, says God to His humble servant. O servant Nanak, He embraces him, and blends him with Himself. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sakhee sahelee meree mo kau dhevahu dhaan har praan jeevaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Gurmukhs, O my friends and companions, give me the gift of the Lord's Name, the life of my very life.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਹ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham hoveh laale gole gursikhaa ke jin(h)aa anadhin har prabh purakh dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am the slave, the servant of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord God, the Primal Being, night and day. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan birahu gursikh pag laiaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body, I have enshrined love for the feet of the Guru's Sikhs.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere praan sakhaa gur ke sikh bhaiee mo kau karahu upadhes har milai milaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my life-mates, O Sikhs of the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, instruct me in the Teachings, that I might merge in the Lord's Merger. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਚਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa har prabh bhaavai taa gurmukh mele jin(h) vachan guroo satigur man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: When it pleases the Lord God, he causes us to meet the Gurmukhs; the Hymns of the Guru, the True Guru, are very sweet to their minds.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur ke sikh piaare har nirabaanee nirabaan padh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are the beloved Sikhs of the Guru; through the Lord, they attain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat gur kee har piaaree jin har har naam meeThaa man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Guru, is loved by the Lord. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and pleasing to their minds.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਮਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin satigur sa(n)gat sa(n)g na paiaa se bhaagaheen paapee jam khaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who does not obtain the Association of the True Guru, is a most unfortunate sinner; he is consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap kirapaal kirapaa prabh dhaare har aape gurmukh milai milaiaa ||
verses.translation: If God, the Kind Master, Himself shows His kindness, then the Lord causes the Gurmukh to merge into Himself.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bole gun baanee gurbaanee har naam samaiaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Words of the Guru's Bani; through them, one is absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur purakh jin har prabh paiaa mo kau kar upadhes har meeTh lagaavai ||
verses.translation: One who has found the Lord God through the True Guru, has made the Lord seem so sweet to me, through the His Teachings.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal sabh hariaa hoaa vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaavai ||1||
verses.translation: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, and totally rejuvenated; by great good fortune, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re mo kau koiee aai milai har naam dhiraRaavai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, let anyone who can implant the Lord's Name within me, come and meet with me.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetam praan man tan sabh dhevaa mere har prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Unto my Beloved, I give my mind and body, and my very breath of life. He speaks to me of the sermon of my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dheeraj dharam gurmat har paiaa nit har naamai har siau chit laavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained courage, faith and the Lord. He keeps my mind focused continually on the Lord, and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bachan satigur kee baanee jo bolai so mukh a(n)mrit paavai ||2||
verses.translation: The Words of the True Guru's Teachings are Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit trickles into the mouth of the one who chants them. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal naam jit mail na laagai gurmat naam japai liv laavai ||
verses.translation: Immaculate is the Naam, which cannot be stained by filth. Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Naam with love.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath jin nar nahee paiaa se bhaagaheen mue mar jaavai ||3||
verses.translation: That man who has not found the wealth of the Naam is most unfortunate; he dies over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh mool jagajeevan dhaataa sabh jan kau anadh karahu har dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: The source of bliss, the Life of the world, the Great Giver brings bliss to all who meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa jeea sabh tere jan naanak gurmukh bakhas milaavai ||4||6||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver, all beings belong to You. O servant Nanak, You forgive the Gurmukhs, and merge them into Yourself. ||4||6||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiee baap putr sabh har ke ke'ee ||
verses.translation: Mother, father and sons are all made by the Lord;

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kau sanaba(n)dh har kar dhe'ee ||1||
verses.translation: the relationships of all are established by the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa jor sabh rahio mere beer ||
verses.translation: I have given up all my strength, O my brother.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa tan man sabh har kai vas hai sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The mind and body belong to the Lord, and the human body is entirely under His control. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau saradhaa aap har laiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself infuses devotion into His humble devotees.

verses.original: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: viche girasat udhaas rahaiee ||2||
verses.translation: In the midst of family life, they remain unattached. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab a(n)tar preet har siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: When inner love is established with the Lord,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tab jo kichh kare su mere har prabh bhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: then whatever one does, is pleasing to my Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jit kaarai ka(n)m ham har laae ||
verses.translation: I do those deeds and tasks which the Lord has set me to;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: so ham kareh ju aap karaae ||4||
verses.translation: I do that which He makes me to do. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kee bhagat mere prabh bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Those whose devotional worship is pleasing to my God

verses.original: ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: te jan naanak raam naam liv laiee ||5||1||7||16||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, those humble beings center their minds lovingly on the Lord's Name. ||5||1||7||16||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe re man chitaveh udham jaa aahar har jeeau pariaa ||
verses.translation: Why, O mind, do you contrive your schemes, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

verses.original: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sail pathar meh ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
verses.translation: From rocks and stones, He created the living beings, and He places before them their sustenance. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile s tariaa ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord of Souls, one who meets with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sooke kaasaT hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status, and the dry branch blossoms forth in greenery. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, friends, children, and spouse - no one is the support of any other.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe Thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
verses.translation: For each and every individual, the Lord and Master provides sustenance; why do you fear, O my mind? ||2||

verses.original: ਊਡੈ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: uooddai uoodd aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
verses.translation: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕਵਨੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aun kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa ||3||
verses.translation: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nidhaan dhas asaT sidhaan Thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
verses.translation: All treasures and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are held by the Lord and Master in the palm of His hand.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bal bal sadh bal jaieeaai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, and forever a sacrifice to You - Your vast expanse has no limit. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiriaachaar kareh khaT karamaa it raate sa(n)saaree ||
verses.translation: They perform the four rituals and six religious rites; the world is engrossed in these.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail na utarai haumai bin gur baajee haaree ||1||
verses.translation: They are not cleansed of the filth of their ego within; without the Guru, they lose the game of life. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur rakh levahu kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please, grant Your Grace and preserve me.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe ko viralaa sevak hor sagale biauhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Out of millions, hardly anyone is a servant of the Lord. All the others are mere traders. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saasat bedh simirat sabh sodhe sabh ekaa baat pukaaree ||
verses.translation: I have searched all the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees, and they all affirm one thing:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin gur mukat na kouoo paavai man vekhahu kar beechaaree ||2||
verses.translation: without the Guru, no one obtains liberation; see, and reflect upon this in your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਧਰ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh majan kar isanaanaa bhram aae dhar saaree ||
verses.translation: Even if one takes cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wanders over the whole planet,

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anik soch kareh dhin raatee bin satigur a(n)dhiaaree ||3||
verses.translation: and performs all the rituals of purification day and night, still, without the True Guru, there is only darkness. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਧਾਇਓ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat dhaavat sabh jag dhaio ab aae har dhuaaree ||
verses.translation: Roaming and wandering around, I have travelled over the whole world, and now, I have arrived at the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhuramat meT budh paragaasee jan naanak gurmukh taaree ||4||1||2||
verses.translation: The Lord has eliminated my evil-mindedness, and enlightened my intellect; O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved. ||4||1||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan jaap har dhan taap har dhan bhojan bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my chanting, the wealth of the Lord is my deep meditation; the wealth of the Lord is the food I enjoy.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nimakh na bisarau man te har har saadhasa(n)gat meh paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I do not forget the Lord, Har, Har, from my mind, even for an instant; I have found Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਖਾਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiee khaaT aaio ghar pootaa ||
verses.translation: O mother, your son has returned home with a profit:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਚਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan chalate har dhan baise har dhan jaagat sootaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the wealth of the Lord while walking, the wealth of the Lord while sitting, and the wealth of the Lord while waking and sleeping. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan isanaan har dhan giaan har sa(n)g lai dhiaanaa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my cleansing bath, the wealth of the Lord is my wisdom; I center my meditation on the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har dhan tulahaa har dhan beRee har har taar paraanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my raft, the wealth of the Lord is my boat; the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship to carry me across. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨਿ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan meree chi(n)t visaaree har dhan laahiaa dhokhaa ||
verses.translation: Through the wealth of the Lord, I have forgotten my anxiety; through the wealth of the Lord, my doubt has been dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਥੋਕਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har dhan te mai nav nidh paiee haath chario har thokaa ||3||
verses.translation: From the wealth of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures; the true essence of the Lord has come into my hands. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਖਰਚਹੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: khaavahu kharachahu toT na aavai halat palat kai sa(n)ge ||
verses.translation: No matter how much I eat and expend this wealth, it is not exhausted; here and hereafter, it remains with me.

verses.original: ਲਾਦਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: laadh khajaanaa gur naanak kau dheeaa ih man har ra(n)g ra(n)ge ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: Loading the treasure, Guru Nanak has given it, and this mind is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||4||2||3||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sabh kilavikh naaseh pitaree hoi udhaaro ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him, all sins are erased, and ones generations are saved.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so har har tum(h) sadh hee jaapahu jaa kaa a(n)t na paaro ||1||
verses.translation: So meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har; He has no end or limitation. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: pootaa maataa kee aasees ||
verses.translation: O son, this is your mother's hope and prayer,

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh na bisarau tum(h) kau har har sadhaa bhajahu jagadhees ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that you may never forget the Lord, Har, Har, even for an instant. May you ever vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tum(h) kau hoi dhiaalaa sa(n)tasa(n)g teree preet ||
verses.translation: May the True Guru be kind to you, and may you love the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaapaR pat paramesar raakhee bhojan keeratan neet ||2||
verses.translation: May the preservation of your honor by the Transcendent Lord be your clothes, and may the singing of His Praises be your food. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit peevahu sadhaa chir jeevahu har simarat anadh ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: So drink in forever the Ambrosial Nectar; may you live long, and may the meditative remembrance of the Lord give you infinite delight.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g tamaasaa pooran aasaa kabeh na biaapai chi(n)taa ||3||
verses.translation: May joy and pleasure be yours; may your hopes be fulfilled, and may you never be troubled by worries. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਵਰੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhavar tum(h)aaraa ih man hovau har charanaa hoh kaulaa ||
verses.translation: Let this mind of yours be the bumble bee, and let the Lord's feet be the lotus flower.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas un sa(n)g lapaTaio jiau boo(n)dheh chaatirak maulaa ||4||3||4||
verses.translation: Says servant Nanak, attach your mind to them, and blossom forth like the song-bird, upon finding the rain-drop. ||4||3||4||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਪਛਮ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪੂਰਬ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: mataa karai pachham kai taiee poorab hee lai jaat ||
verses.translation: He decides to go to the west, but the Lord leads him away to the east.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਮਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa aapan haath mataat ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He holds all matters in His hands. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਤ ॥
verses.translit: siaanap kaahoo kaam na aat ||
verses.translation: Cleverness is of no use at all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਅਨਰੂਪਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਬਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo anaroopio Thaakur merai hoi rahee uh baat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever my Lord and Master deems to be right - that alone comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੀਚੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: dhes kamaavan dhan joran kee manasaa beeche nikase saas ||
verses.translation: In his desire to acquire land and accumulate wealth, one's breath escapes him.

verses.original: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lasakar neb khavaas sabh tiaage jam pur uooTh sidhaas ||2||
verses.translation: He must leave all his armies, assistants and servants; rising up, he departs to the City of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਮਨਹਠ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: hoi ana(n)n manahaTh kee dhiraRataa aapas kau jaanaat ||
verses.translation: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਅਨਿੰਦੁ ਨਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo ani(n)dh ni(n)dh kar chhoddio soiee fir fir khaat ||3||
verses.translation: That food, which the blameless people have condemned and discarded, he eats again and again. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai bhe kirapaalaa tis jan kee kaaTee faas ||
verses.translation: One, unto whom the Lord shows His natural mercy, has the noose of Death cut away from him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur pooraa bheTiaa paravaan girasat udhaas ||4||4||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets the Perfect Guru, is celebrated as a householder as well as a renunciate. ||4||4||5||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan jin jan japio tin ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, have their bonds broken.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa bikh mamataa ieh biaadh te haaTe ||1||
verses.translation: Sexual desirer, anger, the poison of Maya and egotism - they are rid of these afflictions. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: har jas saadhasa(n)g mil gaio ||
verses.translation: One who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chants the Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh bhio man niramal sarab sukhaa sukh paiaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: has his mind purified, by Guru's Grace, and he obtains the joy of all joys. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਓ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh keeo soiee bhal maanai aaisee bhagat kamaanee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, he sees that as good; such is the devotional service he performs.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mitr satr sabh ek samaane jog jugat neesaanee ||2||
verses.translation: He sees friends and enemies as all the same; this is the sign of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio srab thaiee aan na katahoo(n) jaataa ||
verses.translation: The all-pervading Lord is fully filling all places; why should I go anywhere else?

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar ra(n)g ravio ra(n)g raataa ||3||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading within each and every heart; I am immersed in His Love, dyed in the color of His Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal dhiaal gupaalaa taa nirabhai kai ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe becomes kind and compassionate, then one enters the home of the Fearless Lord.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTe khin bheetar naanak sahaj samaiaa ||4||5||6||
verses.translation: His troubles and worries are ended in an instant; O Nanak, he merges in celestial peace. ||4||5||6||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੋ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis maanukh peh karau benatee so apanai dhukh bhariaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever I approach to ask for help, I find him full of his own troubles.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jin ridhai araadhiaa tin bhau saagar tariaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who worships in his heart the Supreme Lord God, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur har bin ko na birathaa dhukh kaaTai ||
verses.translation: No one, except the Guru-Lord, can dispel our pain and sorrow.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਾਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh taj avar sevak je hoiee hai tit maan mahat jas ghaaTai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forsaking God, and serving another, one's honor, dignity and reputation are decreased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਸੈਨ ਸਾਕ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ke sanaba(n)dh sain saak kit hee kaam na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Relatives, relations and family bound through Maya are of no avail.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਊਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kaa dhaas neech kul uoochaa tis sa(n)g man baa(n)chhat fal paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant, although of lowly birth, is exalted. Associating with him, one obtains the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
verses.translit: laakh koT bikhiaa ke bi(n)jan taa meh tirasan na boojhee ||
verses.translation: Through corruption, one may obtain thousands and millions of enjoyments, but even so, his desires are not satisfied through them.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simarat naam koT ujeeaaraa basat agochar soojhee ||3||
verses.translation: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of lights appear, and the incomprehensible is understood. ||3||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat tum(h)rai dhuaar aaiaa bhai bha(n)jan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming around, I have come to Your Door, Destroyer of fear, O Lord King.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
verses.translit: saadh ke charan dhoor jan baachhai sukh naanak ih paiaa ||4||6||7||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of the Holy; in it, he finds peace. ||4||6||7||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa pa(n)chapadhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Pada, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਗਰਭ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਾਸਾ ਊਹਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prathame garabh maataa kai vaasaa uoohaa chhodd dharan meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: First, he came to dwell in his mother's womb; leaving it, he came into the world.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chitr saal su(n)dhar baag ma(n)dhar sa(n)g na kachhahoo jaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Splendid mansions, beautiful gardens and palaces - none of these shall go with him. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭ ਲਬੀ ॥
verses.translit: avar sabh mithiaa lobh labee ||
verses.translation: All other greeds of the greedy are false.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਫਬੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai dheeo har naamaa jeea kau ehaa vasat fabee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, which my soul has come to treasure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਰਚਿ ਹਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eisaT meet ba(n)dhap sut bhaiee sa(n)g banitaa rach hasiaa ||
verses.translation: Surrounded by dear friends, relatives, children, siblings and spouse, he laughs playfully.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਉਨੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab a(n)tee aausar aai banio hai un(h) pekhat hee kaal grasiaa ||2||
verses.translation: But when the very last moment arrives, Death seizes him, while they merely look on. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਬਿਹਾਝੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਦਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar anarath bihaajhee sa(n)pai suinaa roopaa dhaamaa ||
verses.translation: By continual oppression and exploitation, he accumulates wealth, gold, silver and money,

verses.original: ਭਾੜੀ ਕਉ ਓਹੁ ਭਾੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaaRee kau oh bhaaRaa miliaa hor sagal bhio biraanaa ||3||
verses.translation: but the load-bearer gets only paltry wages, while the rest of the money passes on to others. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਰਥ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: haivar gaivar rath sa(n)baahe gahu kar keene mere ||
verses.translation: He grabs and collects horses, elephants and chariots, and claims them as his own.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਂਮੀ ਧਾਈ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jab te hoiee laa(n)mee dhaiee chaleh naahee ik paire ||4||
verses.translation: But when he sets out on the long journey, they will not go even one step with him. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhan naam sukh raajaa naam kuTa(n)b sahaiee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my wealth; the Naam is my princely pleasure; the Naam is my family and helper.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਈ ਓਹ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)pat gur naanak kau dheeiee oh marai na aavai jaiee ||5||1||8||
verses.translation: The Guru has given Nanak the wealth of the Naam; it neither perishes, nor comes or goes. ||5||1||8||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa tipadhe ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Thi-Padhay, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase sukh keeaa nivaasaa tirasanaa jalan bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: My sorrows are ended, and I am filled with peace. The fire of desire within me has been quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan satiguroo dhiraRaiaa binas na aavai jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it neither dies, nor goes anywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jap maiaa ba(n)dhan tooTe ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal dhiaal prabh mere saadhasa(n)gat mil chhooTe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When my God becomes kind and compassionate, one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har ke gun gaavai bhagat prem ras maataa ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, absorbed in loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: harakh sog dhuh maeh niraalaa karanaihaar pachhaataa ||2||
verses.translation: He remains unaffected by both fortune and misfortune, and he recognizes the Creator Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leeaa sagal jugat ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord saves those who belong to Him, and all pathways are opened to them.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh purakh dhiaalaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||3||1||9||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the value of the Merciful Lord God cannot be described. ||3||1||9||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: patit pavitr le'ee kar apune sagal karat namasakaaro ||
verses.translation: The Lord has sanctified the sinners and made them His own; all bow in reverence to Him.

verses.original: ਬਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਛੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਵਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baran jaat kouoo poochhai naahee baachheh charan ravaaro ||1||
verses.translation: No one asks about their ancestry and social status; instead, they yearn for the dust of their feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਐਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur aaiso naam tum(h)aaro ||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, such is Your Name.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਹੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਕੋ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sirasaT ko dhanee kaheejai jan ko a(n)g niraaro ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are called the Lord of all creation; You give Your unique support to Your servant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak budh paiee har keeratan aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained understanding; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is his only support.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚੰਮਿਆਰੋ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naamadheau tiralochan kabeer dhaasaro mukat bhio cha(n)miaaro ||2||1||10||
verses.translation: The Lord's servants, Naam Dayv, Trilochan, Kabeer and Ravi Daas the shoe-maker have been liberated. ||2||1||10||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: hai naahee kouoo boojhanahaaro jaanai kavan bhataa ||
verses.translation: No one understands the Lord; who can understand His plans?

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਹਿ ਗਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: siv bira(n)ch ar sagal mon jan geh na sakaeh gataa ||1||
verses.translation: Shiva, Brahma and all the silent sages cannot understand the state of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee agam agaadh kathaa ||
verses.translation: God's sermon is profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਅਵਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਬਕਨ ਕਥਨ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suneeaai avar avar bidh bujheeaai bakan kathan rahataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is heard to be one thing, but He is understood to be something else again; He is beyond description and explanation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhagataa aap suaamee aapan sa(n)g rataa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the devotee, and He Himself is the Lord and Master; He is imbued with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ko prabh poor rahio hai pekhio jatr kataa ||2||2||11||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is pervading and permeating everywhere; wherever he looks, He is there. ||2||2||11||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: mataa masoorat avar siaanap jan kau kachhoo na aaio ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord has no plans, politics or other clever tricks.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh aausar aai banio hai tahaa tahaa har dhiaaio ||1||
verses.translation: Whenever the occasion arises, there, he meditates on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ko bhagat vachhal biradhaio ||
verses.translation: It is the very nature of God to love His devotees;

verses.original: ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kare pratipaal baarik kee niaaiee jan kau laadd laddaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He cherishes His servant, and caresses him as His own child. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam karam dharam har keeratan jan gaio ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant sings the Kirtan of His Praises as his worship, deep meditation, self-discipline and religious observances.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: saran pario naanak Thaakur kee abhai dhaan sukh paio ||2||3||12||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, and has received the blessings of fearlessness and peace. ||2||3||12||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਢੀਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhin raatee aaraadhahu piaaro nimakh na keejai ddeelaa ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord in adoration, day and night, O my dear - do not delay for a moment.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਹਾਠੀਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sevaa kar bhaavanee laieeaai tiaag maan haaTheelaa ||1||
verses.translation: Serve the Saints with loving faith, and set aside your pride and stubbornness. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਰਾਗੀਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan praan maan raageelaa ||
verses.translation: The fascinating, playful Lord is my very breath of life and honor.

verses.original: ਬਾਸਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baas rahio heeare kai sa(n)ge pekh mohio man leelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He abides in my heart; beholding His playful games, my mind is fascinated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਜੰਗੀਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat man hot ana(n)dhaa utarai manahu ja(n)geelaa ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him, my mind is in bliss, and the rust of my mind is removed.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੀਲਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: milabe kee mahimaa baran na saakau naanak parai pareelaa ||2||4||13||
verses.translation: The great honor of meeting the Lord cannot be described; O Nanak, it is infinite, beyond measure. ||2||4||13||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਗਿ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਸਭ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਸਿ ਅਪਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mun jogee saasatrag kahaavat sabh keen(h)e bas apanahee ||
verses.translation: They call themselves silent sages, Yogis and scholars of the Shaastras, but Maya has has them all under her control.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਕੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਹੈਰਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teen dhev ar koR teteesaa tin kee hairat kachh na rahee ||1||
verses.translation: The three gods, and the 330,000,000 demi-gods, were astonished. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਵੰਤਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: balava(n)t biaap rahee sabh mahee ||
verses.translation: The power of Maya is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar na jaanas kouoo maramaa gur kirapaa te lahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Her secret is known only by Guru's Grace - no one else knows it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਲਪਟਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeet jeet jeete sabh thaanaa sagal bhavan lapaTahee ||
verses.translation: Conquering and conquering, she has conquered everywhere, and she clings to the whole world.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੇਰੀ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak saadh te bhaagee hoi cheree charan gahee ||2||5||14||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, she surrenders to the Holy Saint; becoming his servant, she falls at his feet. ||2||5||14||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR karee bena(n)tee Thaakur apanaa dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer, meditating on my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhe paramesar sagalaa dhurat miTaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has saved me, and erased all my sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur hoe aap dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master Himself has become merciful.

verses.original: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee kaliaan aana(n)dh roop huiee hai ubare baal gupaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have been emancipated, the embodiment of bliss; I am the child of the Lord of the Universe - He has carried me across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil var naaree ma(n)gal gaiaa Thaakur kaa jaikaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting her Husband, the soul-bride sings the songs of joy, and celebrates her Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jin sabh kaa keeaa udhaar ||2||6||15||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has emancipated everyone. ||2||6||15||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa bhaiee sut ba(n)dhap tin kaa bal hai thoraa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, siblings, children and relatives - their power is insignificant.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਪੇਖੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g maiaa ke pekhe kichh saath na chaalai bhoraa ||1||
verses.translation: I have seen the many pleasures of Maya, but none goes with them in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur tujh bin aaeh na moraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, other than You, no one is mine.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਆਹਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਧੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh anaath niragun gun naahee mai aahio tum(h)raa dhoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a worthless orphan, devoid of merit; I long for Your Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਜੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal bal bal charan tum(h)aare ieehaa uoohaa tum(h)aaraa joraa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Your lotus feet; here and hereafter, Yours is the only power.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak dharas paio binasio sagal nihoraa ||2||7||16||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my obligations to all others are annulled. ||2||7||16||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aal jaal bhram moh tajaavai prabh setee ra(n)g laiee ||
verses.translation: He rids us of entanglements, doubt and emotional attachment, and leads us to love God.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man kau ieh upadhes dhiraRaavai sahaj sahaj gun gaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He implants this instruction in our minds, for us to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in peace and poise. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਐਸੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saajan aaiso sa(n)t sahaiee ||
verses.translation: O friend, the Saintly Guru is such a helper.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis bheTe tooTeh maiaa ba(n)dh bisar na kabahoo(n) jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting Him, the bonds of Maya are released, and one never forgets the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਇਹ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: karat karat anik bahu bhaatee neekee ieh Thaharaiee ||
verses.translation: Practicing, practicing various actions in so many ways, I came to recognize this as the best way.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo har jas gaavai naanak bhavajal paar paraiee ||2||8||17||
verses.translation: Joining the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||8||17||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa keemat jai na karee ||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; His value cannot be described.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੀਚਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raajaa ra(n)k karai khin bheetar neecheh jot dharee ||1||
verses.translation: He turns the king into a beggar in an instant, and He infuses splendor into the lowly. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਪਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaaieeaai apano sadhaa haree ||
verses.translation: Meditate forever on Your Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋਚ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soch a(n)dhesaa taa kaa kahaa kareeaai jaa meh ek gharee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why should I feel worry or anxiety, when I am here for only a short time. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਪਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree Tek poore mere satigur man saran tum(h)aarai paree ||
verses.translation: You are my support, O my Perfect True Guru; my mind has taken to the protection of Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਨੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: achet iaane baarik naanak ham tum raakhahu dhaar karee ||2||9||18||
verses.translation: Nanak, I am a foolish and ignorant child; reach out to me with Your hand, Lord, and save me. ||2||9||18||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa basahu mere man maahee ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of all beings; please, come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਤਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal ridh maeh samaae teh bharam a(n)dheraa naahee ||1||
verses.translation: That heart, within which Your lotus feet are enshrined, suffers no darkness or doubt. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur jaa simaraa too(n) taahee ||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, wherever I remember You, there I find You.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa sarab pratipaalak prabh kau sadhaa salaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to me, O God, Cherisher of all, that I may sing Your Praises forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas teraa naam samaarau tum hee kau prabh aahee ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I contemplate Your Name; O God, I long for You alone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਭਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਸ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ਲਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak Tek bhiee karate kee hor aas biddaanee laahee ||2||10||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my support is the Creator Lord; I have renounced all other hopes. ||2||10||19||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanaa dharas dheejai jas gaavau nis ar bhor ||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to me, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I sing Your Praises night and day.

verses.original: ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kes sa(n)g dhaas pag jhaarau ihai manorath mor ||1||
verses.translation: With my hair, I wash the feet of Your slave; this is my life's purpose. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਆ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur tujh bin beeaa na hor ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਅਰਾਧਉ ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chit chitavau har rasan araadhau nirakhau tumaree or ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, in my mind I remain conscious of You; with my tongue I worship You, and with my eyes, I gaze upon You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal purakh sarab ke Thaakur binau karau kar jor ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, O Lord and Master of all, with my palms pressed together I pray to You.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਆਖੀ ਫੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naam japai naanak dhaas tumaro udharas aakhee for ||2||11||20||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, chants Your Name, and is redeemed in the twinkling of an eye. ||2||11||20||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਆਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: braham lok ar rudhr lok aaiee i(n)dhr lok te dhai ||
verses.translation: Overwhelming the realm of Brahma, the realm of Shiva and the realm of Indra, Maya has come running here.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kau joh na saakai mal mal dhovai pai ||1||
verses.translation: But she cannot touch the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; she washes and massages their feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh aai pario saranai ||
verses.translation: Now, I have come and entered the Lord's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਹਜ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: guhaj paavako bahut prajaarai mo kau satigur dheeo hai batai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This awful fire has burned so many; the True Guru has cautioned me about it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਰਹੀ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik ar jakhaye ki(n)nar nar rahee ka(n)Th urajhai ||
verses.translation: It clings to the necks of the Siddhas, and the seekers, the demi-gods, angels and mortals.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਐਸੀ ਦਾਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak a(n)g keeaa prabh karatai jaa kai koT aaisee dhaasai ||2||12||21||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has the support of God the Creator, who has millions of slaves like her. ||2||12||21||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: apajas miTai hovai jag keerat dharageh baisan paieeaai ||
verses.translation: His bad reputation is erased, he is acclaimed all over the world, and he obtains a seat in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jam kee traas naas hoi khin meh sukh anadh setee ghar jaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: The fear of death is removed in an instant, and he goes to the Lord's House in peace and bliss. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te ghaal na birathee jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: His works do not go in vain.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar simarahu prabh apanaa man tan sadhaa dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, remember your God in meditation; meditate on Him continually in your mind and body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: moh saran dheen dhukh bha(n)jan too(n) dheh soiee prabh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; whatever You give me, God, that is what I receive.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਹ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: charan kamal naanak ra(n)g raate har dhaaseh paij rakhaieeaai ||2||13||22||
verses.translation: Nanak is imbued with the love of Your lotus feet; O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slave. ||2||13||22||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bisavai(n)bhar jeean ko dhaataa bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The all-sustaining Lord is the Giver of all beings; His devotional worship is an overflowing treasure.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sevaa nifal na hovat khin meh kare udhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Service to Him is not wasted; in an instant, He emancipates. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere charan kamal sa(n)g raach ||
verses.translation: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal jeea jaa kau aaraadheh taahoo kau too(n) jaach ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Seek from Him, who is worshipped by all beings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saran tum(h)aaree karate too(n) prabh praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Creator Lord; You, O God, are the support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: hoi sahaiee jis too(n) raakheh tis kahaa kare sa(n)saar ||2||14||23||
verses.translation: He who is protected by You, O Helper Lord - what can the world do to him? ||2||14||23||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee paij savaaree aap ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has protected the honor of His humble servant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheeo gur avakhadh utar gio sabh taap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given the medicine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, and all afflictions are gone. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: harigobi(n)dh rakhio paramesar apunee kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord, in His Mercy, has preserved Har Gobind.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੀ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: miTee biaadh sarab sukh hoe har gun sadhaa beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: The disease is over, and there is joy all around; we ever contemplate the Glories of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo merai karatai gur poore kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: My Creator Lord has made me His own; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: abichal neev dharee gur naanak nit nit chaRai savaiee ||2||15||24||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak laid the immovable foundation, which grows higher and higher each day. ||2||15||24||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo har siau cheet na laio ||
verses.translation: You never focused your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਉਧਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa karat bihaanee aaudheh gun nidh naam na gaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have spent your life engaged in worldly pursuits; you have not sung the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਤ ਕਪਟੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kauddee kauddee jorat kapaTe anik jugat kar dhaio ||
verses.translation: Shell by shell, you accumulate money; in various ways, you work for this.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisarat prabh kete dhukh gane'eeh mahaa mohanee khaio ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting God, you suffer awful pain beyond measure, and you are consumed by the Great Enticer, Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਨਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere ganahu na moh kamaio ||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to me, O my Lord and Master, and do not hold me to account for my actions.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh dhiaal kirapaal sukh saagar naanak har saranaio ||2||16||25||
verses.translation: O merciful and compassionate Lord God, ocean of peace, Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||16||25||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam raam rava(n)t ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, chant the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd aan biauhaar mithiaa bhaj sadhaa bhagava(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renounce other false occupations, and vibrate forever on the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਈਤ ਆਗੈ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: naam ek adhaar bhagataa ieet aagai Tek ||
verses.translation: The One Name is the support of His devotees; in this world, and in the world hereafter, it is their anchor and support.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gobi(n)dh dheeaa gur giaan budh bibek ||1||
verses.translation: In His mercy and kindness, the Guru has given me the divine wisdom of God, and a discriminating intellect. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran sa(n)mrath sreedhar saran taa kee gahee ||
verses.translation: The all-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is the Master of wealth - I seek His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਵਾਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: mukat jugat ravaal saadhoo naanak har nidh lahee ||2||17||26||
verses.translation: Liberation and worldly success come from the dust of the feet of the Holy Saints; Nanak has obtained the Lord's treasure. ||2||17||26||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd sagal siaanapaa saadh saranee aau ||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and seek the Sanctuary of the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesaro prabhoo ke gun gaau ||1||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: re chit charan kamal araadh ||
verses.translation: O my consciousness, contemplate and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh kaliaan paaveh miTai sagal upaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain total peace and salvation, and all troubles shall depart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut meet bhaiee tis binaa nahee koi ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children, friends and siblings - without the Lord, none of them are real.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot jeea naal sa(n)gee sarab raviaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, He is the companion of the soul; He is pervading everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: koT jatan upaav mithiaa kachh na aavai kaam ||
verses.translation: Millions of plans, tricks, and efforts are of no use, and serve no purpose.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saran saadhoo niramalaa gat hoi prabh kai naam ||3||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure, and obtains salvation, through the Name of God. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਊਚਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: agam dhiaal prabhoo uoochaa saran saadhoo jog ||
verses.translation: God is profound and merciful, lofty and exalted; He gives Sanctuary to the Holy.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: tis paraapat naanakaa jis likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||4||1||27||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Lord, O Nanak, who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny to meet Him. ||4||1||27||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa gur sev sadh hee ramahu gun gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Serve your Guru forever, and chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saas saas araadh har har leh jai man kee chi(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, worship the Lord, Har, Har, in adoration, and the anxiety of your mind will be dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jaap prabh kaa naau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of God.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj ana(n)dh paaveh milee niramal thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall be blessed with peace, poise and pleasure, and you shall find the immaculate place. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g udhaar ih man aaTh pahar aaraadh ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, redeem your mind, and adore the Lord, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar binasai miTai sagal upaadh ||2||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and egotism will be dispelled, and all troubles shall end. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: aTal achhedh abhedh suaamee saran taa kee aau ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is immovable, immortal and inscrutable; seek His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal araadh hiradhai ek siau liv laau ||3||
verses.translation: Worship in adoration the lotus feet of the Lord in your heart, and center your consciousness lovingly on Him alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਨੑੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh dhiaa dhaaree bakhas leen(h)e aap ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me, and He Himself has forgiven me.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: sarab sukh har naam dheeaa naanak so prabh jaap ||4||2||28||
verses.translation: The Lord has given me His Name, the treasure of peace; O Nanak, meditate on that God. ||4||2||28||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਈ ਸੰਕਾ ਤੂਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadhee prabh dhiaaiaa giee sa(n)kaa tooT ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on God, and my doubts are gone.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਨਿਖੂਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh aneraa bhai binaase paap ge nikhooT ||1||
verses.translation: Pain, ignorance and fear have left me, and my sins have been dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam kee man preet ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with love for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਿਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadh bachan gobi(n)dh dhiaae mahaa niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Holy Saint, under His Instruction, I meditate on the Lord of the Universe, in the most immaculate way. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap anek karanee safal simarat naam ||
verses.translation: Chanting, deep meditation and various rituals are contained in the fruitful meditative remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar anugrahu aap raakhe bhe pooran kaam ||2||
verses.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have been brought to fruition. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas na bisar kabahoo(n) braham prabh samarath ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, may I never forget You, O God, Almighty Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਅਕਥ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun anik rasanaa kiaa bakhaanai aganat sadhaa akath ||3||
verses.translation: How can my tongue describe Your countless virtues? They are uncountable, and forever indescribable. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh nivaar taaran dhiaal kirapaa karan ||
verses.translation: You are the Remover of the pains of the poor, the Savior, the Compassionate Lord, the Bestower of Mercy.

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: aTal padhavee naam simaran dhiraR naanak har har saran ||4||3||29||
verses.translation: Remembering the Naam in meditation, the state of eternal dignity is obtained; Nanak has grasped the protection of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||29||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਘਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh bahu saghan maiaa mahaa dheeragh rog ||
verses.translation: Intellectual egotism and great love for Maya are the most serious chronic diseases.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam aaukhadh gur naam dheeno karan kaaran jog ||1||
