verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the medicine, which is potent to cure everything. The Guru has given me the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan baachheeaai jan dhoor ||
verses.translation: My mind and body yearn for the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਹਹਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam ke laheh paatik gobi(n)dh lochaa poor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With it, the sins of millions of incarnations are obliterated. O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my desire. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)te madh aasaa kookaree bikaraal ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, one is hounded by dreadful desires.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur giaan keeratan gobi(n)dh ramana(n) kaaTeeaai jam jaal ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, we sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮੂਠੇ ਸਦਾ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh mooThe sadhaa aavaa gavan ||
verses.translation: Those who are cheated by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment suffer reincarnation forever.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਮਿਟਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh prem bhagat gupaal simaran miTat jonee bhavan ||3||
verses.translation: By loving devotional worship to God, and meditative remembrance of the Lord of the World, one's wandering in reincarnation is ended. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਰ ਰਿਦ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਜਲੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: mitr putr kalatr sur ridh teen taap jala(n)t ||
verses.translation: Friends, children, spouses and well-wishers are burnt by the three fevers.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jap raam raamaa dhukh nivaare milai har jan sa(n)t ||4||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one's miseries are ended, as one meets the Saintly servants of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਧਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab bidh bhramate pukaareh kateh naahee chhoT ||
verses.translation: Wandering around in all directions, they cry out, ""Nothing can save us!""

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: har charan saran apaar prabh ke dhiraR gahee naanak oT ||5||4||30||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Infinite Lord; he holds fast to their Support. ||5||4||30||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaraadh sreedhar safal moorat karan kaaran jog ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Lord of wealth, the fulfilling vision, the Almighty Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun raman sravan apaar mahimaa fir na hot biog ||1||
verses.translation: Uttering His Praises, and hearing of His infinite glory, you shall never suffer separation from Him again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: man charanaarabi(n)dh upaas ||
verses.translation: O my mind, worship the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTa(n)t simaran kaaT jamadhoot faas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance, strife and sorrow are ended, and the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਦਹਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satr dhahan har naam kahan avar kachh na upaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, and your enemies shall be consumed; there is no other way.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: kar anugrahu prabhoo mere naanak naam suaau ||2||1||31||
verses.translation: Show Mercy, O my God, and bestow upon Nanak the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||31||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) samarath saran ko dhaataa dhukh bha(n)jan sukh rai ||
verses.translation: You are the Almighty Lord, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Destroyer of pain, the King of happiness.

verses.original: ਜਾਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaeh kales miTe bhai bharamaa niramal gun prabh gai ||1||
verses.translation: Troubles depart, and fear and doubt are dispelled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh tujh bin avar na Thaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, without You, there is no other place.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee japee tumaaraa naau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Show Mercy to me, O Supreme Lord Master, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਲਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev lage har charanee vaddai bhaag liv laagee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, I am attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet; by great good fortune, I have embraced love for Him.

verses.original: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaval pragaas bhe saadhasa(n)ge dhuramat budh tiaagee ||2||
verses.translation: My heart lotus blossoms forth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have renounced evil-mindedness and intellectualism. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har ke gun gaavai simarai dheen dhaiaalaa ||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, and remembers the Lord in meditation, who is Kind to the poor,

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਉਧਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sa(n)gat sabh udharai binase sagal ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: saves himself, and redeems all his generations; all of his bonds are released. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan adhaar teraa prabh suaamee ot pot prabh saath ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of Your Feet, O God, O Lord and Master; you are with me through and through, God.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: saran pario naanak prabh tumaree dhe raakhio har haath ||4||2||32||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protected him. ||4||2||32||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: goojaree asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਬਰਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ek nagaree pa(n)ch chor baseeale barajat choree dhaavai ||
verses.translation: In the one village of the body, live the five thieves; they have been warned, but they still go out stealing.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਦਸ ਮਾਲ ਰਖੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirahadhas maal rakhai jo naanak mokh mukat so paavai ||1||
verses.translation: One who keeps his assets safe from the three modes and the ten passions, O Nanak, attains liberation and emancipation. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਹੁ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: chetahu baasudheau banavaalee ||
verses.translation: Center your mind on the all-pervading Lord, the Wearer of garlands of the jungles.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam ridhai japamaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Let your rosary be the chanting of the Lord's Name in your heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਰਧ ਮੂਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਲਾਹਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: auradh mool jis saakh talaahaa chaar bedh jit laage ||
verses.translation: Its roots extend upwards, and its branches reach down; the four Vedas are attached to it.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhai jai te naanak paarabraham liv jaage ||2||
verses.translation: He alone reaches this tree with ease, O Nanak, who remains wakeful in the Love of the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਤਤੁ ਡਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarajaat ghar aagan merai puhap patr tat ddaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Elysian Tree is the courtyard of my house; in it are the flowers, leaves and stems of reality.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੰਭੂ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab jot nira(n)jan sa(n)bhoo chhoddahu bahut ja(n)jaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate on the self-existent, immaculate Lord, whose Light is pervading everywhere; renounce all your worldly entanglements. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਵੰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun sikhava(n)te naanak binavai chhoddahu maiaa jaalaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O seekers of Truth - Nanak begs you to renounce the traps of Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man beechaar ek liv laagee punarap janam na kaalaa ||4||
verses.translation: Reflect within your mind, that by enshrining love for the One Lord, you shall not be subject to birth and death again. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: so guroo so sikh katheeale so vaidh j jaanai rogee ||
verses.translation: He alone is said to be a Guru, he alone is said to be a Sikh, and he alone is said to be a physician, who knows the patient's illness.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tis kaaran ka(n)m na dha(n)dhaa naahee dha(n)dhai girahee jogee ||5||
verses.translation: He is not affected by actions, responsibilities and entanglements; in the entanglements of his household, he maintains the detachment of Yoga. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar tajeeale lobh moh tis maiaa ||
verses.translation: He renounces sexual desire, anger, egotism, greed, attachment and Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man tat avigat dhiaaiaa gur parasaadhee paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Within his mind, he meditates on the reality of the Imperishable Lord; by Guru's Grace he finds Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan sabh dhaat katheeale set baran sabh dhootaa ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are all said to be God's gifts; all of the demons are turned white before him.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਮਧੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਰਸਾਦੰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: braham kamal madh taas rasaadha(n) jaagat naahee sootaa ||7||
verses.translation: He enjoys the taste of the honey of God's lotus; he remains awake, and does not fall asleep. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ga(n)bheer patr paataalaa naanak sarab juaaiaa ||
verses.translation: This lotus is very deep; its leaves are the nether regions, and it is connected to the whole universe.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਮ ਪੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੰ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: aupadhes guroo mam puneh na garabha(n) bikh taj a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||8||1||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I shall not have to enter the womb again; I have renounced the poison of corruption, and I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਰਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kavan jaacheh prabh dhaate taa ke a(n)t na pareh sumaar ||
verses.translation: Those who beg of God the Great Giver - their numbers cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaisee bhookh hoi abh a(n)tar too(n) samarath sach dhevanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee jap tap sa(n)jam sach adhaar ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline and truth are my foundations.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheh sukh paieeaai teree bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Name, Lord, that I may find peace. Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n samaadh raheh liv laage ekaa ekee sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Some remain absorbed in Samaadhi, their minds fixed lovingly on the One Lord; they reflect only on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal thal dharan gagan teh naahee aape aap keeaa karataar ||2||
verses.translation: In that state, there is no water, land, earth or sky; only the Creator Lord Himself exists. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naa tadh maiaa magan na chhaiaa naa sooraj cha(n)dh na jot apaar ||
verses.translation: There is no intoxication of Maya there, and no shadow, nor the infinite light of the sun or the moon.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab dhirasaT lochan abh a(n)tar ekaa nadhar su tirabhavan saar ||3||
verses.translation: The eyes within the mind which see everything - with one glance, they see the three worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਅਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: pavan paanee agan tin keeaa brahamaa bisan mahes akaar ||
verses.translation: He created air, water and fire, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva - the whole creation.

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sarabe jaachik too(n) prabh dhaataa dhaat kare apunai beechaar ||4||
verses.translation: All are beggars; You alone are the Great Giver, God. You give Your gifts according to Your own considerations. ||4||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਇਕ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: koT tetees jaacheh prabh naik dhedhe toT naahee bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Three hundred thirty million gods beg of God the Master; even as He gives, His treasures are never exhausted.

verses.original: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੀਧੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰੈ ਨਿਹਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dhai bhaa(n)ddai kachh na samaavai seedhai a(n)mrit parai nihaar ||5||
verses.translation: Nothing can be contained in a vessel turned upside-down; Ambrosial Nectar pours into the upright one. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾਚਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sidh samaadhee a(n)tar jaacheh ridh sidh jaach kareh jaikaar ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi beg for wealth and miracles, and proclaim His victory.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaisee piaas hoi man a(n)tar taiso jal dheveh parakaar ||6||
verses.translation: As is the thirst within their minds, so is the water which You give to them. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: badde bhaag gur seveh apunaa bhedh naahee gurdhev muraar ||
verses.translation: The most fortunate ones serve their Guru; there is no difference between the Divine Guru and the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: taa kau kaal naahee jam johai boojheh a(n)tar sabadh beechaar ||7||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot see those who come to realize within their minds the contemplative meditation of the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ab tab avar na maagau har peh naam nira(n)jan dheejai piaar ||
verses.translation: I shall never ask anything else of the Lord; please, bless me with the Love of Your Immaculate Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak chaatirak a(n)mirat jal maagai har jas dheejai kirapaa dhaar ||8||2||
verses.translation: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the Ambrosial Water; O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon him, and bless him with Your Praise. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee janam marai aavai fun jaavai bin gur gat nahee kaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, he is born, and then dies; he continues coming and going; without the Guru, he is not emancipated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh praanee naame raate naame gat pat paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those mortals who become Gurmukhs are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Name, they obtain salvation and honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re raam naam chit laiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, focus your consciousness lovingly on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੇ ਐਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har prabh jaache aaisee naam baddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one begs of the Lord God; such is the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਕੇਤੇ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee bahute bhekh kareh bhikhiaa kau kete udhar bharan kai taiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, so many wear various religious robes, for begging and filling their bellies.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin har bhagat naahee sukh praanee bin gur garab na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship to the Lord, O mortal, there can be no peace. Without the Guru, pride does not depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee kaal sadhaa sir uoopar Thaadde janam janam vairaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, death hangs constantly over his head. Incarnation after incarnation, it is his enemy.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਬਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh rate se baache satigur boojh bujhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad are saved. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee joh na saakai dhoot na sakai sa(n)taiee ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Messenger of Death cannot see the mortal, or torture him.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: avigat naath nira(n)jan raate nirabhau siau liv laiee ||4||
verses.translation: I am imbued with the Imperishable and Immaculate Lord Master, and lovingly attached to the Fearless Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jeeau naam dhiRahu naame liv laavahu satigur Tek Tikaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, implant the Naam within me; lovingly attached to the Naam, I lean on the True Guru's Support.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee kirat na meTiaa jaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, He does; no one can erase His actions. ||5||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee bhaag pare gur saran tum(h)aaree mai avar na dhoojee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Guru; I have no love for any other except You.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਉ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ab tab eko ek pukaarau aadh jugaadh sakhaiee ||6||
verses.translation: I constantly call upon the One Lord; since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He has been my help and support. ||6||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee raakhahu paij naam apune kee tujh hee siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, please preserve the Honor of Your Name; I am hand and glove with You.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gur dharas dhikhaavahu haumai sabadh jalaiee ||7||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Mercy, and reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Guru. Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away my ego. ||7||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee kiaa maagau kichh rahai na dheesai is jag meh aaiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, what should I ask of You? Nothing appears permanent; whoever comes into this world shall depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam padhaarath dheejai hiradhai ka(n)Th banaiee ||8||3||
verses.translation: Bless Nanak with the wealth of the Naam, to adorn his heart and neck. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਮ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਮਧਿਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee naa ham utam neech na madhim har saranaagat har ke log ||
verses.translation: O Dear One, I am not high or low or in the middle. I am the Lord's slave, and I seek the Lord's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਜੋਗ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam rate keval bairaagee sog bijog bisarajit rog ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am detached from the world; I have forgotten sorrow, separation and disease. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gur kirapaa te bhagat Thaakur kee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, by Guru's Grace, I perform devotional worship to my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vaak hiradhai har niramal naa jam kaan na jam kee baakee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Hymns of the True Guru, obtains the Pure Lord. He is not under the power of the Messenger of Death, nor does he owe Death anything. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨ ਰਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har gun rasan raveh prabh sa(n)ge jo tis bhaavai sahaj haree ||
verses.translation: He chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord with his tongue, and abides with God; he does whatever pleases the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮੇਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin har naam birathaa jag jeevan har bin nihafal mek gharee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, life passes in vain in the world, and every moment is useless. ||2||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee khoTe Thaur naahee ghar baahar ni(n)dhak gat nahee kaiee ||
verses.translation: The false have no place of rest, either inside or outside; the slanderer does not find salvation.

verses.original: ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ros karai prabh bakhas na meTai nit nit chaRai savaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Even if one is resentful, God does not withhold His blessings; day by day, they increase. ||3||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee gur kee dhaat na meTai koiee merai Thaakur aap dhivaiee ||
verses.translation: No one can take away the Guru's gifts; my Lord and Master Himself has given them.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਰ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak nar kaale mukh ni(n)dhaa jin(h) gur kee dhaat na bhaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The black-faced slanderers, with slander in their mouths, do not appreciate the Guru's gifts. ||4||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਅਧੂਆ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee saran pare prabh bakhas milaavai bilam na adhooaa raiee ||
verses.translation: God forgives and blends with Himself those who take to His Sanctuary; He does not delay for an instant.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aanadh mool naath sir naathaa satigur mel milaiee ||5||
verses.translation: He is the source of bliss, the Greatest Lord; through the True Guru, we are united in His Union. ||5||

verses.original: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aai jee sadhaa dhiaal dhiaa kar raviaa gurmat bhraman chukaiee ||
verses.translation: Through His Kindness, the Kind Lord pervades us; through Guru's Teachings, our wanderings cease.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: paaras bheT ka(n)chan dhaat hoiee satasa(n)gat kee vaddiaaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, metal is transformed into gold. Such is the glorious greatness of the Society of the Saints. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jal niramal man isanaanee majan satigur bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the immaculate water; the mind is the bather, and the True Guru is the bath attendant, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: punarap janam naahee jan sa(n)gat jotee jot milaiee ||7||
verses.translation: That humble being who joins the Sat Sangat shall not be consigned to reincarnation again; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਰੋਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) vadd purakh aga(n)m tarovar ham pa(n)khee tujh maahee ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Primal Lord, the infinite tree of life; I am a bird perched on Your branches.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nira(n)jan dheejai jug jug sabadh salaahee ||8||4||
verses.translation: Grant to Nanak the Immaculate Naam; throughout the ages, he sings the Praises of the Shabad. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਆਰਾਧਿਤੰ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਰਮ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat prem aaraadhita(n) sach piaas param hita(n) ||
verses.translation: The devotees worship the Lord in loving adoration. They thirst for the True Lord, with infinite affection.

verses.original: ਬਿਲਲਾਪ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਨੰਤੀਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਹਿਤੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bilalaap bilal bina(n)teeaa sukh bhai chit hita(n) ||1||
verses.translation: They tearfully beg and implore the Lord; in love and affection, their consciousness is at peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap man naam har saranee ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and take to His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar taar taaran ram naam kar karanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the boat to cross over the world-ocean. Practice such a way of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਿਰਤ ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: e man mirat subh chi(n)ta(n) gur sabadh har ramana(n) ||
verses.translation: O mind, even death wishes you well, when you remember the Lord through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਨਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mat tat giaana(n) kaliaan nidhaana(n) har naam man ramana(n) ||2||
verses.translation: The intellect receives the treasure, the knowledge of reality and supreme bliss, by repeating the Lord's Name in the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: chal chit vit bhramaa bhrama(n) jag moh magan hita(n) ||
verses.translation: The fickle consciousness wanders around chasing after wealth; it is intoxicated with worldly love and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿੜੰ ਮਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਤੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thir naam bhagat dhiRa(n) matee gur vaak sabadh rata(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Devotion to the Naam is permanently implanted within the mind, when it is attuned to the Guru's Teachings and His Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਰਮਾਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਖਪੰ ॥
verses.translit: bharamaat bharam na chookiee jag janam biaadh khapa(n) ||
verses.translation: Wandering around, doubt is not dispelled; afflicted by reincarnation, the world is being ruined.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੰ ਸਤਿ ਮਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਤਪੰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: asathaan har nihakevala(n) sat matee naam tapa(n) ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord's eternal throne is free of this affliction; he is truly wise, who takes the Naam as his deep meditation. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag moh het biaapita(n) dhukh adhik janam marana(n) ||
verses.translation: This world is engrossed in attachment and transitory love; it suffers the terrible pains of birth and death.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਊਬਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhaj saran satigur uoobareh har naam ridh ramana(n) ||5||
verses.translation: Run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, chant the Lord's Name in your heart, and you shall swim across. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਨੰ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat nihachal man man mana(n) sahaj beechaara(n) ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teaching, the mind becomes stable; the mind accepts it, and reflects upon it in peaceful poise.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: so man niramal jit saach a(n)tar giaan ratan saara(n) ||6||
verses.translation: That mind is pure, which enshrines Truth within, and the most excellent jewel of spiritual wisdom. ||6||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਮਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai bhagat tar bhavajal manaa chit lai har charanee ||
verses.translation: By the Fear of God, and Love of God, and by devotion, man crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, focusing his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har naam hiradhai pavitr paavan ih sareer tau saranee ||7||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh lahar nivaarana(n) har naam raas mana(n) ||
verses.translation: The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: man maar tuhee nira(n)janaa kahu naanakaa sarana(n) ||8||1||5||
verses.translation: Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||8||1||5||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nirat karee ih man nachaiee ||
verses.translation: I dance, and make this mind dance as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee aap gavaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.

verses.original: ਚਿਤੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chit thir raakhai so mukat hovai jo ichhee soiee fal paiee ||1||
verses.translation: One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains the fruits of his desires. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਚੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: naach re man gur kai aagai ||
verses.translation: So dance, O mind, before your Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai naacheh taa sukh paaveh a(n)te jam bhau bhaagai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, the fear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap nachaae so bhagat kaheeaai aapanaa piaar aap laae ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links us to His Love.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape gaavai aap sunaavai is man a(n)dhe kau maarag paae ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naachai sakat nivaarai siv ghar needh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of the Lord Shiva, where there is no sleep.

verses.original: ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਟਾਪੈ ਅਵਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sakatee ghar jagat sootaa naachai Taapai avaro gaavai manmukh bhagat na hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਖਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar virat pakh karamee naache mun jan giaan beechaaree ||
verses.translation: The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdom dance.

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik liv laagee naache jin gurmukh budh veechaaree ||4||
verses.translation: The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs, whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd trai gun naache jin laagee har liv tumaaree ||
verses.translation: The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear love for You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabhe hee naache naacheh khaanee chaaree ||5||
verses.translation: The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaaveh seiee naacheh jin gurmukh sabadh liv laae ||
verses.translation: They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: se bhagat se tat giaanee jin kau hukam manaae ||6||
verses.translation: They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of His Command. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa bhagat sache siau liv laagai bin sevaa bhagat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannot be a devotee.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai taa sabadh beechaarai taa sach paavai koiee ||7||
verses.translation: If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kai arath bahut lok naache ko viralaa tat beechaaree ||
verses.translation: So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplate reality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee soiee jan paae jin kau kirapaa tumaaree ||8||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy. ||8||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik dham saachaa veesarai saa velaa birathaa jai ||
verses.translation: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: saeh saeh sadhaa samaaleeaai aape bakhase kare rajai ||9||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgive you, according to His Will. ||9||

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: seiee naacheh jo tudh bhaaveh j gurmukh sabadh veechaaree ||
verses.translation: They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak se sahaj sukh paaveh jin kau nadhar tumaaree ||10||1||6||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace. ||10||1||6||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har bin jeearaa reh na sakai jiau baalak kheer adhaaree ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agam agochar prabh gurmukh paieeaai apune satigur kai balihaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man re har keerat tar taaree ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam a(n)mirat jal paieeaai jin kau kirapaa tumaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sanak sana(n)dhan naaradh mun seveh anadhin japat raheh banavaaree ||
verses.translation: Sanak, Sanandan and Naarad the sage serve You; night and day, they continue to chant Your Name, O Lord of the jungle.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saranaagat prahalaadh jan aae tin kee paij savaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Slave Prahlaad sought Your Sanctuary, and You saved his honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: alakh nira(n)jan eko varatai ekaa jot muraaree ||
verses.translation: The One unseen immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, as is the Light of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh jaachik too eko dhaataa maageh haath pasaaree ||3||
verses.translation: All are beggars, You alone are the Great Giver. Reaching out our hands, we beg from You. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee uootam baanee gaaveh akath kathaa nit niaaree ||
verses.translation: The speech of the humble devotees is sublime; they sing continually the wondrous, Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: safal janam bhiaa tin keraa aap tare kul taaree ||4||
verses.translation: Their lives become fruitful; they save themselves, and all their generations. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhubidhaa dhuramat biaape jin a(n)tar moh gubaaree ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in duality and evil-mindedness; within them is the darkness of attachment.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee kathaa na bhaavai oi ddoobe san paravaaree ||5||
verses.translation: They do not love the sermon of the humble Saints, and they are drowned along with their families. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਲਭਖੁ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak ni(n)dhaa kar mal dhovai oh malabhakh maiaadhaaree ||
verses.translation: By slandering, the slanderer washes the filth off others; he is an eater of filth, and a worshipper of Maya.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)dhaa viaape naa uravaar na paaree ||6||
verses.translation: He indulges in the slander of the humble Saints; he is neither on this shore, nor the shore beyond. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eh parapa(n)ch khel keeaa sabh karatai har karatai sabh kal dhaaree ||
verses.translation: All this worldly drama is set in motion by the Creator Lord; He has infused His almighty strength into all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har eko soot varatai jug a(n)tar soot khi(n)chai eka(n)kaaree ||7||
verses.translation: The thread of the One Lord runs through the world; when He pulls out this thread, the One Creator alone remains. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: rasan rasan ras gaaveh har gun rasanaa har ras dhaaree ||
verses.translation: With their tongues, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and savor Them. They place the sublime essence of the Lord upon their tongues, and savor it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak har bin avar na maagau har ras preet piaaree ||8||1||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, other than the Lord, I ask for nothing else; I am in love with the Love of the Lord's sublime essence. ||8||1||7||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੂਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: raajan meh too(n) raajaa kahe'eeh bhooman meh bhoomaa ||
verses.translation: Among kings, You are called the King. Among land-lords, You are the Land-lord.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੋਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੋਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: Thaakur meh Thakuraiee teree koman sir komaa ||1||
verses.translation: Among masters, You are the Master. Among tribes, Yours is the Supreme Tribe. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਡੋ ਧਨੀ ਅਗਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa mero baddo dhanee agamaa ||
verses.translation: My Father is wealthy, deep and profound.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kavan kareejai karate pekh rahe bisamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What praises should I chant, O Creator Lord? Beholding You, I am wonder-struck. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਦਾਤਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukheean meh sukheeaa too(n) kahe'eeh dhaatan sir dhaataa ||
verses.translation: Among the peaceful, You are called the Peaceful One. Among givers, You are the Greatest Giver.

verses.original: ਤੇਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਜਵੰਸੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਰਸੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tejan meh tejava(n)see kahe'eeh raseean meh raataa ||2||
verses.translation: Among the glorious, You are said to be the Most Glorious. Among revellers, You are the Reveller. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sooran meh sooraa too(n) kahe'eeh bhogan meh bhogee ||
verses.translation: Among warriors, You are called the Warrior. Among indulgers, You are the Indulger.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਸਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਡੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੀ ਜੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: grasatan meh too(n) baddo girahasatee jogan meh jogee ||3||
verses.translation: Among householders, You are the Great Householder. Among yogis, You are the Yogi. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਚਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karatan meh too(n) karataa kahe'eeh aachaaran meh aachaaree ||
verses.translation: Among creators, You are called the Creator. Among the cultured, You are the Cultured One.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saahan meh too(n) saachaa saahaa vaapaaran meh vaapaaree ||4||
verses.translation: Among bankers, You are the True Banker. Among merchants, You are the Merchant. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਰਬਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਸਰਨ ਪਾਲਨ ਟੀਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharabaaran meh tero dharabaaraa saran paalan Teekaa ||
verses.translation: Among courts, Yours is the Court. Yours is the Most Sublime of Sanctuaries.

verses.original: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਸੀਕਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: lakhimee ketak ganee na jaieeaai gan na sakau seekaa ||5||
verses.translation: The extent of Your wealth cannot be determined. Your Coins cannot be counted. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ਗਿਆਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: naaman meh tero prabh naamaa giaanan meh giaanee ||
verses.translation: Among names, Your Name, God, is the most respected. Among the wise, You are the Wisest.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਇਸਨਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jugatan meh teree prabh jugataa isanaanan meh isanaanee ||6||
verses.translation: Among ways, Yours, God, is the Best Way. Among purifying baths, Yours is the Most Purifying. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਿਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਧਾ ਕਰਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: sidhan meh teree prabh sidhaa karaman sir karamaa ||
verses.translation: Among spiritual powers, Yours, O God, are the Spiritual Powers. Among actions, Yours are the Greatest Actions.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aagiaa meh teree prabh aagiaa hukaman sir hukamaa ||7||
verses.translation: Among wills, Your Will, God, is the Supreme Will. Of commands, Yours is the Supreme Command. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bolaaveh tiau boleh suaamee kudharat kavan hamaaree ||
verses.translation: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak jas gaio jo prabh kee at piaaree ||8||1||8||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, sing His Praises; they are so very dear to God. ||8||1||8||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: naath narahar dheen ba(n)dhav patit paavan dhev ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Man-lion Incarnate, Companion to the poor, Divine Purifier of sinners;

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhai traas naas kirapaal gun nidh safal suaamee sev ||1||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of fear and dread, Merciful Lord Master, Treasure of Excellence, fruitful is Your service. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: har gopaal gur gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Cherisher of the World, Guru-Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੇਸਵ ਤਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran dhiaal kesav taar jag bhav si(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord. Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹਰਨ ਮਦ ਮੋਹ ਦਹਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh haran madh moh dhahan muraar man makara(n)dh ||
verses.translation: O Dispeller of sexual desire and anger, Eliminator of intoxication and attachment, Destroyer of ego, Honey of the mind;

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam maran nivaar dharaneedhar pat raakh paramaana(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: set me free from birth and death, O Sustainer of the earth, and preserve my honor, O Embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: jalat anik tara(n)g maiaa gur giaan har ridh ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The many waves of desire for Maya are burnt away, when the Guru's spiritual wisdom is enshrined in the heart, through the Guru's Mantra.

verses.original: ਛੇਦਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਚਿੰਤ ਮੇਟਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhedh aha(n)budh karunaa mai chi(n)t meT purakh ana(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: Destroy my egotism, O Merciful Lord; dispel my anxiety, O Infinite Primal Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪਲ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: simar samarath pal mahoorat prabh dhiaan sahaj samaadh ||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the Almighty Lord, every moment and every instant; meditate on God in the celestial peace of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾਚੀਐ ਰਜ ਸਾਧ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal prasa(n)n pooran jaacheeaai raj saadh ||4||
verses.translation: O Merciful to the meek, perfectly blissful Lord, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: moh mithan dhura(n)t aasaa baasanaa bikaar ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment is false, desire is filthy, and longing is corrupt.

verses.original: ਰਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: rakh dharam bharam bidhaar man te udhar har nira(n)kaar ||5||
verses.translation: Please, preserve my faith, dispel these doubts from my mind, and save me, O Formless Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਧਨਾਢਿ ਆਢਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਚੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhanaadd aadd bha(n)ddaar har nidh hot jinaa na cheer ||
verses.translation: They have become wealthy, loaded with the treasures of the Lord's riches; they were lacking even clothes.

verses.original: ਖਲ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੂੜ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: khal mugadh mooR kaTaakhaye sreedhar bhe gun mat dheer ||6||
verses.translation: The idiotic, foolish and senseless people have become virtuous and patient, receiving the Gracious Glance of the Lord of wealth. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat jagadhees jap man dhaar ridh parateet ||
verses.translation: Become Jivan-Mukta, liberated while yet alive, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and maintaining faith in Him in your heart.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸਹ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jeea dhiaa miaa sarabatr ramana(n) param ha(n)seh reet ||7||
verses.translation: Show kindness and mercy to all beings, and realize that the Lord is pervading everywhere; this is the way of life of the enlightened soul, the supreme swan. ||7||

verses.original: ਦੇਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhet dharasan sravan har jas rasan naam uchaar ||
verses.translation: He grants the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to those who listen to His Praises, and who, with their tongues, chant His Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥੫॥੧॥੧॥੨॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)g sa(n)g bhagavaan parasan prabh naanak patit udhaar ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||
verses.translation: They are part and parcel, life and limb with the Lord God; O Nanak, they feel the Touch of God, the Savior of sinners. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਸਿਕੰਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਹਿਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਉਣੀ
verses.translit: goojaree kee vaar mahalaa teejaa sika(n)dhar biraahim kee vaar kee dhunee gaaunee
verses.translation: Goojaree Ki Vaar, Third Mehla, Sung In The Tune Of The Vaar Of Sikandar & Biraahim:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih jagat mamataa muaa jeevan kee bidh naeh ||
verses.translation: This world perishing in attachment and possessiveness; no one knows the way of life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਣ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai taa(n) jeevan padhavee paeh ||
verses.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, obtains the supreme status of life.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi sadhaa sadhaa jan jeevate jo har charanee chit laeh ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Feet, live forever and ever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee man vasai gurmukh sahaj samaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Lord abides in the minds of the Gurmukhs, who merge in celestial bliss. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sahasaa dhukh hai aapai sir dha(n)dhai maar ||
verses.translation: Within the self is the pain of doubt; engrossed in worldly affairs, they are killing themselves.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai sute kabeh na jaageh maiaa moh piaar ||
verses.translation: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are in love with, and attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam na cheteh sabadh na veechaareh ih manmukh kaa aachaar ||
verses.translation: They do not think of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad. This is the conduct of the self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naam na paiaa janam birathaa gavaiaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: They do not obtain the Lord's Name, and they waste away their lives in vain; O Nanak, the Messenger of Death punishes and dishonors them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਦਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap upaion tadhahu hor na koiee ||
verses.translation: He created Himself - at that time, there was no other.

verses.original: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mataa masoorat aap kare jo kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: He consulted Himself for advice, and what He did came to pass.

verses.original: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tadhahu aakaas na paataal hai naa trai loiee ||
verses.translation: At that time, there were no Akaashic Ethers, no nether regions, nor the three worlds.

verses.original: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tadhahu aape aap nira(n)kaar hai naa opat hoiee ||
verses.translation: At that time, only the Formless Lord Himself existed - there was no creation.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau tis bhaavai tivai kare tis bin avar na koiee ||1||
verses.translation: As it pleased Him, so did He act; without Him, there was no other. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa sadhaa hai dhisai sabadh kamai ||
verses.translation: My Master is eternal. He is seen by practicing the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਉਹਾਣੀ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh aauhaanee kadhe naeh naa aavai naa jai ||
verses.translation: He never perishes; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa so seveeaai jo sabh meh rahai samai ||
verses.translation: So serve Him, forever and ever; He is contained in all.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: avar dhoojaa kiau seveeaai ja(n)mai tai mar jai ||
verses.translation: Why serve another who is born, and then dies?

verses.original: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nihafal tin kaa jeeviaa j khasam na jaaneh aapanaa avaree kau chit lai ||
verses.translation: Fruitless is the life of those who do not know their Lord and Master, and who center their consciousness on others.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੇਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ev na jaapiee karataa ketee dhei sajai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it cannot be known, how much punishment the Creator shall inflict on them. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam dhiaaieeaai sabho varatai sach ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam bujh paravaan hoi taa fal paavai sach ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one becomes acceptable, and then obtains the fruit of Truth.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee karataa firai hukamai mool na bujhiee a(n)dhaa kach nikach ||2||
verses.translation: He wanders around babbling and speaking, but he does not understand the Lord's Command at all. He is blind, the falsest of the false. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jog vijog upaion sirasaTee kaa mool rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: Creating union and separation, He laid the foundations of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee sirasaT saajeean jotee jot milaiaa ||
verses.translation: By His Command, the Lord of Light fashioned the Universe, and infused His Divine Light into it.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jotee hoo(n) sabh chaananaa satigur sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: From the Lord of Light, all light originates. The True Guru proclaims the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes trai gun sir dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, under the influence of the three dispositions, were put to their tasks.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaa mool rachaion tureeaa sukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He created the root of Maya, and the peace obtained in the fourth state of consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jap so tap j satigur bhaavai ||
verses.translation: That alone is chanting, and that alone is deep meditation, which is pleasing to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai vaddiaaiee paavai ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the True Guru, glorious greatness is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aap chhodd gur maeh samaavai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, renouncing self-conceit, one merges into the Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sikh ko viralaa levai ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who receive the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jis aap vaddiaaiee dhevai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone receives it, whom the Lord Himself blesses with glorious greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh agiaan hai bikham at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is spiritual darkness; it is very difficult and such a heavy load.

verses.original: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pathar paap bahu ladhiaa kiau tareeaai taaree ||
verses.translation: Loaded with so very many stones of sin, how can the boat cross over?

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagatee ratiaa har paar utaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Lord's devotional worship night and day are carried across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man niramalaa haumai chhadd vikaaree ||
verses.translation: Under the Instruction of the Guru's Shabad, one sheds egotism and corruption, and the mind becomes immaculate.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaaieeaai har har nisataaree ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, is our Saving Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁੜਾ ਰਾਈ ਦਸਵੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer mukat dhuaaraa sa(n)kuRaa raiee dhasavai bhai ||
verses.translation: O Kabeer, the gate of liberation is narrow, less than one-tenth of a mustard seed.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tau maigal hoi rahaa nikasiaa kiau kar jai ||
verses.translation: The mind has become as big as an elephant; how can it pass through this gate?

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur je milai tuThaa kare pasaau ||
verses.translation: If one meets such a True Guru, by His Pleasure, He shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੋਕਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukat dhuaaraa mokalaa sahaje aavau jaau ||1||
verses.translation: Then, the gate of liberation becomes wide open, and the soul easily passes through. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak mukat dhuaaraa at neekaa naan(h)aa hoi su jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the gate of liberation is very narrow; only the very tiny can pass through.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai man asathool hai kiau kar vich dhe jai ||
verses.translation: Through egotism, the mind has become bloated. How can it pass through?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai haumai giee jot rahee sabh aai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, egotism departs, and one is filled with the Divine Light.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih jeeau sadhaa mukat hai sahaje rahiaa samai ||2||
verses.translation: Then, this soul is liberated forever, and it remains absorbed in celestial bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sa(n)saar upai kai vas aapanai keetaa ||
verses.translation: God created the Universe, and He keeps it under His power.

verses.original: ਗਣਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ganatai prabhoo na paieeaai dhoojai bharameetaa ||
verses.translation: God cannot be obtained by counting; the mortal wanders in doubt.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai jeevat marai bujh sach sameetaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe haumai khoieeaai har mel mileetaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is eradicated, and one is united in the Lord's Union.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੀਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh jaanai kare aap aape vigaseetaa ||4||
verses.translation: He knows everything, and Himself does everything; beholding His Creation, He rejoices. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur siau chit na laio naam na vasio man aai ||
verses.translation: One who has not focused his consciousness on the True Guru, and into whose mind the Naam does not come

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag ivehaa jeeviaa kiaa jug meh paiaa aai ||
verses.translation: cursed is such a life. What has he gained by coming into the world?

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa khoTee raas hai ek chase meh paaj leh jai ||
verses.translation: Maya is false capital; in an instant, its false covering falls off.

verses.original: ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਤਨੁ ਸਿਆਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਦਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hathahu chhuRakee tan siaahu hoi badhan jai kumalai ||
verses.translation: When it slips from his hand, his body turns black, and his face withers away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur siau chit laiaa tin(h) sukh vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru - peace comes to abide in their minds.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaaveh ra(n)g siau har naam rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the Name of the Lord with love; they are lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur so dhan saupiaa j jeea meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru has bestowed upon them the wealth, which remains contained within their hearts.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g tisai kau agalaa va(n)nee chaRai chaRai ||1||
verses.translation: They are imbued with supreme love; its color increases day by day. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਗਨੀ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa hoiee naaganee jagat rahee lapaTai ||
verses.translation: Maya is a serpent, clinging to the world.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis kee sevaa jo kare tis hee kau fir khai ||
verses.translation: Whoever serves her, she ultimately devours.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਗਾਰੜੂ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਲਿ ਦਲਿ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koiee gaaraRoo tin mal dhal laiee pai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is a snake-charmer; he has trampled her and thrown her down, and crushed her underfoot.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak seiee ubare j sach rahe liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee kare pukaar prabhoo sunaisee ||
verses.translation: The minstrel cries out, and God hears him.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar dheerak hoi pooraa paisee ||
verses.translation: He is comforted within his mind, and he obtains the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa lekh se karam kamaisee ||
verses.translation: Whatever destiny is pre-ordained by the Lord, those are the deeds he does.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa hovai khasam dhiaal taa mahal ghar paisee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord and Master becomes Merciful, then one obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as his home.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਸੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so prabh meraa at vaddaa gurmukh melaisee ||5||
verses.translation: That God of mine is so very great; as Gurmukh, I have met Him. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa sahu ek hai sadh hee rahai hajoor ||
verses.translation: There is One Lord God of all; He remains ever-present.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਈ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na ma(n)niee taa ghar hee a(n)dhar dhoor ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukam bhee tin(h)aa manaisee jin(h) kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: They alone obey the Lord's Command, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)n sukh paiaa prem suhaagan hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Obeying His Command, one obtains peace, and becomes the happy, loving soul-bride. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rain sabaiee jal muiee ka(n)t na laio bhaau ||
verses.translation: She who does not love her Husband Lord, burns and wastes away all through the night of her life.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sukh vasan suohaaganee jin(h) piaaraa purakh har raau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-brides dwell in peace; they have the Lord, their King, as their Husband. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag fir mai dhekhiaa har iko dhaataa ||
verses.translation: Roaming over the entire world, I have seen that the Lord is the only Giver.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aupai kitai na paieeaai har karam bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord cannot be obtained by any device at all; He is the Architect of Karma.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee har man vasai har sahaje jaataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and the Lord is easily revealed within.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu tirasanaa agan bujhee har a(n)mirat sar naataa ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire within is quenched, and one bathes in the Lord's Pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee vadde kee gurmukh bolaataa ||6||
verses.translation: The great greatness of the great Lord God - the Gurmukh speaks of this. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਪਇਆ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ha(n)s kiaa preet hai j piaa hee chhadd jai ||
verses.translation: What love is this between the body and soul, which ends when the body falls?

verses.original: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਿ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ ਜਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: es no kooR bol k khavaaleeaai j chaladhiaa naal na jai ||
verses.translation: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਪਉਣੈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa miTee a(n)dh hai paunai puchhahu jai ||
verses.translation: The body is merely blind dust; go, and ask the soul.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau taa maiaa mohiaa fir fir aavaa jai ||
verses.translation: The soul answers, ""I am enticed by Maya, and so I come and go, again and again.""

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na jaato khasam kaa j rahaa sach samai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko nihachal naam dhan hor dhan aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only permanent wealth; all other wealth comes and goes.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾ ਓਚਕਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhan kau tasakar joh na sakiee naa ochakaa lai jai ||
verses.translation: Thieves cannot steal this wealth, nor can robbers take it away.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਐ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਐ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih har dhan jeeaai setee rav rahiaa jeeaai naale jai ||
verses.translation: This wealth of the Lord is embedded in the soul, and with the soul, it shall depart.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te paieeaai manmukh palai na pai ||
verses.translation: It is obtained from the Perfect Guru; the self-willed manmukhs do not receive it.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa jin(h)aa naam dhan khaTiaa aai ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed are the traders, O Nanak, who have come to earn the wealth of the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa saahib at vaddaa sach gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
verses.translation: My Master is so very great, true, profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag tis kai vas hai sabh tis kaa cheeraa ||
verses.translation: The whole world is under His power; everything is the projection of Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paieeaai nihachal dhan dheeraa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the eternal wealth is obtained, bringing peace and patience to the mind.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa te har man vasai bheTai gur sooraa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the Lord dwells in the mind, and one meets the Brave Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sadhaa thir nihachal har pooraa ||7||
verses.translation: The virtuous praise the ever-stable, permanent, perfect Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag tin(h)aa dhaa jeeviaa jo har sukh parahar tiaagadhe dhukh haumai paap kamai ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the life of those who forsake and throw away the peace of the Lord's Name, and suffer pain instead by practicing ego and sin.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh agiaanee maiaa moh viaape tin(h) boojh na kaiee pai ||
verses.translation: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of Maya; they have no understanding at all.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਓਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat oi sukh na paaveh a(n)t ge pachhutai ||
verses.translation: In this world and in the world beyond, they do not find peace; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ko naam dhiaae tis haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one may meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and egotism departs from within him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis poorab hovai likhiaa so gur charanee aai pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਊਧਾ ਕਉਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh uoodhaa kaul hai naa tis bhagat na naau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the inverted lotus; he has neither devotional worship, nor the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਕਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sakatee a(n)dhar varatadhaa kooR tis kaa hai upaau ||
verses.translation: He remains engrossed in material wealth, and his efforts are false.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa a(n)dhar chit na bhijiee mukh feekaa aalaau ||
verses.translation: His consciousness is not softened within, and the words from his mouth are insipid.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਧਰਮਿ ਰਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਰਲਨਿੑ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: oi dharam ralaae naa ralani(h) onaa a(n)dhar kooR suaau ||
verses.translation: He does not mingle with the righteous; within him are falsehood and selfishness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karatai banat banaiee manmukh kooR bol bol ddube gurmukh tare jap har naau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Lord has arranged things, so that the self-willed manmukhs are drowned by telling lies, while the Gurmukhs are saved by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
