verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਵਡਾ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe vaddaa fer piaa fir aavai jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, one must wander around the cycle of reincarnation, and continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa na keeteeaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaiee ||
verses.translation: One who has not served the True Guru, shall depart regretting and repenting in the end.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee kirapaa kare gur paieeaai vichahu aap gavaiee ||
verses.translation: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, one finds the Guru, and ego is banished from within.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa bhukh vichahu utarai sukh vasai man aaiee ||
verses.translation: Hunger and thirst depart from within, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saalaaheeaai hiradhai liv laiee ||8||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, praise Him with love in your heart. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: j satigur seve aapanaa tis no pooje sabh koi ||
verses.translation: One who serves his True Guru, is worshipped by everyone.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa upaavaa sir upaau hai har naam paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Of all efforts, the supreme effort is the attainment of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar seetal saat vasai jap hiradhai sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind; meditating within the heart, there comes a lasting peace.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit khaanaa a(n)mrit painanaa naanak naam vaddaiee hoi ||1||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Amrit is his food, and the Ambrosial Amrit is his clothes; O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: e man gur kee sikh sun har paaveh gunee nidhaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, listen to the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa man vasai haumai jai gumaan ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, shall dwell in your mind, and your egotism and pride shall depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai taa anadhin laagai dhiaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then, night and day, one centers his meditation on the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh sabh sach hai gurmukh pavitaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is totally truthful, content and pure.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu kapaT vikaar giaa man sahaje jitaa ||
verses.translation: Deception and wickedness have departed from within him, and he easily conquers his mind.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh jot pragaas ana(n)dh ras agiaan gavitaa ||
verses.translation: There, the Divine Light and the essence of bliss are manifest, and ignorance is eliminated.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin har ke gun ravai gun paragaT kitaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and manifests the excellence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa dhaataa ek hai iko har mitaa ||9||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all; the Lord alone is our friend. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dhe so braahaman kaheeaai j anadhin har liv laae ||
verses.translation: One who understands God, who lovingly centers his mind on the Lord night and day, is called a Brahmin.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਛੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur puchhai sach sa(n)jam kamaavai haumai rog tis jaae ||
verses.translation: Consulting the True Guru, he practices Truth and self-restraint, and he is rid of the disease of ego.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai gun sa(n)grahai jotee jot milaae ||
verses.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and gathers in His Praises; his light is blended with the Light.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh ko viralaa braham giaanee j haumai meT samaae ||
verses.translation: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed in God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis no miliaa sadhaa sukh paieeaai j anadhin har naam dhiaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting him, peace is obtained; night and day, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kapaT manmukh agiaanee rasanaa jhooTh bolai ||
verses.translation: Within the ignorant self-willed manmukh is deception; with his tongue, he speaks lies.

verses.original: ਕਪਟਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kapaT keetai har purakh na bheejai nit vekhai sunai subhai ||
verses.translation: Practicing deception, he does not please the Lord God, who always sees and hears with natural ease.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai jai jag parabodhai bikh maiaa moh suaai ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, he goes to instruct the world, but he is engrossed in the poison of Maya and attachment to pleasure.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eit kamaanai sadhaa dhukh paavai ja(n)mai marai fir aavai jai ||
verses.translation: By doing so, he suffers in constant pain; he is born and then dies, and comes and goes again and again.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa mool na chukiee vich visaTaa pachai pachai ||
verses.translation: His doubts do not leave him at all, and he rots away in manure.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare meraa suaamee tis gur kee sikh sunai ||
verses.translation: One, unto whom my Lord Master shows His Mercy, listens to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaavai har naamo gaavai har naamo a(n)t chhaddai ||2||
verses.translation: He meditates on the Lord's Name, and sings the Lord's Name; in the end, the Lord's Name will deliver him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa hukam manaion te poore sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Those who obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, are the perfect persons in the world.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sevani(h) aapanaa poorai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: They serve their Lord Master, and reflect upon the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa chaakaree sachai sabadh piaar ||
verses.translation: They serve the Lord, and love the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa mahal tin(h)ee paiaa jin(h) haumai vichahu maar ||
verses.translation: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, as they eradicate egotism from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mil rahe jap har naamaa ur dhaar ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with Him, chanting the Name of the Lord, and enshrining it within their hearts. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhiaan sahaj dhun upajai sach naam chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord; the celestial sound-current resounds within him, and he focuses his consciousness on the True Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh anadhin rahai ra(n)g raataa har kaa naam man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains imbued with the Lord's Love, night and day; his mind is pleased with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har vekheh gurmukh har boleh gurmukh har sahaj ra(n)g laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord, and the Gurmukh naturally loves the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh giaan paraapat hovai timar agiaan adher chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and the pitch-black darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis no karam hovai dhur pooraa tin gurmukh har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Perfect Lord's Grace - as Gurmukh, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jinaa na sevio sabadh na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru do not embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje naam na dhiaaiaa kit aaiaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: They do not meditate on the Celestial Naam, the Name of the Lord - why did they even bother to come into the world?

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir joonee paieeaai visaTaa sadhaa khuaar ||
verses.translation: Time and time again, they are reincarnated, and they rot away forever in manure.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai laalach lagiaa naa uravaar na paar ||
verses.translation: They are attached to false greed; they are not on this shore, nor on the one beyond.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ubare j aap mele karataar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Creator Lord unites them with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat sachai dhar sohadhe sachai sabadh rahaae ||
verses.translation: The devotees look beauteous in the True Court of the Lord; they abide in the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kee preet tin uoopajee har prem kasaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Love wells up in them; they are attracted by the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raheh sadhaa ra(n)g raate rasanaa har ras piaae ||
verses.translation: They abide in the Lord's Love, they remain imbued with the Lord's Love forever, and with their tongues, they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam jin(h)ee gurmukh jaataa har jeeau ridhai vasaae ||
verses.translation: Fruitful are the lives of those Gurmukhs who recognize the Lord and enshrine Him in their hearts.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo firai bilalaadhee dhoojai bhai khuaae ||11||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, they wander around crying out in misery; in the love of duality, they are ruined. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh naam nidhaan bhagatee khaTiaa har utam padh paiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the devotees earn the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev har naam man vasaiaa anadhin naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, they enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds, and they meditate on the Naam, night and day.

verses.original: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: viche gireh gur bachan udhaasee haumai moh jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: Within the home of their own selves, they remain unattached, through the Guru's Teachings; they burn away egotism and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap tariaa kul jagat taraiaa dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and they save the whole world. Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur soiee paae jis dhur masatak har likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone finds such a True Guru, upon whose forehead the Lord inscribed such pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak balihaaree gur aapane viTahu jin bhram bhulaa maarag paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to his Guru; when he was wandering in doubt, He placed him on the Path. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa vekh bhule jiau dhekh dheepak pata(n)g pachaiaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding Maya with her three dispositions, he goes astray; he is like the moth, which sees the flame, and is consumed.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਦਿਖਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਣਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit bhul bhul maiaa vekheh dhikhaa kinai kih aan chaRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The mistaken, deluded Pandits gaze upon Maya, and watch to see whether anyone has offered them something.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਦਯਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai paReh nit bikhiaa naavahu dhay khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they read continually about sin, while the Lord has withheld His Name from them.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਓਨੑਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jogee ja(n)gam sa(n)niaasee bhule on(h)aa aha(n)kaar bahu garab vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, the wandering hermits and the Sannyaasees have gone astray; their egotism and arrogance have increased greatly.

verses.original: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਹੀ ਸਤ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadhan bhojan na laihee sat bhikhiaa manahaTh janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: They do not accept the true donations of clothes and food, and their lives are ruined by their stubborn minds.

verses.original: ਏਤੜਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: etaRiaa vichahu so jan samadhaa jin gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Among these, he alone is a man of poise, who, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kis no aakh sunaieeaai jaa karadhe sabh karaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Unto whom should servant Nanak speak and complain? All act as the Lord causes them to act. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh paret hai kaam karodh aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya, sexual desire, anger and egotism are demons.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਏਨੑਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh jam kee sirakaar hai en(h)aa upar jam kaa dda(n)dd karaaraa ||
verses.translation: Because of them, mortals are subject to death; above their heads hangs the heavy club of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਨੑ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh jam mag paieeani(h) jin(h) dhoojaa bhaau piaaraa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, are led onto the path of Death.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur badhe maareean ko sunai na pookaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, they are tied up and beaten, and no one hears their cries.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare tis gur milai gurmukh nisataaraa ||12||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace meets the Guru; as Gurmukh, he is emancipated. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa mohanee manmukhaa no giee khai ||
verses.translation: By egotism and pride, the self-willed manmukhs are enticed, and consumed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo moh dhoojai chit laidhe tinaa viaap rahee lapaTai ||
verses.translation: Those who center their consciousness on duality are caught in it, and remain stuck.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਤਾ ਏਹ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh parajaaleeaai taa eh vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: But when it is burnt away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, only then does it depart from within.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan man hovai ujalaa naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The body and mind become radiant and bright, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak maiaa kaa maaran har naam hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is the antidote to Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man ketaRiaa jug bharamiaa thir rahai na aavai jai ||
verses.translation: This mind has wandered through so many ages; it has not remained stable - it continues coming and going.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਭਰਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaanaa taa bharamaian kar parapa(n)ch khel upai ||
verses.translation: When it is pleasing to the Lord's Will, then He causes the soul to wander; He has set the world-drama in motion.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa har bakhase taa gur milai asathir rahai samai ||
verses.translation: When the Lord forgives, then one meets the Guru, and becoming stable, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak man hee te man maaniaa naa kichh marai na jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the mind, the mind is satisfied, and then, nothing comes or goes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa koT apaar hai milanaa sa(n)jogee ||
verses.translation: The body is the fortress of the Infinite Lord; it is obtained only by destiny.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar aap vas rahiaa aape ras bhogee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He Himself is the Enjoyer of pleasures.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap ateet alipat hai nirajog har jogee ||
verses.translation: He Himself remains detached and unaffected; while unattached, He is still attached.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so kare har kare su hogee ||
verses.translation: He does whatever He pleases, and whatever He does, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: har gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai leh jaeh vijogee ||13||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name, and separation from the Lord is ended. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu aap akhaidhaa gur sabadhee sach soi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord Himself causes us to praise Him, through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu sifat salaeh hai gurmukh boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is His Eulogy and Praise; how rare are the Gurmukhs who understand this.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai sach milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Word of His Bani, by which we meet our True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu karatiaa prabh paiaa karam paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chanting Waaho! Waaho! God is attained; by His Grace, He is obtained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatee rasanaa sabadh suhaiee ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the tongue is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: poorai sabadh prabh miliaa aaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Shabad, one comes to meet God.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaageeaa vaahu vaahu muhahu kaddaiee ||
verses.translation: How very fortunate are those, who with their mouths, chant Waaho! Waaho!

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਰਜਾ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu kareh seiee jan sohane tin(h) kau parajaa poojan aaiee ||
verses.translation: How beautiful are those persons who chant Waaho! Waaho! ; people come to venerate them.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karam paraapat hovai naanak dhar sachai sobhaa paiee ||2||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is obtained by His Grace; O Nanak, honor is obtained at the Gate of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੑ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bajar kapaaT kaiaa gaR(h) bheetar kooR kusat abhimaanee ||
verses.translation: Within the fortress of body, are the hard and rigid doors of falsehood, deception and pride.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhoole nadhar na aavanee manmukh a(n)dh agiaanee ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, the blind and ignorant self-willed manmukhs cannot see them.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਵਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aupai kitai na labhanee kar bhekh thake bhekhavaanee ||
verses.translation: They cannot be found by any efforts; wearing their religious robes, the wearers have grown weary of trying.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee kholaieeani(h) har naam japaanee ||
verses.translation: The doors are opened only by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and then, one chants the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: har jeeau a(n)mirat birakh hai jin peeaa te tirapataanee ||14||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Tree of Ambrosial Nectar; those who drink in this Nectar are satisfied. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa rain sukh vihai ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the night of one's life passes in peace.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai meree mai ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! I am in eternal bliss, O my mother!

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, I have fallen in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karamee bolai bolai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Through the karma of good deeds, I chant it, and inspire others to chant it as well.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sobhaa pai ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, one obtains honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu sat rajai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! is the Will of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai gurmukh ladhee bhaal ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani of the True Word. Searching, the Gurmukhs have found it.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu sabadhe ucharai vaahu vaahu hiradhai naal ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! They chant the Word of the Shabad. Waaho! Waaho! They enshrine it in their hearts.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har paiaa sahaje gurmukh bhaal ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the Gurmukhs easily obtain the Lord, after searching.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa har har ridhai samaal ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who reflect upon the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: e manaa at lobheeaa nit lobhe raataa ||
verses.translation: O my utterly greedy mind, you are constantly engrossed in greed.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa manasaa mohanee dheh dhis firaataa ||
verses.translation: In your desire for the enticing Maya, you wander in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: agai naau jaat na jaisee manmukh dhukh khaataa ||
verses.translation: Your name and social status shall not go with you hereafter; the self-willed manmukh is consumed by pain.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਫੀਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har ras na chakhio feekaa bolaataa ||
verses.translation: Your tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord; it utters only insipid words.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jinaa gurmukh a(n)mrit chaakhiaa se jan tirapataataa ||15||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar are satisfied. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeaai j sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
verses.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is True, profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeaai j gunadhaataa mat dheer ||
verses.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of virtue, intelligence and patience.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeaai j sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is permeating and pervading in all.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeaai j dhedhaa rijak sabaeh ||
verses.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of sustenance to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu iko kar saalaaheeaai j satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! - praise the One Lord, revealed by the True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu gurmukh sadhaa kareh manmukh mareh bikh khai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Gurmukhs praise the Lord continually, while the self-willed manmukhs eat poison and die.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa vaahu vaahu na bhaaviee dhukhe dhukh vihai ||
verses.translation: They have no love for the Lord's Praises, and they pass their lives in misery.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)mrit peevanaa vaahu vaahu kareh liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and they center their consciousness on the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu kareh se jan niramale tirabhavan sojhee pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! are immaculate and pure; they obtain the knowledge of the three worlds. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai gur milai sevaa bhagat baneejai ||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Will, one meets the Guru, serves Him, and worships the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai har man vasai sahaje ras peejai ||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Will, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one easily drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai sukh paieeaai har laahaa nit leejai ||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Will, one finds peace, and continually earns the Lord's Profit.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai takhat bahaaleeaai nij ghar sadhaa vaseejai ||
verses.translation: He is seated on the Lord's throne, and he dwells continually in the home of his own being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: har kaa bhaanaa tinee ma(n)niaa jinaa guroo mileejai ||16||
verses.translation: He alone surrenders to the Lord's Will, who meets the Guru. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu se jan sadhaa kareh jin(h) kau aape dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Those humble beings ever praise the Lord, unto whom the Lord Himself grants understanding.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karatiaa man niramal hovai haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, the mind is purified, and egotism departs from within.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu gursikh jo nit kare so man chi(n)dhiaa fal pai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh who continually chants Waaho! Waaho! attains the fruits of his heart's desires.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu kareh se jan sohane har tin(h) kai sa(n)g milai ||
verses.translation: Beauteous are those humble beings who chant Waaho! Waaho! O Lord, let me join them!

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਚਰਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu hiradhai ucharaa mukhahu bhee vaahu vaahu kareau ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I chant Waaho! Waaho!, and with my mouth, Waaho! Waaho!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu jo kareh hau tan man tin(h) kau dheau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! - unto them I dedicate my body and mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu saahib sach hai a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Lord Master; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa tin fal paiaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord are blessed with the fruit; I am a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu gunee nidhaan hai jis no dhei su khai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the treasure of virtue; he alone tastes it, who is so blessed.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu jal thal bharapoor hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is pervading and permeating the oceans and the land; the Gurmukh attains Him.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਿਤ ਸਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu gursikh nit sabh karahu gur poore vaahu vaahu bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Let all the Gursikhs continually praise Him. Waaho! Waaho! The Perfect Guru is pleased with His Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu jo man chit kare tis jamaka(n)kar neR na aavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who chants Waaho! Waaho! with his heart and mind - the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sachaa sach hai sachee gurbaanee ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Truest of the True; True is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te sach pachhaaneeaai sach sahaj samaanee ||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the Truth is realized, and one is easily absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾ ਸਵਹਿ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jaageh naa saveh jaagat rain vihaanee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they remain awake, and do not sleep; in wakefulness, the night of their lives passes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee har ras chaakhiaa se pu(n)n paraanee ||
verses.translation: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, are the most worthy persons.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: bin gur kinai na paio pach mue ajaanee ||17||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; the ignorant rot away and die. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu baanee nira(n)kaar hai tis jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani, the Word, of the Formless Lord. There is no other as great as He is.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu agam athaahu hai vaahu vaahu sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is unfathomable and inaccessible. Waaho! Waaho! He is the True One.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu veparavaahu hai vaahu vaahu kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! He is the self-existent Lord. Waaho! Waaho! As He wills, so it comes to pass.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu a(n)mirat naam hai gurmukh paavai koi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtained by the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu karamee paieeaai aap dhiaa kar dhei ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! This is realized by His Grace, as He Himself grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vaahu vaahu gurmukh paieeaai anadhin naam lei ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! This is obtained by the Gurmukhs, who hold tight to the Naam, night and day. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve saat na aaviee dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained, and the sense of duality does not depart.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je bahuteraa locheeaai vin karamai na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: No matter how much one may wish, without the Lord's Grace, He is not found.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
verses.translation: Those who are filled with greed and corruption are ruined by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran na chukiee haumai vich dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: They cannot escape birth and death, and with egotism within them, they suffer in misery.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa satigur siau chit laiaa su khaalee koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: Those who center their consciousness on the True Guru, never go empty-handed.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin jam kee talab na hoviee naa oi dhukh sahaeh ||
verses.translation: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ubare sachai sabadh samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they merge in the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee tis no aakheeaai j khasamai dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: He alone is called a minstrel, who enshrines love for his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਖੜਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhar khaRaa sevaa kare gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Standing at the Lord's Door, he serves the Lord, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee dhar ghar paisee sach rakhai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The minstrel attains the Lord's Gate and Mansion, and he keeps the True Lord clasped to his heart.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee kaa mahal agalaa har kai nai piaar ||
verses.translation: The status of the minstrel is exalted; he loves the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee kee sevaa chaakaree har jap har nisataar ||18||
verses.translation: The service of the minstrel is to meditate on the Lord; he is emancipated by the Lord. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree jaat gavaar jaa sahu paae aapanaa ||
verses.translation: The milkmaid's status is very low, but she attains her Husband Lord

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh veechaar anadhin har jap jaapanaa ||
verses.translation: when she reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and chants the Lord's Name, night and day.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis satigur milai tis bhau pavai saa kulava(n)tee naar ||
verses.translation: She who meets the True Guru, lives in the Fear of God; she is a woman of noble birth.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੰਤ ਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saa hukam pachhaanai ka(n)t kaa jis no kirapaa keetee karataar ||
verses.translation: She alone realizes the Hukam of her Husband Lord's Command, who is blessed by the Creator Lord's Mercy.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: oh kuchajee kulakhanee parahar chhoddee bhataar ||
verses.translation: She who is of little merit and ill-mannered, is discarded and forsaken by her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai piaai mal kaTeeaai niramal hovai sareer ||
verses.translation: By the Fear of God, filth is washed off, and the body becomes immaculately pure.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar paragaas mat uootam hovai har jap gunee gaheer ||
verses.translation: The soul is enlightened, and the intellect is exalted, meditating on the Lord, the ocean of excellence.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਭੈ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich baisai bhai rahai bhai vich kamaavai kaar ||
verses.translation: One who dwells in the Fear of God, lives in the Fear of God, and acts in the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai sukh vaddiaaieeaa dharageh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: He obtains peace and glorious greatness here, in the Lord's Court, and at the Gate of Salvation.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te nirabhau paieeaai mil jotee jot apaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and one's light merges in the Infinite Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak khasamai bhaavai saa bhalee jis no aape bakhase karataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that bride alone is good, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master, and whom the Creator Lord Himself forgives. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saalaaheeaai sache kau bal jaau ||
verses.translation: Praise the Lord, forever and ever, and make yourself a sacrifice to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ek chhodd dhoojai lagai saa jihavaa jal jaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, let that tongue be burnt, which renounces the One Lord, and attaches itself to another. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਸਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)saa aautaar upaion bhaau dhoojaa keeaa ||
verses.translation: From a single particle of His greatness, He created His incarnations, but they indulged in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭਿੜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau raaje raaj kamaavadhe dhukh sukh bhiReeaa ||
verses.translation: They ruled like kings, and fought for pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: e'eesar brahamaa sevadhe a(n)t tin(h)ee na laheeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve Shiva and Brahma do not find the limits of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau nira(n)kaar alakh hai gurmukh pragaTeeaa ||
verses.translation: The Fearless, Formless Lord is unseen and invisible; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: tithai sog vijog na viaapiee asathir jag theeaa ||19||
verses.translation: There, one does not suffer sorrow or separation; he becomes stable and immortal in the world. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh sabh kichh aavan jaan hai jetaa hai aakaar ||
verses.translation: All these things come and go, all these things of the world.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh lekhaa likhiaa so hoaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who knows this written account is acceptable and approved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak je ko aap ganaidhaa so moorakh gaavaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, anyone who takes pride in himself is foolish and unwise. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੀਲਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man ku(n)char peelak guroo giaan ku(n)ddaa jeh khi(n)che teh jai ||
verses.translation: The mind is the elephant, the Guru is the elephant-driver, and knowledge is the whip. Wherever the Guru drives the mind, it goes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hasatee ku(n)dde baaharaa fir fir ujhaR pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the whip, the elephant wanders into the wilderness, again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis aagai aradhaas jin upaiaa ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer to the One, from whom I was created.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apanaa sev sabh fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: Serving my True Guru, I have obtained all the fruits.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat har kaa naau sadhaa dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate continually on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g dhukh miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I am rid of my pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bhe achi(n)t har dhan nihachalaiaa ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have become care-free; I have obtained the imperishable wealth of the Lord. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੇਤਿ ਮਿਆਲਾ ਉਚੀਆ ਘਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨਿਰਣਉ ॥
verses.translit: khet miaalaa ucheeaa ghar uchaa niranau ||
verses.translation: Raising the embankments of the mind's field, I gaze at the heavenly mansion.

verses.original: ਮਹਲ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸਰੈ ਸਜਣ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਅਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahal bhagatee ghar sarai sajan paahuniaau ||
verses.translation: When devotion comes to the mind of the soul-bride, she is visited by the friendly guest.

verses.original: ਬਰਸਨਾ ਤ ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਰਸਹਿ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: barasanaa ta baras ghanaa bahuR baraseh kaeh ||
verses.translation: O clouds, if you are going to rain, then go ahead and rain; why rain after the season has passed?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin(h) balihaaranai jin(h) gurmukh paiaa man maeh ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who obtain the Lord in their minds. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋ ਜਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa so jo bhaavadhaa sajan so j raas ||
verses.translation: That which is pleasing is sweet, and one who is sincere is a friend.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh jaaneeaai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he is known as a Gurmukh, whom the Lord Himself enlightens. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh paas jan kee aradhaas too sachaa saa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: O God, Your humble servant offers his prayer to You; You are my True Master.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: too rakhavaalaa sadhaa sadhaa hau tudh dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: You are my Protector, forever and ever; I meditate on You.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh teriaa too rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: All the beings and creatures are Yours; You are pervading and permeating in them.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhaas tere kee ni(n)dhaa kare tis maar pachaiee ||
verses.translation: One who slanders Your slave is crushed and destroyed.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa chhadd achi(n)t rahu naanak lag paiee ||21||
verses.translation: Falling at Your Feet, Nanak has renounced his cares, and has become care-free. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jai ||
verses.translation: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aasaa pooreeaa sache siau chit lai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, hopes are fulfilled only by attaching one's consciousness to the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa mar jaisee jin keetee so lai jai ||
verses.translation: Hopes and desires shall die only when He, who created them, takes them away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nihachal ko nahee baajhahu har kai nai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, nothing is permanent, except the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagat upaion kar pooraa thaaT ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the world, with His perfect workmanship.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape hee har haaT ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the true banker, He Himself is the merchant, and He Himself is the store.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖੇਵਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape saagar aape bohithaa aape hee khevaaT ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the ocean, He Himself is the boat, and He Himself is the boatman.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦਸੇ ਘਾਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape dhase ghaaT ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Guru, He Himself is the disciple, and He Himself shows the destination.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੁ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaai too sabh kilavikh kaaT ||22||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and all your sins shall be eradicated. ||22||1||Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: raag goojaree vaar mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, Vaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar gur aaraadhanaa jihavaa jap gur naau ||
verses.translation: Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant the Guru's Name.

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੇਖਣਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: netree satigur pekhanaa sravanee sunanaa gur naau ||
verses.translation: Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur setee ratiaa dharageh paieeaai Thaau ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਹ ਵਥੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kirapaa kare jis no eh vath dhei ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਉਤਮ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jag meh utam kaadde'eeh virale keiee kei ||1||
verses.translation: In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਖੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: rakhe rakhanahaar aap ubaarian ||
verses.translation: O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee pairee pai kaaj savaarian ||
verses.translation: Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.

verses.original: ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hoaa aap dhiaal manahu na visaarian ||
verses.translation: You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from our minds.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal taarian ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saakat ni(n)dhak dhusaT khin maeh bidhaarian ||
verses.translation: In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis saahib kee Tek naanak manai maeh ||
verses.translation: That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sukh hoi sagale dhookh jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: akul nira(n)jan purakh agam apaareeaai ||
verses.translation: He is without relatives, immaculate, all-powerful, unapproachable and infinite.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sacho sachaa sach sach nihaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Truly, the True Lord is seen to be the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kooR na jaapai kichh teree dhaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Nothing established by You appears to be false.

verses.original: ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabhasai dhe dhaataar jet upaareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver gives sustenance to all those He has created.

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਜਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: eikat soot paroi jot sa(n)jaareeaai ||
verses.translation: He has strung all on only one thread; He has infused His Light in them.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਮੰਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukame bhavajal ma(n)jh hukame taareeaai ||
verses.translation: By His Will, some drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and by His Will, some are carried across.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jeeau tudh dhiaae soi jis bhaag mathaareeaai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, he alone meditates on You, upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teree gat mit lakhee na jai hau tudh balihaareeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Your condition and state cannot be known; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) tuseh miharavaan achi(n)t vaseh man maeh ||
verses.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, you automatically come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) tuseh miharavaan nau nidh ghar meh paeh ||
verses.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I find the nine treasures within the home of my own self.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) tuseh miharavaan taa gur kaa ma(n)tr kamaeh ||
verses.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I act according to the Guru's Instructions.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) tuseh miharavaan taa naanak sach samaeh ||1||
verses.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, then Nanak is absorbed in the True One. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਤੀ ਬੈਹਨਿੑ ਬੈਹਣੇ ਮੁਚੁ ਵਜਾਇਨਿ ਵਜ ॥
verses.translit: kitee baihani(h) baihane much vajain vaj ||
verses.translation: Many sit on thrones, to the sounds of musical instruments.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਲਜ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vin kisai na raheeaa laj ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's honor is safe. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸਣੁ ਖੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh dhiaaini(h) bedh katebaa san khaRe ||
verses.translation: The followers of the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran, standing at Your Door, meditate on You.

verses.original: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ganatee ganee na jai terai dhar paRe ||
verses.translation: Uncounted are those who fall at Your Door.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahame tudh dhiaaini(h) i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasanaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma meditates on You, as does Indra on his throne.

verses.original: ਸੰਕਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kar bisan avataar har jas mukh bhanaa ||
verses.translation: Shiva and Vishnu, and their incarnations, chant the Lord's Praise with their mouths,

verses.original: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕਾਬਰ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਅਉਲੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: peer pikaabar sekh masaik aaule'ee ||
verses.translation: as do the Pirs, the spiritual teachers, the prophets and the Shaykhs, the silent sages and the seers.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਉਲੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot nira(n)kaar ghaT ghaT maule'ee ||
verses.translation: Through and through, the Formless Lord is woven into each and every heart.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਧਰਮੇ ਤਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kooRahu kare vinaas dharame tageeaai ||
verses.translation: One is destroyed through falsehood; through righteousness, one prospers.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jit jit laieh aap tit tit lageeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord links him to, to that he is linked. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੰਗਿਆੲਂੀ ਆਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆੲਂੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)giaae(n)ee aalak kare buriaae(n)ee hoi ser ||
verses.translation: He is reluctant to do good, but eager to practice evil.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਆਵਸੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aj kal aavasee gaafal faahee per ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਤੀਆ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਗੁਝਾ ਥੀਐ ਨ ਹਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiteeaa kudda(n)g gujhaa theeaai na hit ||
verses.translation: No matter how evil my ways are, still, Your Love for me is not concealed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਢਕਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tai seh ddakiaa man meh sachaa mit ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak: You, O Lord, conceal my short-comings and dwell within my mind; You are my true friend. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੋਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau maagau tujhai dhiaal kar dhaasaa goliaa ||
verses.translation: I beg of You, O Merciful Lord: please, make me the slave of Your slaves.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh paiee raaj jeevaa boliaa ||
verses.translation: I obtain the nine treasures and royalty; chanting Your Name, I live.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam nidhaan dhaasaa ghar ghanaa ||
verses.translation: The great ambrosial treasure, the Nectar of the Naam, is in the home of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin kai sa(n)g nihaal sravanee jas sunaa ||
verses.translation: In their company, I am in ecstasy, listening to Your Praises with my ears.

verses.original: ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kamaavaa tin kee kaar sareer pavit hoi ||
verses.translation: Serving them, my body is purified.

verses.original: ਪਖਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pakhaa paanee pees bigasaa pair dhoi ||
verses.translation: I wave the fans over them, and carry water for them; I grind the corn for them, and washing their feet, I am over-joyed.

verses.original: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aapahu kachhoo na hoi prabh nadhar nihaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: By myself, I can do nothing; O God, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦਿਚੈ ਥਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh niragun dhichai thaau sa(n)t dharam saaleeaai ||3||
verses.translation: I am worthless - please, bless me with a seat in the place of worship of the Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sadh dhoor ||
verses.translation: O Friend, I pray that I may remain forever the dust of Your Feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadhaa hajoor ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, and beholds You ever-present. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet asa(n)kh hoh har charanee man laag ||
verses.translation: Countless sinners become pure, by fixing their minds on the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath naam prabh jis naanak masatak bhaag ||2||
verses.translation: The Name of God is the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, O Nanak, for one who has such destiny written upon his forehead. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰ ਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: nit japeeaai saas giraas naau paravadhigaar dhaa ||
verses.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, chant the Name of the Lord, the Cherisher.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰੇ ਰਹੰਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kare raha(n)m tis na visaaradhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord does not forget one upon whom He has bestowed His Grace.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaavanahaar aape hee maaradhaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself destroys.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh jaanai jaan bujh veechaaradhaa ||
verses.translation: The Knower knows everything; He understands and contemplates.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: anik roop khin maeh kudharat dhaaradhaa ||
verses.translation: By His creative power, He assumes numerous forms in an instant.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no lai sach tiseh udhaaradhaa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord attaches to the Truth is redeemed.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਲਿ ਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhai hovai val su kadhe na haaradhaa ||
verses.translation: One who has God on his side is never conquered.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਭਗੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sadhaa abhag dheebaan hai hau tis namasakaaradhaa ||4||
verses.translation: His Court is eternal and imperishable; I humbly bow to Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh chhoddeeaai dheejai agan jalai ||
verses.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, and burn them in the fire.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevadhiaa nit jaapeeaai naanak saachaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: As long as you are alive, O Nanak, meditate continually on the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: simarat simarat prabh aapanaa sabh fal paae aaeh ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my God, I have obtained all the fruits.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam araadhiaa gur poorai dheeaa milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so mukataa sa(n)saar j gur upadhesiaa ||
verses.translation: One who has been instructed by the Guru is liberated in this world.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee giee balai miTe a(n)dhesiaa ||
verses.translation: He avoids disaster, and his anxiety is dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa dharasan dhekh jagat nihaal hoi ||
verses.translation: Beholding the blessed vision of his Darshan, the world is over-joyed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jan kai sa(n)g nihaal paapaa mail dhoi ||
verses.translation: In the company of the Lord's humble servants, the world is over-joyed, and the filth of sin is washed away.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit saachaa naau othai jaapeeaai ||
verses.translation: There, they meditate on the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh bhukhaa dhraapeeaai ||
verses.translation: The mind becomes content, and its hunger is satisfied.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis ghaT vasiaa naau tis ba(n)dhan kaaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name, has his bonds cut away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੀਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kinai viralai har dhan khaaTeeaai ||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, some rare person earns the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਠਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: man meh chitavau chitavanee udham karau uTh neet ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I think thoughts of always rising early, and making the effort.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har keeratan kaa aaharo har dheh naanak ke meet ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, my Friend, please bless Nanak with the habit of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar prabh raakhiaa man tan rataa mool ||
verses.translation: Casting His Glance of Grace, God has saved me; my mind and body are imbued with the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jo prabh bhaaneeaa marau vichaaree sool ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, have their cries of suffering taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee birathaa hoi su gur peh aradhaas kar ||
verses.translation: When your soul is feeling sad, offer your prayers to the Guru.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd siaanap sagal man tan arap dhar ||
verses.translation: Renounce all your cleverness, and dedicate your mind and body to Him.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: poojahu gur ke pair dhuramat jai jar ||
verses.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru, and your evil-mindedness shall be burnt away.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal bikham tar ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਗੈ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਡਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sevahu satigur dhev agai na marahu ddar ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru, and in the world hereafter, you shall not die of fear.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh kare nihaal uoone subhar bhar ||
verses.translation: In an instant, he shall make you happy, and the empty vessel shall be filled to overflowing.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh dhiaaieeaai sadhaa har ||
verses.translation: The mind becomes content, meditating forever on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਧੁਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: so lagaa satigur sev jaa kau karam dhur ||6||
verses.translation: He alone dedicates himself to the Guru's service, unto whom the Lord has granted His Grace. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਗੜੀ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰੈ ਜੋੜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: lagaRee suthaan joRanahaarai joReeaa ||
verses.translation: I am attached to the right place; the Uniter has united me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਲਖ ਸੈ ਆਨ ਡੁਬਣ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak laharee lakh sai aan dduban dhei na maa piree ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there are hundreds and thousands of waves, but my Husband Lord does not let me drown. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਨਿ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੈ ਹਿਕੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: ban bheehaavalai hik saathee ladham dhukh harataa har naamaa ||
verses.translation: In the dreadful wilderness, I have found the one and only companion; the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of distress.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bal bal jaiee sa(n)t piaare naanak pooran kaamaa(n) ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints, O Nanak; through them, my affairs have been brought to fulfillment. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paieean sabh nidhaan terai ra(n)g ratiaa ||
verses.translation: All treasures are obtained, when we are attuned to Your Love.

verses.original: ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਜਪਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: n hovee pachhotaau tudh no japatiaa ||
verses.translation: One does not have to suffer regret and repentance, when he meditates on You.

verses.original: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: pahuch na sakai koi teree Tek jan ||
verses.translation: No one can equal Your humble servant, who has Your Support.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਮਨ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore vaahu vaahu sukh lahaa chitaar man ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! How wonderful is the Perfect Guru! Cherishing Him in my mind, I obtain peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur peh sifat bha(n)ddaar karamee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Lord's Praise comes from the Guru; by His Mercy, it is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur nadhar nihaal bahuR na dhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace, one does not wander any more.

verses.original: ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: rakhai aap dhiaal kar dhaasaa aapane ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord preserves him - He makes him His own slave.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har har har har naam jeevaa sun sune ||7||
verses.translation: Listening, hearing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, I live. ||7||
